movie:tt18926098.description: A married couple's trip takes an unsettling turn when the wife goes missing, prompting the husband's frantic search while an unknown villain creates obstacles.

movie:tt5072334.name: Inside the Trustor Scandal
movie:tt5072334.description: For the first time since 1997, Joachim Posener finally emerges from hiding and allows himself to be interviewed about his life and the Trustor affair. Twenty-seven years ago, he disappeared without a trace, and ever since, he has been on the international most wanted list. Now, Karin af Klintberg searches for him to find out how he lives and where he's been hiding all these years. But perhaps above all, to uncover what everyone is wondering: Was he guilty? Through new and opposing testimonies from never-before-heard voices, Karin simultaneously continues the search for the truth about the coup. How could five people swindle 600 million kr and still go free? And where did the money actually go?

movie:tt39368489.name: #Skyking
movie:tt39368489.description: A troubled airport worker's impulsive decision to steal and fly a commercial plane becomes a gripping aerial drama that reflects deeper issues of mental health and working-class struggles in America.

movie:tt37982738.name: Love You So Bad
movie:tt37982738.description: Confident college senior Savannah must choose between wild bad boy L.A. and ambitious Vic while facing personal growth and past hurts, all while staying true to herself.

movie:tt38608937.name: One Shot with Ed Sheeran
movie:tt38608937.description: Ed Sheeran performs his hits in one continuous take while walking NYC streets, riding subways and meeting fans, creating spontaneous musical moments throughout the city.

movie:tt37024319.name: The Bus: A French Football Mutiny
movie:tt37024319.description: This documentary revisits the controversy surrounding the French team during the 2010 FIFA World Cup and the strike that made headlines and outraged an entire country.

movie:tt37737315.description: A quirky 29-year-old named Sathya embarks on an unexpected journey of laughter, unlikely friendships, and self-discovery. Through hilarious misadventures and chance encounters, he slowly sees life's bigger picture - its surprises, joys, and second chances.

movie:tt21996220.name: The Rose of Versailles
movie:tt21996220.description: In an age of revolution, Marie Antoinette and her protector Oscar François de Jarjayes face tough choices as women growing into their distinct roles.

movie:tt15387182.name: Akhanda 2: Thaandavam
movie:tt15387182.description: When all hope died, Akhanda arrived. He saved his family, protected his people, killed the wrongdoers, and retreated into isolation. But years later, new threats emerge putting the world in danger. And as the world burns, Akhanda returns.

movie:tt38934698.name: Bunny!!
movie:tt38934698.description: A host of a relationship advice television programme starts to see cracks in her own marriage after the appearance of a mysterious guest.

movie:tt37649515.name: Jim Jefferies: Two Limb Policy
movie:tt37649515.description: Comedian Jim Jefferies shares his comedic takes on small mustaches, challenges faced by straight men, and his dismissive view of acting as a profession.

movie:tt35051383.name: Hoops, Hopes & Dreams
movie:tt35051383.description: The untold story about how Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. and an all-star team of civil rights activists took to basketball courts to rally young voters while winning hearts of communities, and how their strategy has echoed in contemporary politics.

movie:tt38201907.name: Henri Henri
movie:tt38201907.description: Henri was raised by religious in a convent and lived with them until the women, now elders, moved, leaving him alone. Henri fixes lamps. Since his young age, he's been replacing burned light bulbs and illuminates people's lives. After following signs, he finds himself working in a lamp company. Through his new work, he meets an old man trying to never forget his glory days and a blind woman, teller in an adult cinema, with whom he falls in love.

movie:tt14338246.name: Ustaad Bhagat Singh
movie:tt14338246.description: A tribal boy is shaped by the values of his teacher, who gives him the name 'Bhagat Singh'. He grows up deeply rooted in strong morals, which guide his actions throughout his life.He stands firm against injustice and takes on powerful evil forces, even when facing overwhelming odds.

movie:tt39075270.name: Stranger Things: Fireplace
movie:tt39075270.description: Gather 'round the fireplace in Hawkins, where the flames crackle, the alphabet glows — and the holidays get turned Upside Down.

movie:tt37738599.name: Millionaire
movie:tt37738599.description: A Chilean man hits the headlines when his damaged lottery ticket claiming a life-changing jackpot sparks a national investigation.

movie:tt37302783.name: Canelo Álvarez vs. Terence Crawford
movie:tt37302783.description: Canelo Álvarez and Terence Crawford clash in a mega-fight for boxing's unified super middleweight crown live from Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas.

movie:tt27957740.name: Daaku Maharaaj
movie:tt27957740.description: A daring robber, striving for survival and establishing his own territory amid conflicts with powerful adversaries, battling to become a 'king without a kingdom'.

movie:tt38109660.name: Golden Kamuy -The Abashiri Prison Raid-
movie:tt38109660.description: As each group pursues their mission, a fierce battle unfolds over the tattooed prisoners. Who is friend, and who is foe? The fight leads them all to Abashiri Prison, where Noppera-bo, the man who holds all the answers, is locked away...

movie:tt41801280.name: Untold UK: Liverpool's Miracle of Istanbul
movie:tt41801280.description: At half-time in the 2005 champion league final Liverpool were 3-0 down. What happened next made football history -​ as players recall in this documentary.

movie:tt33054858.name: Pati Patni Aur Woh Do
movie:tt33054858.description: A seemingly perfect marriage in Prayagraj takes an unexpected turn when one decision leads to a chain of misunderstandings, suspicion, and comedic chaos.

movie:tt39664733.name: Kartavya
movie:tt39664733.description: A police officer must hunt an exploited teenage assassin while his own family collapses under caste driven violence and moral absolutism, forcing him toward irreversible choices between institutional loyalty and blood ties.

movie:tt28037987.name: Saiyaara
movie:tt28037987.description: Heartbroken after being ditched at the altar, Vaani meets angry, struggling musician Krish. Her poetry ignites his songs and their passionate love. But as fame rises, her fading memories threaten to erase everything.

movie:tt37976405.name: Versa
movie:tt37976405.description: A young couple looking to start a family who experience emotions—from grief and loss to ultimate joy—as they embark on an ethereal, abstract, and imaginative cosmic dance of life.

movie:tt43702934.name: Disney Worldbuilders
movie:tt43702934.description: We sit down with some of the key figures shaping Disney’s most enduring stories for a series of intimate conversations about their early years, first sparks, and formative Disney memories — and how the worlds they once dreamed up are now taking shape at Disney destinations around the globe.

movie:tt39308381.name: Disneyland Handcrafted
movie:tt39308381.description: Hundreds of craftspeople brought Walt Disney's impossible dream of Disneyland to life in 1955. Rare archival footage and recordings reveal their untold stories of artistry and determination.

movie:tt27477888.name: Test
movie:tt27477888.description: Three people's worlds collide during a historic international cricket test match in Chennai which ultimately forces them to make life-changing difficult decisions.

movie:tt38895441.name: The Night My Dad Saved Christmas 2
movie:tt38895441.description: When Santa vanishes during a chaotic Christmas, a quirky actor tries to replace him. A father, his teen son and special friends must rescue Santa to save Christmas.

movie:tt39390472.name: Supernova Strikers: Genesis
movie:tt39390472.description: Influencers, celebrities, YouTube stars, and comedians face off in boxing matches, with live performances from top local artists like Carín León between each bout.

movie:tt31593809.name: Biker
movie:tt31593809.description: A seasoned motocross rider returns to the grueling sport he once abandoned, confronting fierce competition and a father who might push him to the brink.

movie:tt35712605.name: G.D.N
movie:tt35712605.description: G.D. Naidu overcomes challenges and defies a repressive colonial regime to become one of India's greatest innovators.

movie:tt39214430.name: CMXXIV
movie:tt39214430.description: Turkish comedy heavyweight Cem Yilmaz takes the stand-up stage in this dynamic special - covering everything from cancel culture to regretful tattoos.

movie:tt33255004.name: Death Before the Wedding
movie:tt33255004.description: When a small town's local dairy farm is about to get shut down, a father makes a plea with the new CEO's wife to keep it open in exchange for planning his daughter's wedding.

movie:tt37961067.name: Jordan Jensen: Take Me with You
movie:tt37961067.description: In her hilarious debut special, Jordan Jensen delivers unapologetic takes on failing at femininity, the paradox that is “self love” and the horrors of trying to find it.

movie:tt36120468.name: Pets
movie:tt36120468.description: Worldwide stories of human-animal bonds, following pet owners and rescuers with dogs, cats, pigs, goats and birds of prey. Features interviews, archives and viral clips showing people's connections with their animals.

movie:tt37975888.name: Jake Paul vs. Tank Davis
movie:tt37975888.description: Jake Paul collides with Gervonta "Tank" Davis in a can't-miss blockbuster boxing mega-event, presented by Most Valuable Promotions.

movie:tt39131664.name: Kumail Nanjiani: Night Thoughts
movie:tt39131664.description: After nearly a decade away, Kumail Nanjiani returns to Chicago, where he got his start in standup, in a special that tackles anxiety, the perils of buying drugs pre-legalization, and cat medication.

movie:tt39308444.name: Hannah Berner: None of My Business
movie:tt39308444.description: Follows Hannah Berner as she questions her future, exposes her unorthodox career path, dishes dating secrets and admits she's "part-time hot."

movie:tt39749953.name: The Debt Collector
movie:tt39749953.description: Haunted by guilt after prison, a former debt collector races against a terminal illness, returning to his old world to avenge loan shark victims.

movie:tt38673135.name: Taylor Swift: The Eras Tour - The Final Show
movie:tt38673135.description: Taylor Swift's Vancouver Eras Tour finale features 45 songs, including a new "Female Rage" segment and special medleys. The concert marked the end of her record-breaking global tour at BC Place Stadium.

movie:tt31312310.name: Oho Enthan Baby
movie:tt31312310.description: Ashwin goes to actor Vishnu Vishal’s office to pitch a script and ends up narrating his love story. What the actor thinks to be an interval is Ashwin’s climax, it actually is a stoic end to his romantic relationship with Meera. With Vishnu Vishal’s pursual, Ashwin must confront his former lover again, to complete his story and begin his debut directorial.

movie:tt39444813.name: Lainey Wilson: Keepin' Country Cool
movie:tt39444813.description: Lainey Wilson redefines what it means to be a modern country star while exploring her struggles and triumphs at a pivotal career moment.

movie:tt43596156.name: A Proud Family Wizmas
movie:tt43596156.description: When Penny Proud’s rant about Wizmas and the commercialization of Christmas causes Santa to quit on Christmas eve, Penny finds herself guilted into putting on the red suit and replacing him. And in the process of delivering Yuletide cheer with the help of Santa’s irreverent elves, she discovers that indeed the Christmas spirit is still alive.

movie:tt35669015.name: Frozen Hot Boys
movie:tt35669015.description: Driven by her personal agenda, a teacher at a juvenile detention center convinces a crew of teenage misfits to enter an snow sculpting contest in Japan.

movie:tt38873883.name: Matt Rife: Unwrapped: A Christmas Crowd Work Special
movie:tt38873883.description: Who is on Matt Rife's naughty or nice list? Find out as the comedian shares his thoughts on gifts, holiday traditions, and more.

movie:tt39367471.name: Taylor Tomlinson: Prodigal Daughter
movie:tt39367471.description: This is Taylor Tomlinson's fourth Netflix special, following Quarter-Life Crisis (2020), Look At You (2022), and Have It All (2024).

movie:tt33538438.name: Maa Behen
movie:tt33538438.description: Rekha and her daughters Jaya and Sushma, controversial figures in their conservative neighborhood, discover a dead body in their kitchen. The struggling, squabbling mother-daughter trio must work together to cover up the crime.

movie:tt38772659.name: Eloá the Hostage: Live on TV
movie:tt38772659.description: A tragic hostage case from 2008 Brazil unfolds through unseen diary entries, family interviews, and media coverage, as a 15-year-old girl is held captive by her ex-boyfriend for 100 hours while TV networks broadcast it live.

movie:tt38079900.name: Food Truck: Stolen Love... and Moo Deng
movie:tt38079900.description: When a child sneaks onto their food truck looking for his father, three friends go on a wild road trip, running into police, monks — and a famous hippo.

movie:tt34984613.name: You, Always
movie:tt34984613.description: Ethan is a devoted best friend who soon realises he has long been in love with Dr Jen Bell. However, Jen’s world is turned upside down by the arrival of a charismatic author named Patrick.

movie:tt38346012.name: The Balloonist
movie:tt38346012.description: Gaby, a heritage chicken keeper, is turned upside down when an arrogant air balloon pilot crashes on her chicken coop. The crash reveals the roots of a family conflict and forces Gaby to confront the air balloon pilot as well as h...

movie:tt40603309.name: Ronda Rousey vs. Gina Carano
movie:tt40603309.description: This event was the first-ever MMA event produced by Most Valuable Promotions, which also aired on Netflix. A women's featherweight bout between former Strikeforce and UFC Women's Bantamweight Champion Ronda Rousey and Gina Carano served as the event headliner. A five round welterweight bout between The Ultimate Fighter 5 lightweight winner Nate Diaz and Mike Perry took place as the co-main event.

movie:tt28802657.name: De De Pyaar De 2
movie:tt28802657.description: Love faces its toughest test yet as Ashish visits Ayesha's family home. Will the age-gap romance win hearts or stir things up? This Pyaar vs Parivaar clash promises a relatable, riotous ride for every kind of audience.

movie:tt38681567.name: Stephen
movie:tt38681567.description: Delves into the mind of a confessed killer being evaluated by a psychiatrist on a chilling case. The psychiatrist soon finds herself entangled in a mind-twisting mystery, which begins as an evaluation but leads to eternal darkness

movie:tt43617119.name: Love in Slow Motion
movie:tt43617119.description: When Haya's best friend Jawad gets engaged, her chronically-single world unravels — because who knew true love could be hiding in the friend zone?

movie:tt40618609.name: USA 94: Brazil's Return to Glory
movie:tt40618609.description: Follows Brazil's journey to winning its fourth World Cup in 1994, featuring interviews with players and unseen behind-the-scenes footage from the tournament.

movie:tt27907811.name: Thandel
movie:tt27907811.description: An action drama about a fisherman in Srikakulam who gets caught by the Pakistan forces in international waters.

movie:tt29383191.name: Maareesan
movie:tt29383191.description: In an unusual situation , Velayudham sets out on a journey with Dhaya from Nagercoil to Tiruvannamalai-a journey that will alter both their lives in ways they never imagined. What unfolds becomes the heart of the story.

movie:tt23804696.name: HIT: The 3rd Case
movie:tt23804696.description: The Homicide Intervention Team (HIT) sends ruthless police officer Arjun Sarkaar to find a group of killers and stop their grisly murder spree.

movie:tt36110471.name: Eraserheads: Combo on the Run
movie:tt36110471.description: When Eraserheads formed in 1989, their music swept the country. But the real story behind the group has remain untold. Until now...

movie:tt21279420.name: Emergency
movie:tt21279420.description: 1975. A chronicle of the incidents that took place under the leadership of Mrs. Indira Gandhi, one of the most powerful women in Indian history.

movie:tt32150360.name: Color Book
movie:tt32150360.description: Following the passing of his wife, a devoted father is learning to raise his son with Down Syndrome as a single parent. While adjusting to their new reality, the two embark on a journey through Metro Atlanta to attend their first baseball game.

movie:tt43339083.name: Tony Hinchcliffe: Man of the People
movie:tt43339083.description: Tony Hinchcliffe takes center stage to prove no topic is too taboo and nothing is off-limits — not even the audience — in this razor-sharp special.

movie:tt30742355.name: Sunny Sanskari Ki Tulsi Kumari
movie:tt30742355.description: Two former lovers in Delhi try to rekindle old flames, leading to amusing mix-ups and deceptions. As chaos unfolds, a new unexpected romance blooms. Who will find their happy ending amid the confusion.

movie:tt38590754.name: The Last Beergin
movie:tt38590754.description: Lives of 5 strangers intersect in a convenience store – Hilo a family man running away from his family, RG a man in a crossroad, Tere a tired married woman taking care of an invalid husband, Sandy a spoiled brat with trivial problems, Isaac a young man in love with Sandy but nonexistent to her.

movie:tt40341984.name: Harry Styles. One Night in Manchester
movie:tt40341984.description: Harry Styles performs his new album "Kiss All The Time. Disco, Occasionally" for the first time at a special one-off Manchester concert recorded March 6.

movie:tt35295747.name: Elway
movie:tt35295747.description: Told in his own words, the definitive story of Denver Broncos quarterback John Elway goes deep on his NFL dreams, heartbreaks and Super Bowl redemption.

movie:tt34365591.name: Mahavatar Narsimha
movie:tt34365591.description: The demon Hiranyakashyap seeks revenge on Vishnu and declares himself a god. His son Prahlad remains devoted to Vishnu. Vishnu manifests as Narsimha to defeat the demon and restore balance.

movie:tt38644597.name: Lali: Time To Step Up
movie:tt38644597.description: This documentary follows Lali in her return after four years away from the stage, showcasing the personal journey that led her to become the artist we know today.

movie:tt27235882.name: Thammudu
movie:tt27235882.description: A troubled man reunites with his sister to protect her and a group of villagers from the brutal plans of a violent criminal businessman.

movie:tt43604367.name: RADWIMPS 20th Anniversary Live Tour
movie:tt43604367.description: RADWIMPS celebrates 20 years since their major debut with this concert film, captured during their 17-show nationwide anniversary tour.

movie:tt38984207.name: Sunshine Women's Choir
movie:tt38984207.description: Inside a women's prison, four inmates form an unlikely bond with a newborn baby girl and create a choir to give her one final beautiful memory after she is diagnosed with an eye disease.

movie:tt39354078.name: Yoh! Bestie
movie:tt39354078.description: Thando's never been lucky in love. Now her best friend returns home with a fiancée on his arm, forcing her to confront a new emotion: jealousy.

movie:tt35657531.name: One Hit Wonder
movie:tt35657531.description: When big dreams meet second chances, two dreamers Entoy and Lorina chase fame in the world of '90s OPM. Will they make it?

movie:tt27136041.name: Champion
movie:tt27136041.description: An aspiring football star desperately seeks a way to travel to England to play for a famous team, but his journey leads him to a village waging a bloody conflict.

movie:tt42037166.name: Chris & Martina: The Final Set
movie:tt42037166.description: Tennis legends Chris Evert and Martina Navratilova reflect on their parallel journeys to sports stardom while delving into their rivalry and friendship, especially as the duo continue to support each other through their shared experience of cancer treatment.

movie:tt31227132.name: The Biggest Fan
movie:tt31227132.description: Canceled in Hollywood, star Lana Cruz heads to her hometown for a comeback. Enter Polly, her fan-turned-frenemy. Can Lana dodge drama and reclaim her fame?

movie:tt36472392.name: Chatha Pacha
movie:tt36472392.description: Misfits in Fort Kochi unite to create a wrestling group, facing internal rivalries and funny fights as they grow to tackle greater obstacles

movie:tt37996139.name: Rebel Royals: An Unlikely Love Story
movie:tt37996139.description: This exclusive documentary goes behind the scenes with Märtha Louise and Shaman Durek Verrett in the lead-up to their divisive wedding in Norway.

movie:tt35929110.name: Meet, Greet & Bye
movie:tt35929110.description: A mother, who loves watching K-dramas, decides to stop her chemo treatment after losing hope of getting better. Her only dream before dying is to meet her ultimate K-drama idol, who is visiting Manila for a series of events. Her four children agree to work together with the condition that once their mother meets their idol, she will undergo therapy before her time runs out.

movie:tt35948720.name: Another You
movie:tt35948720.description: Mümtaz and Derya are condemned to live out their last moments each day in someone else's skin.

movie:tt37443891.name: Raat Akeli Hai: The Bansal Murders
movie:tt37443891.description: After the Bansal family is found murdered, Inspector Jatil Yadav discovers a web of greed, betrayal and secrets leading to a lethal conspiracy.

movie:tt38884553.name: I Wish You Had Told Me
movie:tt38884553.description: When a young missionary uncovers his late father's long-held secret, he travels from the Philippines to Spain in search of his dad's forbidden love.

movie:tt39578551.name: BTS: The Return
movie:tt39578551.description: Follows BTS as they reunite in Los Angeles after completing military service, confronting how to begin again, honor their past, and move forward together as they return to making music.

movie:tt29247040.name: Baramulla
movie:tt29247040.description: A police officer investigating missing children cases discovers disturbing truths while supernatural occurrences threaten his family and Baramulla's tranquility.

movie:tt26229612.name: The Diplomat
movie:tt26229612.description: Follows an Indian diplomat who tries to repatriate an Indian girl from Pakistan, where she was presumably forced and deceived into marrying against her will.

movie:tt36153259.name: Meet the Pickles: The Making of "Win or Lose"
movie:tt36153259.description: Discover how Pixar brought its first long-form original series to life. This behind-the-scenes documentary introduces the scrappy filmmaking team that drew from personal experiences to create this ambitious and stylistically unique series that follows a middle-school softball team, the Pickles, in the week leading up to the big championship game.

movie:tt35652650.name: Kontrabida Academy
movie:tt35652650.description: When a mysterious TV transports her to a school for on-screen villains, a restaurant worker finds new purpose - and a way to get back at her enemies.

movie:tt19896510.name: K-Pops!
movie:tt19896510.description: A washed-up musician travels to Korea to write for K-pop stars, discovering that his long-lost son is set to front one of the country’s hottest new groups. He then jumps at the opportunity to capitalize on his son’s stardom for his own renaissance, but learns that fatherhood is much more fulfilling and meaningful than stardom.

movie:tt33319697.name: Detective Ujjwalan
movie:tt33319697.description: In the village of Plaachikkaavu, a local detective, Ujjwalan, must outsmart a mysterious figure in a deadly battle of wits, where his skills are put to the ultimate test.

movie:tt31806052.name: Barbara
movie:tt31806052.description: Meet Barbara, who takes the name Shirin David as a rapper and becomes one of the most successful German-speaking artists. Shows her struggles with perfectionism, business, and identity.

movie:tt35931046.name: Bono: Stories of Surrender
movie:tt35931046.description: Through words, music, and mischief, Bono pulls back the curtain on his deeply personal experiences that have shaped him as a son, father, husband, activist, and U2 frontman.

movie:tt38965502.name: Tom Segura: Teacher
movie:tt38965502.description: Parenting fails. Blackout bar stories. Career regrets. Tom Segura explores the darkly funny side of life's most unpredictable lessons.

movie:tt39075309.name: KPop Demon Hunters: Fireplace
movie:tt39075309.description: Watch Gwi-Ma's flames rise and fall as a golden soundtrack burns bright. When darkness meets the light, this is what it sounds like.

movie:tt38672425.name: Greater Kalesh
movie:tt38672425.description: Twinkle returns home for a surprise Diwali trip, but secrets and disagreements test her family's bonds in ways she never imagined.

movie:tt15097358.name: Bison: Kaalamaadan
movie:tt15097358.description: A young man fights to overcome violence plaguing his village and succeed as a professional kabaddi player.

movie:tt34375730.name: On Your Lap
movie:tt34375730.description: Sartika, a pregnant young woman, moves away from her city hoping to provide a better future for her child. She meets Maya, a coffee shop owner in Pantura. Maya takes care of Sartika and helps with her deliveries. After Sartika gives birth, Maya manipulates her into working for her as the "Kopi Pangku" waitress, a job that requires her to serve coffee on a man's lap, until one day she meets a fish distributor truck driver named Hadi and falls in love. Will she find happiness?

movie:tt32598081.name: Off Track 2
movie:tt32598081.description: Siblings Lisa and Daniel gear up for the Vätternrundan cycling race, where unexpected detours, old flames and marriage problems test their resolve.

movie:tt38347318.name: Matt McCusker: A Humble Offering
movie:tt38347318.description: From wife logic to locker-room shame, Matt McCusker offers witty takes on manhood, marriage and raising daughters in a world he barely understands.

movie:tt39901552.name: Jeff Ross: Take a Banana for the Ride
movie:tt39901552.description: Making his Broadway debut, legendary comic Jeff Ross turns the spotlight on himself in a one-man show that is as heartfelt as it is hilarious.

movie:tt29383300.name: An Honest Life
movie:tt29383300.description: Simon's law school dreams fade as he meets Max during a protest. Her anarchist lifestyle of excess and deception entraps him before he can recognize the destructive path he is on.

movie:tt38865049.name: Warkop DKI: ViRaLiN dOoOoNg..!!
movie:tt38865049.description: Three best friends, Dono, Kasino, and Indro, want to get quickly rich by becoming content creators. After numerous failed attempts, they try making a horror-drama video in a remote village. However, their fake plan turns into reality when they are actually haunted by vengeful spirits. To survive, they must uncover the spirits' tragic pasts and help them get justice. Although their horror project fails, their hilarious failed videos make them viral and famous.

movie:tt36895760.name: ConMom
movie:tt36895760.description: After separating from an abusive husband, a former theater actress resorts to using disguises in a desperate attempt to spend time with her only child.

movie:tt38123566.name: With Love
movie:tt38123566.description: Sathya reluctantly agrees to a blind date arranged by his sister and meets Monisha. They discover they attended the same school years ago. Bonding over shared memories and old crushes, they reconnect with their past and grow closer.

movie:tt37893389.name: Bāhubali: The Epic
movie:tt37893389.description: When a mysterious child is found by a tribal couple near a roaring waterfall, they raise him as their own. As he grows, Sivudu is drawn to the world beyond the cliffs, where he discovers the ancient kingdom of Mahishmati, ruled by a cruel tyrant, haunted by rebellion, and bound to his past. What begins as a quest for love soon unravels a legacy of betrayal, sacrifice, and a forgotten prince.

movie:tt36187149.name: Masthishka Maranam
movie:tt36187149.description: Plunging into a virtual reminiscence challenge to assuage his sorrow, a heartbroken dad uncovers a shocking revelation about Frida Soman, his long-admired icon and globally beloved luminary.

movie:tt26424928.name: Sly Lives! (aka the Burden of Black Genius)
movie:tt26424928.description: It focuses on the life and legacy of Sly and the Family Stone, telling the story behind the rise, reign and fadeout of one of pop music's most influential artists.

movie:tt10370856.name: They Fight
movie:tt10370856.description: Reformed ex-convict Walt Manigan returns home to rebuild his family with the love of his life, Ketta. His path leads him to a boxing gym inside a D.C. youth recreation center about to be closed. There, he works under the wise coach Slim to mentor a group of boys to train for the junior national boxing tournament, all leading to a showdown between best friends Quincey and Peanut as they battle for a spot on the U.S. Junior Olympic Team.

movie:tt38772625.name: Gerry Dee: Funny You Should Say That
movie:tt38772625.description: With dry wit, Canadian comic Gerry Dee explores his perilous years as a schoolteacher, the pitfalls of open marriages and the truth about Santa.

movie:tt30835190.name: Songs from the Hole
movie:tt30835190.description: Sentenced to life in prison at 15, musician JJ'88 finds hope by writing songs during solitary confinement in this award-winning documentary visual album.

movie:tt36409255.name: Only We Know
movie:tt36409255.description: When a retired professor and a widowed engineer in his '40s bond after a chance meeting, their conversations on life and love turn into something more.

movie:tt37812919.name: Nenante Nene
movie:tt37812919.description: 1968 Indian film starring Sriranjani, Krishna Ghattamaneni and Kanchana

movie:tt37433245.name: Dusty Slay: Wet Heat
movie:tt37433245.description: Known for his laid-back Southern charm and razor-sharp wit, Slay is back following his successful 2024 debut Workin’ Man. If you love storytelling with a hilarious twist and a splash of retro flair, this one’s a must-watch.

movie:tt34498610.name: Toaster
movie:tt34498610.description: Murder and chaos erupt when a miser becomes obsessed with a toaster he gave as a wedding gift.

movie:tt27931052.name: Pangolin: Kulu's Journey

movie:tt35510818.name: Rosebud Baker: The Mother Lode

movie:tt37458102.description: A Brazilian street dancer training for a major contest dives deep into a culture that's given a voice to countless dancers.

movie:tt41559856.name: Yiya Murano: Death at Tea Time
movie:tt41559856.description: Yiya Murano poisoned her friends to cover up scams in 1970s Argentina and became a dark figure in popular culture. Freed in the 1990s, she reappeared as a pop icon. Today, her son Martín seeks to reveal her true face.

movie:tt35669032.name: Same Day with Someone
movie:tt35669032.description: Trapped in a time loop, a picture-perfect museum curator relives her worst day ever and must figure out how to break free from the vicious cycle.

movie:tt38779530.name: Manila's Finest

movie:tt38043121.description: After a lifelong dream of playing in the NBA is dashed, and on the brink of their athletic prime, three athletes discover unexpected growth and success as international ballers when they decide to play overseas. Immersing themselves in foreign cultures while discovering the intense and exhilarating global fandom for basketball, these athletes turn an unwanted detour into a transformative and fulfilling chapter in the pursuit of their dreams.

movie:tt39578533.name: BTS the Comeback Live: Arirang
movie:tt39578533.description: Follows BTS as they perform live from Seoul in celebration of their fifth studio album Arirang, marking their first global livestream event from Korea.

movie:tt35669044.name: Tee Yai: Born to Be Bad

movie:tt13451410.name: Untitled
movie:tt13451410.description: The plot is currently under wraps.

movie:tt31107212.name: Promised Hearts

movie:tt28334938.name: Clika
movie:tt28334938.description: Aspiring small-town musician Chito is determined to make it big. When a clip of him performing one of his songs goes viral, he seizes the opportunity and pushes to carve out a place for himself in the new wave of Mexican-American music... and ultimately gets caught in a game more dangerous than anticipated.

movie:tt35668447.name: Lost in the Spotlight

movie:tt29429860.name: Son of Sardaar 2
movie:tt29429860.description: After his wife asks for a divorce, Jassi joins a dance troupe and helps a musician's daughter get married by posing as her war-hero father.

movie:tt35924806.name: Bert Kreischer: Lucky
movie:tt35924806.description: Comedian Bert Kreischer's fourth Netflix special covers his weight loss journey, family stories, and advice from Snoop Dogg, while reflecting on his lucky life experiences.

movie:tt10727696.name: Semi-Soeter
movie:tt10727696.description: Power couple Jaci and JP find themselves in a bumpy predicament when a new work pitch for a baby brand forces them to play the perfect pretend parents.

movie:tt43616650.name: Jeff Arcuri: Nice to Meet You

movie:tt31712434.name: Sikandar
movie:tt31712434.description: A tragic accident pushes the powerful Sikandar to protect the less fortunate by standing up to corruption and greed - using any means necessary.

movie:tt42839367.name: Snoopy Presents: There's No Place Like Home, Snoopy
movie:tt42839367.description: When Snoopy's beloved doghouse goes missing, he tries to track it down, and learns what makes a house feel like home.

movie:tt35820235.name: Chelsea Handler: The Feeling
movie:tt35820235.description: From ruining Thanksgiving to a wild summer fling, Chelsea Handler recounts coming of age, unexpected encounters and that time she met Bill Cosby.

movie:tt41269788.name: Wanda Sykes: Legacy
movie:tt41269788.description: Wanda Sykes returns to her alma mater with a fearlessly funny takedown of everything from the state of the world to the cultural clash over washcloths.

movie:tt39064608.name: The Last Shot
movie:tt39064608.description: Petch wants out of the assassin's life, but escaping the past isn't easy. Torn between love, loyalty, and revenge, he's forced into one last job. With every shot, the stakes rise—his future and freedom rest on the final bullet.

movie:tt38039379.name: Stay
movie:tt38039379.description: A couple near the end of their marriage begin to encounter supernatural forces that cause them to fight for their lives.

movie:tt26849593.name: Cheer to Life
movie:tt26849593.description: Jéssica is a simple young woman, dedicated to her job at an antique shop in Rio de Janeiro, but she feels her life lacks purpose. Everything changes when she finds a mysterious locket identical to an item she inherited from her late mother. Driven by the desire to understand the connection between the locket and her family history, Jéssica teams up with Gabriel, a distant relative who appears unexpectedly.

movie:tt32161542.name: Mrithyunjay
movie:tt32161542.description: An intense murder investigation unfolds when a man refuses to accept a death casually deemed natural by the police. As he digs deeper, what begins as doubt turns into a relentless pursuit of truth, uncovering layers of deception and danger

movie:tt35713900.name: Gates of Heaven
movie:tt35713900.description: Latifah's happy family life is tested when her husband passes away, leaving her to care for their child with ADHD and manage his educational foundation. Her former lover, Arman, helps with the foundation, bringing them closer until he proposes. Now, Latifah must decide whether she can accept becoming a second wife.

movie:tt43698006.name: Kelsey Cook: Happy Hour
movie:tt43698006.description: In this candid and clever stand-up special, Kelsey Cook explores "hangxiety," relives a plane bathroom nightmare and breaks down dating a literal Chad.

movie:tt44657701.name: HB2Me
movie:tt44657701.description: When a son attempts to out-prank his father on his birthday, the plan falls out of control as his father is kidnapped and held for ransom.

movie:tt35307143.name: The Stringer: The Man Who Took the Photo
movie:tt35307143.description: A two-year investigation uncovers a scandal behind the making of one of the most recognized photographs of the 20th century. Five decades of secrets are unraveled in the search for justice for a man known only as  "the stringer."

movie:tt35076553.name: Inspector Zende
movie:tt35076553.description: After escaping prison, serial killer Carl Bhojraj returns to Mumbai, where Inspector Zende pursues him to capture the elusive criminal again.

movie:tt38938597.name: The Fakenapping
movie:tt38938597.description: Failed entrepreneur and struggling dad Sattam finds himself tangled in a madcap scheme when he decides to repay his debts — by kidnapping his own father.

movie:tt33092501.name: My Love Will Make You Disappear
movie:tt33092501.description: A woman who believes she's cursed meets a troubled landlord while fighting community displacement. As they grow closer, her fear that all her lovers disappear threatens their connection.

movie:tt42192201.name: Bride of the Year
movie:tt42192201.description: When Lienkie's dream of budding a family of her own come crashing down, she hatches a devious plan to win "Bride of the Year" and get back at her ex.

movie:tt42898884.name: WHO
movie:tt42898884.description: In a high-stakes world where time is scarce and every choice matters, diverse characters face a merciless system where one wrong move means death. Amid intense pressure, they confront moral quandaries and seek truth while testing limits.

movie:tt32282525.name: Faith in the Impossible
movie:tt32282525.description: American pastor Renee Murdoch, who lives in Rio de Janeiro, was tragically attacked during a run in September 2012. Hospitalized in a critical condition and with minimal prospects of recovery, she received the full support of her family and her husband Philip, who shared Renee's struggle with the world, hoping to bring together as many people as possible in prayer for her recovery.

movie:tt39196792.name: This Is I
movie:tt39196792.description: Bullied for wanting to be an idol, Kenji finds belonging in a cabaret and help from a trailblazing doctor, emerging onstage as her true self, Ai Haruna.

movie:tt36009904.name: Alie's Home
movie:tt36009904.description: Alie, the youngest and only daughter among five siblings, suffers relentless abuse from her father and siblings—blamed for their mother's death—when all she longs for is a bit of compassion and acceptance from her family.

movie:tt36593616.name: Organ Child
movie:tt36593616.description: A series of tragic events unfolds after Chang Chi-Mao's daughter goes missing as an infant. Chang becomes consumed by revenge against a powerful criminal organization suspected of kidnapping her. Along the way, he clings to the hope that his daughter may still be alive, determined to rescue her and break free from their dark fate.

movie:tt34830387.name: Scarecrow
movie:tt34830387.description: As a family clashes over their late father's land, an eerie painting appears and releases something sinister during the nine-day funeral ritual.

movie:tt33098576.name: Room to Move
movie:tt33098576.description: Choreographer and performer Jenn Freeman has always possessed the gift of movement. From a very early age, she simply had to dance… all the time. But with that ever-present need to jump, leap, shake and squirm came a struggle to exist harmoniously in a world that seemed to assault her senses and sense of equilibrium at every turn.

movie:tt37536961.name: Badak
movie:tt37536961.description: A deaf single dad's life with his daughter changes when she becomes a hip-hop star. Meanwhile, another father faces ongoing challenges communicating with his deaf son.

movie:tt33888131.name: Aap Jaisa Koi
movie:tt33888131.description: Lives of two unique individuals, Shrirenu Tripathi and Madhu Bose. Embark on a journey full of unexpected twists, heartfelt moments and plenty of fun.

movie:tt32730754.name: Chasing the Wind
movie:tt32730754.description: A focused city worker and a laid-back surfer - both heirs to the same company - find they have plenty in common when they join forces in the boardroom.

movie:tt37455270.name: Squid Game in Conversation
movie:tt37455270.description: Take a seat with the director and cast of Squid Game. Discover key moments, hear untold stories and see what this entire journey meant to them.

movie:tt34749630.name: The Most Beautiful Girl in the World

movie:tt22001978.description: When his fiancée's dream leads to an accident on his wedding day, Aby wakes up from a coma to find himself torn between the past and present.

movie:tt41592024.name: Trevor Noah: Joy in the Trenches
movie:tt41592024.description: From unexpected social media beef to a therapist's truth bomb, Trevor Noah turns chaos into comedy in this hilariously sharp, playful stand-up set.

movie:tt27922706.name: Chhaava
movie:tt27922706.description: After the death of his father, warrior-king Sambhaji Maharaj battles Mughal forces led by Aurangzeb to keep the Maratha Empire alive.

movie:tt35933611.name: Lovesick
movie:tt35933611.description: A love story that starts with pretending to be sick, describing a troubled teenager named Ye Zijie who always loves to get into trouble. By chance, he discovered that "it's good to be sick".

movie:tt32370381.name: Martabat: Misi Berdarah
movie:tt32370381.description: A quirky group of extras determined to do anything to become famous actors or getting a bigger role in Malaysia.

movie:tt43088166.name: Kylie - Tension Tour Live

movie:tt35668659.name: Vir Das: Fool Volume
movie:tt35668659.description: Whether it's the police, the evil eye or a badly timed lost voice, comedian Vir Das explores how embracing foolishness has led him to shared happiness.

movie:tt33112363.name: The Last Goodbye
movie:tt33112363.description: It takes us back to the early 2000s, where handwritten letters held unspoken emotions, and love was both beautiful and fleeting. It follows the story of two souls drawn together by pain, healed by love, yet tested by fate.

movie:tt35265182.name: Qifarah
movie:tt35265182.description: An estranged son returns from abroad to care for his dying father, only to uncover dark, sinister secrets about his family that span both his past and present.

movie:tt34253990.name: Sebastian Maniscalco: It Ain't Right

movie:tt38779509.name: Rekonek

movie:tt37937880.name: Kill Tony: Mayhem at Madison Square Garden
movie:tt37937880.description: With one minute to impress Tony Hinchcliffe and his star-studded panel, newbie stand-ups risk it all on the hallowed ground of Madison Square Garden.

movie:tt32206574.name: And the Breadwinner Is...
movie:tt32206574.description: When Bambi discovers that her family has squandered their savings, they devise a plan to cover their debts — but first, she must fake her death.

movie:tt38674977.description: After her boyfriend's betrayal leaves her alone in Seoul, Shenba faces isolation and cultural differences. Through personal growth and new friendships, she finds strength and lasting connections.

movie:tt23724242.name: Last Take: Rust and the Story of Halyna
movie:tt23724242.description: A personal look at the life, work and untimely death of celebrated indie cinematographer Halyna Hutchins, who was shot and killed in a tragic accident on the set of the film Rust in 2021.

movie:tt37727295.name: Planet Single: Greek Adventure
movie:tt37727295.description: A Greek getaway for five friends turns into a hilarious detective story when suspicions rise around one of their partners — who may be a famous con-man.

movie:tt39115217.description: From the immersive opening shot to the emotional final line, go behind the scenes with director Noah Baumbach, George Clooney, Adam Sandler and more.

movie:tt35453979.name: The Best Mother in the World
movie:tt35453979.description: To escape her abusive husband, garbage collector Gal packs her two young children, Rihanna and Benin, onto the top of her cart and heads across São Paulo to her cousin’s house. As she struggles to avoid the dangers of the streets along the way, she convinces the children that they are on a big and exciting adventure. When they arrive at her cousin’s house, they are warmly welcomed and fed. However, what initially seems like a safe haven soon turns out to be a trap. Gal realises that not only her own safety is at risk, but also the future of her children.

movie:tt35699057.name: Jessica Kirson: I'm the Man
movie:tt35699057.description: Jessica Kirson shares her searing perspective on everything from TikTok girls to her bizarre time at a trauma center.

movie:tt37751253.name: Diary of A Wimpy Kid: The Last Straw
movie:tt37751253.description: Greg must impress Holly Hills at an upcoming talent show. His father, Frank, plans to send him to military school. The central issue is Greg's effort to prove to Frank that he does not need military schooling by participating in t...

movie:tt37539162.name: Call Me Mother
movie:tt37539162.description: Twinkle is a single queer mother whose dream of officially adopting her son gets shaken when the boy's biological mother, Mara, unexpectedly reappears.

movie:tt38061951.name: Leanne Morgan: Unspeakable Things

movie:tt36933778.description: Sheng Wang shares his thoughts on edible bras, braving the ghosts in your house and guarding expensive berries from your friends' kids.

movie:tt32245870.name: Happy Patel: Khatarnak Jasoos
movie:tt32245870.description: Chronically unsuccessful MI7 operative Happy Patel is finally assigned a mission in Goa, where he uncovers his Indian roots and must rescue a high-profile scientist from crime lord Mama. Unaware of his Indian heritage and armed with a comically British accent, Happy’s blunders trigger a string of chaotic mishaps that could lead him to expose a criminal network.

Although he wishes to end his mission, Inspector Nazri urges him to continue in order to combat crime. Conflict arises when Bos, the leader of Harimau Merah, is murdered by his brother, AhB, who aspires to become the new leader. Hakin investigates AhB's operations, including the brutal murder of Uncle Hazim and the smuggling of drugs using foreign migrants.

movie:tt33505728.name: Soul's Peak
movie:tt33505728.description: In Pernambuco, a jewel robbery brings together an old group of misfits, with catastrophic results. Watched over by ghosts from the past, each of them will have to find their own way to freedom.

movie:tt13968662.name: A Magnificent Life
movie:tt13968662.description: In 1955, 60-year-old Marcel Pagnol is a well-known and acclaimed playwright and filmmaker. When the editor-in-chief of ELLE magazine commissions a weekly column about Pagnol's childhood, he sees this as a great opportunity to go back to his artistic roots: writing. Realizing his memory is failing him and deeply affected by the disappointing results of his last two plays, Pagnol starts doubting his ability to pursue his work. That is until Little Marcel - the young boy he used to be - appears to him as if by magic. Together, they will explore Marcel Pagnol's incredible life and bring back to life his most cherished encounters and memories...

movie:tt33319618.name: Atsuko Okatsuka: Father
movie:tt33319618.description: Fans call her 'Mother,' but Atsuko is 'Father'—thriving professionally yet clueless about basics. A 7-year laundry hiatus and learning that marriage licenses precede weddings are just some hilariously relatable discoveries she shares in her special.

movie:tt37895011.name: Rao Bahadur
movie:tt37895011.description: Plagued by guilt and fear, an eccentric aristocrat retreats into his ancestral manor, creating an alternate world that deeply blurs reality and imagination.

movie:tt38994128.name: Robby Hoffman: Wake Up
movie:tt38994128.description: Breakout star Robby Hoffman hilariously pushes the limits of comedy with red-hot, controversial takes in her debut special.

movie:tt30406302.name: Perusu
movie:tt30406302.description: After discovering their father dead, two estranged brothers are shocked to find something inside him is still alive. What should have been a day of somber mourning breaks Into a complete bedlam as the two sons try to conduct the funeral as discreetly as possible. Forced to navigate nosy relatives, hidden family secrets, and their own strained relationship with their father, the brothers must hold it all together—or risk letting everything unravel.

movie:tt38263655.name: 2025 Rock & Roll Hall of Fame Induction Ceremony
movie:tt38263655.description: On Saturday, November 8, 2025, rock royalty once again gathered to celebrate the induction of another class of performers, influencers and excellent musicians into the Hallowed Hall of Rock. The 2025 Rock & Roll Hall of Fame inductees were Bad Company, Chubby Checker, Joe Cocker, Cyndi Lauper, Outkast, Soundgarden and The White Stripes in the Performer category.

movie:tt34965967.name: Deaf President Now!
movie:tt34965967.description: Discover the story of the greatest civil rights movement most people have never heard about. During eight tumultuous days in 1988 at the world's only Deaf university, four students must find a way to lead a revolution—and change the course of history.

movie:tt33996602.name: The 4 Rascals

movie:tt38681815.name: It Takes a Village
movie:tt38681815.description: When financial trouble forces Halina to call off her wedding, her friends and family decide to hatch a wild plan to bring in tourist money.

movie:tt37543466.name: Katie Taylor vs. Amanda Serrano 3: Weigh-In

movie:tt40145204.name: Mark Normand: None Too Pleased
movie:tt40145204.description: Mark Normand turns married life, fatherhood and hot-button topics into rapid-fire punchlines in this witty free-for-all where nothing is off limits.

The company where he works is bought by an office that decides to keep only women in its positions. However, the character is not fired, since, due to her name, the HR department believes that she is a woman. The character then starts dressing in women's clothing to stay in his job.

movie:tt35295730.name: A Business Proposal
movie:tt35295730.description: Short on cash, food analyst Sari makes a deal to go on a blind date, only to realize she's been set up with Utama, her hateable but handsome boss.

movie:tt36398562.name: Jaras Enzar 2

He's averse to innovation and averse to taking risks, and his shop is struggling. The recent opening of a new-generation restaurant, Pidburger, only makes things worse. However, with the arrival of Öcü, a transformation begins, and they embark on numerous adventures to save the shop.

movie:tt38687274.description: Lisa Ann Walter's long-awaited debut comedy special takes on feral Gen-Xers, self-loathing, and navigating a backsliding America, via the no-filter lens of a grown-ass woman who has been paying attention.

movie:tt35713227.name: Groom & Two Brides

movie:tt36985837.name: Frozen: The Hit Broadway Musical
