movie:tt39631179.description: When a celebrated queer doctor in London is accused of sexual misconduct, her life unravels.

movie:tt36616410.name: Eko
movie:tt36616410.description: In misty Kaattukunnu hills, an elderly woman and her caretaker confront past memories while a hunted dog breeder named Kuriyachan eludes capture. As searchers arrive, buried secrets emerge.

movie:tt37546146.name: Squid Game: Making Season 2
movie:tt37546146.description: From set designs to character arcs, get exclusive cast and director interviews on how Season 2 of the globally most-watched series was brought to life.

movie:tt30790710.name: Bleeding Tiger: Conflict Begins
movie:tt30790710.description: Hakin, a police officer goes undercover and infiltrates the Red Tiger gang and manages to gain the gang's trust. Hakin not only succeeds in uncovering their crimes but also has to face the brutal criminals. However, he is betrayed, plagued by moral dilemmas and his loyalty is tested as he fights to uphold justice without his identity being known.

movie:tt36593484.name: BAKA's Identity
movie:tt36593484.description: To get by, Takuya and Mamoru pose as women in an online scheme, but when they try to leave this life, they must rely on their dangerous mentor for help.

movie:tt32362494.name: Flat Girls
movie:tt32362494.description: As Jane prepares to leave a police flat where she was born and raised, she starts to reflect on old memories including a painful story of love and intimacy lost between a handsome young policeman and Ann, the ambitious older girl Jane once secretly loved.

movie:tt43587135.name: Bukayo Saka: The Time Is Now
movie:tt43587135.description: Two generations of Arsenal greats are brought together as Bukayo Saka joins club legend Thierry Henry for an unguarded look at what it takes to perform at the highest level. Saka and Henry reflect on pressure, resilience, and the joy that first drew them to the game, with the conversation taking them back to Saka’s childhood home in Ealing where it all began.

movie:tt37931873.name: Gintama the Movie 2026: Yoshiwara in Flames
movie:tt37931873.description: Upon meeting a young boy named Seita who makes a living as a pickpocket, Gintoki discovers that he is pickpocketing out of a desire to meet his long-lost mother, Hinowa, Yoshiwara's number one courtesan. Gintoki and his friends venture to Yoshiwara to fulfill Seita's wish, but standing in their way is Housen, the Night King who rules Yoshiwara.

movie:tt36242582.name: Meet the Khumalos
movie:tt36242582.description: Two moms — once best friends, now arch-enemies — start a neighborhood war against each other when they find out their kids are head-over-heels in love.

movie:tt42456008.name: Poldi
movie:tt42456008.description: Footballer, entrepreneur, fan favorite and true community hero — Lukas Podolski reflects on his journey and what comes next in this intimate documentary.

movie:tt35628532.name: Air Force Elite: Thunderbirds
movie:tt35628532.description: The inside look at the U.S. Air Force's Thunderbirds flight squadron.

movie:tt45819060.name: Mojo Brookzz: I Know You Lying
movie:tt45819060.description: Scene-stealer Mojo Brookzz unloads on freaky partners, wild BBL culture and his niece's big coming-out present in his debut Netflix special.

movie:tt34967734.name: Liza Treyger: Night Owl
movie:tt34967734.description: Treyger's stand-up explores the struggles of new parenthood, venting frustrations about others' spouses, and self-deceptions around substance use.

movie:tt34981200.name: Gabriel Iglesias: Legend of Fluffy
movie:tt34981200.description: From breaking stereotypes to home break-ins, Gabriel Iglesias brings comedy to life's unexpected twists in this stand-up special.

movie:tt33108207.name: In Waves and War
movie:tt33108207.description: Three Navy SEALs leave their tours of duty in Iraq and Afghanistan with treatment-resistant, unrelenting psychological pain. They find themselves at the cutting edge of a different frontline: a lifesaving psychedelic therapy that brings healing to a community in urgent need.

movie:tt37472747.name: Deive Leonardo - Antes & Depois
movie:tt37472747.description: Documentary with host Deive Leonardo reflecting on God’s power to change lives.

movie:tt37748279.name: LEGO Disney Princess: Villains Unite
movie:tt37748279.description: After Ariel, Moana, Tiana, Rapunzel, and Snow White thwarted Gaston's plan to take over all of their kingdoms, he calls upon Ursula, Jafar, and the Evil Queen to help take the Princesses down once and for all. The Princesses learn about Gaston's scheme and recruit a few friends of their own with the help of Magic Mirror: Aurora, Belle, and Cinderella! Together, the Princesses team up for an ultimate showdown of good versus evil.

movie:tt39751309.name: 18th Rose
movie:tt39751309.description: A spirited teen dreaming of the perfect debut makes a deal with a lonely newcomer, but unexpected feelings and revelations may shatter their plans.

movie:tt34963797.name: Selena y Los Dinos: A Family's Legacy
movie:tt34963797.description: Never-before-seen footage and intimate interviews celebrate the life and legacy of iconic Mexican American singer Selena Quintanilla and her family band.

movie:tt51201053.name: Darius Rucker: They Called Me Hootie
movie:tt51201053.description: Darius Rucker gets deeply personal about the cost of stardom, revealing his struggles with drugs and alcohol, the breakdown of his marriage and brushes with death. Through candid interviews with collaborators, friends and family, new footage from the road and in the studio as he records his forthcoming album and never-before-seen tape dating back to the start of Hootie & the Blowfish, this documentary traces the full journey of his extraordinary career, revealing a deeply personal story of ambition, resilience and reinvention.

movie:tt33998357.name: Jackhammer
movie:tt33998357.description: A shy struggling actor is dragged into the world of professional male stripping by his egotistical brother.

movie:tt43689138.name: LEGO Disney Princess: Magical Mayhem
movie:tt43689138.description: During a heavy rainstorm, the Princess characters and their sidekick friends take in animals in need while enjoying a cozy day in their castle. But when the animals run amok, chaos erupts. Sleuthing reveals a mischievous villain behind it all, and with teamwork, quick thinking, and help from an unexpected friend, the Princess characters must restore order and save their home.

movie:tt31408343.name: Masameer Junior
movie:tt31408343.description: After a dire lesson on bad behavior, three unruly six-year-olds embark on a chaotic quest for the ultimate "good deed" — unleashing mayhem at every turn.

movie:tt41973417.name: KillTonyMania
movie:tt41973417.description: Kill Tony tag teams with WrestleMania 42, as Tony Hinchcliffe, WWE icons and comedy heavyweights put upstart stand-ups to the test in Las Vegas.

movie:tt41300402.name: AFI Life Achievement Award: A Tribute to Eddie Murphy
movie:tt41300402.description: Comedy trailblazer Eddie Murphy celebrates his legendary film career in this star-studded tribute filmed live in Los Angeles.

movie:tt39089423.name: The First Snow of Fraggle Rock
movie:tt39089423.description: Follows the Fraggles as they eagerly await the first snow of the season. When only a single snowflake arrives and Gobo can't write the yearly holiday song everyone is expecting, the season is thrown off course.

movie:tt36421934.name: Ralph Barbosa: Planet Bosa
movie:tt36421934.description: Ralph Barbosa shares his adventures in dating, controlling his temper, working on cars, and his views on current events.

movie:tt43961446.name: 9/11: United We Stand -- 25 Years Later
movie:tt43961446.description: Explore how sports, music, Broadway and comedy helped Americans rediscover joy and begin to heal in the wake of the 9/11 attacks.

movie:tt40205709.name: Derrick Stroup: Nostalgic
movie:tt40205709.description: Stroup dives into his experience being a '90s kid in rural Alabama and everything that came along with it.

movie:tt42063852.name: Beyond the Game: Samurai 2026 WORLD BASEBALL CLASSIC
movie:tt42063852.description: The pressure of glory. A shocking loss.​ Raw locker room talk. Go behind the scenes into their reality as Samurai​ Japan's camera keeps rolling.

movie:tt33083471.name: Funky
movie:tt33083471.description: A debut director who falls in love with his producer's daughter

movie:tt38348802.name: Who Killed the Montreal Expos?
movie:tt38348802.description: An investigation into the downfall of the Montreal Expos, Canada's first Major League Baseball team — and who was ultimately responsible.

movie:tt43701966.name: Rory Scovel: Show Must Go On
movie:tt43701966.description: With a hypothetical home invasion, a biblical reenactment, and his late dad's final wish, Rory Scovel delivers unrelenting laughs in this raucous stand-up special filmed at The Neptune in Seattle, Washington.

movie:tt43475091.name: Daddy's in Trouble
movie:tt43475091.description: Roberta is tired of taking care of the house and the kids all by herself, so she decides to take a vacation, leaving her husband to look after the children. The result is that the house is turned upside down as Fred tries to balance family demands with his work responsibilities. Amid laughter and chaos, the film shows how a family can overcome challenges when they stick together.

movie:tt36150950.name: The Dad Quest
movie:tt36150950.description: When a father-son duo learns that they might not be related biologically, they embark on a wild adventure through Mexico to find the truth.

movie:tt39458763.name: Deaw Still Alive
movie:tt39458763.description: Comedian Udom Taephanich shares candid stories from his chaotic life, from superstition and dark rituals to his time in Korea.

movie:tt36988583.name: Snoopy Presents: A Summer Musical
movie:tt36988583.description: Music and glee fill the air as Charlie Brown and the gang head off to summer camp. First-timer Sally doesn't get what all the hype is about. But when the camp may be forced to close, they team up to save it so more kids can make their own special memories.

movie:tt40660080.name: Son-in-Law
movie:tt40660080.description: José Sánchez has big ambitions, terrible instincts, and a mustache to match. After a string of bad deals, he accidentally bluffs his way into becoming El Serpiente, a political boss feared for all the wrong reasons. Now he must pull off one final deal to stay alive — a deal far beyond anything he can fake.

movie:tt42898211.name: Ryan Hamilton: This Just Hit Me
movie:tt42898211.description: Leave it to Ryan Hamilton to get hit by a bus and have the last laugh — whether it's falling for his anesthesiologist or a dispensary trip with his mom.

movie:tt39479604.name: Katt Williams: The Last Report
movie:tt39479604.description: Katt Williams delivers his famously bold takes on conspiracies, celebrities, and the world at large in this electrifying stand up special.

movie:tt21194868.name: Dhoom Dhaam
movie:tt21194868.description: Veer Poddar and Koyal Chadda are a mismatched couple, who get into an arranged marriage. A case of mistaken identity forces this newly married couple to go on the run on their wedding night and search for the mysterious "Charlie".

movie:tt35668683.name: A Normal Woman
movie:tt35668683.description: Believing she's contracted a mysterious illness, a socialite begins sabotaging her own life in the face of rejection from her own body and her family.

movie:tt35434840.name: Banger
movie:tt35434840.description: When an intelligence agent offers a washed-up DJ the opportunity to take down his young rival, he sees it as a chance to return to the top with a banger.

movie:tt36367119.name: Sea Lions of the Galapagos
movie:tt36367119.description: Follow Leo, a handsome sea lion pup who's learning how to navigate life alongside his mother, Luna.

movie:tt36548443.name: Behind the Curtain: Stranger Things: The First Shadow
movie:tt36548443.description: Go behind the scenes with the cast and crew of “Stranger Things: The First Shadow”, the award-winning live stage show that expands the Hawkins universe.

movie:tt36372021.name: Guardians of the Galapagos
movie:tt36372021.description: Go behind the scenes with the crew of Sea Lions of the Galapagos to showcase not just the production of a film, but the world that inspired it.

movie:tt39045344.name: Beauty and the Beat
movie:tt39045344.description: Imagine the excitement when four rival divas are brought together to perform on the same stage. But remember, when two ride on a horse, one must sit behind. So, how will these four divas share the spotlight without chaos?

movie:tt32982833.name: Roy Wood Jr.: Lonely Flowers
movie:tt32982833.description: In this stand-up special, Roy Wood Jr explores how lack of connection has sent society spiraling into a culture full of guns, rude employees, self-checkout lanes, and why some of us would rather be alone rather than be connected.

movie:tt36473825.name: Sarah Silverman: PostMortem
movie:tt36473825.description: After losing both parents, Sarah Silverman turns grief into comedy, finding humor in funeral planning and final moments with her mother while maintaining her characteristic wit.

movie:tt36711248.name: Gold Rush Gang
movie:tt36711248.description: At the tail end of World War II, a bandit leader and his crew go up against his sworn enemy and the Japanese army to rob a train full of gold.

movie:tt27843798.name: Jewel Thief: The Heist Begins
movie:tt27843798.description: A master thief accepts a mission to steal the legendary African Red Sun diamond. What begins as a meticulously planned heist spirals into a dangerous game of double-crosses and shifting loyalties.

movie:tt39377509.name: The Lotto Winner
movie:tt39377509.description: It follows an ordinary family whose lives are abruptly transformed by extraordinary luck—unraveling how money can both bind people together and quietly pull them apart.

movie:tt33244550.name: Corazón delator
movie:tt33244550.description: מנואל עובר השתלת לב ומרגיש שמשהו באישיות שלו השתנה. כשהוא מתחיל להתעניין בחייו של התורם, הוא פוגש את ואלה האלמנה ואת הקהילה שמקיפה אותה.

movie:tt31828532.name: The Wrong Track
movie:tt31828532.description: A struggling divorced mom must learn to ski and complete a grueling 54km race to stay at her brother's place. As she trains for the impossible challenge, she discovers inner strength she never knew she had.

movie:tt28657879.name: Lucca's World
movie:tt28657879.description: Determined to help her son, who has cerebral palsy, Bárbara takes her family to India for an experimental treatment.

movie:tt37457638.name: Almost Family
movie:tt37457638.description: A Brazilian father finds a worthy opponent when he meets his daughter's Argentine in-laws, and a trip to Bariloche becomes the stage for a fun international rivalry.

movie:tt38221275.name: Rhythm + Flow France: After the Beat
movie:tt38221275.description: Discover the journey of former emblematic participants of the French Novelle Ecole (New School) rap competition show, and the impact of fame as well as their advancement in the world of rap.

movie:tt41559880.name: Emi Martínez: The Kid Who Stops Time
movie:tt41559880.description: Mixing animation and interviews, this film follows Emi Martínez's journey to becoming a legendary goalkeeper, from small-town Argentina to world glory.

movie:tt30422937.name: Nadaaniyan
movie:tt30422937.description: A privileged Delhi socialite hires a middle-class student to pose as her boyfriend to maintain her social status. Their pretense becomes complicated when genuine feelings develop between them.

movie:tt33636006.name: The Red Envelope
movie:tt33636006.description: After a supernatural marriage binds them for life, thief-turned-informant Menn and his ghost husband Titi set out to solve the mystery of Titi's death.

movie:tt23398540.name: Thug Life
movie:tt23398540.description: Gang leader Sakthivel adopts Amaran after saving him during a gang war. Years later, Sakthivel survives an assassination attempt and suspects Amaran's involvement, leading to a conflict of loyalty and revenge.

movie:tt38607240.name: LEGO Frozen: Operation Puffins
movie:tt38607240.description: After the events of Frozen, Anna and Elsa want to start fresh in Arendelle, and make the castle feel a bit more comfortable. While they struggle to break free of the bounds of tradition, the Duke of Weselton has other plans for their beloved home alongside a flock of menacing puffins.

movie:tt36820596.name: Call Me Dad
movie:tt36820596.description: Little Intan was used as collateral for a debt by her mother, who was forced to become a migrant worker and leave her behind. But from that moment, her life took a turn. Dedi, the debt collector — a stranger who initially just came to collect — ended up becoming an important figure in Intan’s life. Together with Tatang, they grew into an unusual kind of “family.”

movie:tt37677952.name: Dr. Seuss's the Sneetches
movie:tt37677952.description: An unexpected friendship forms between two young Sneetches on an island.

movie:tt35804779.name: Welcome, Now Get Lost
movie:tt35804779.description: Facing a whirlwind of emotions, comedians endure relentless insults from angry villagers. Can they turn hostility into laughter?

movie:tt43658408.name: Heartstopper: Ending on a Hi
movie:tt43658408.description: After the ending of the hit Netflix series “Heartstopper”, this special combines never-before-seen behind-the-scenes footage, cast and crew interviews, larger cultural commentary, and fan input.

movie:tt38907962.name: Love and Wine
movie:tt38907962.description: A privileged young man working at his wealthy father's business traps himself in a lie when he falls in love with a hard-working medical student, and tries to convince her that he comes from more humble beginnings like hers. What follows is a comedic whirlwind of chaos and heartfelt revelations.

movie:tt36607196.name: Mikael: Hunter of Two Realms
movie:tt36607196.description: An elite police officer who is also a jinn hunter, facing the threat of creatures from the supernatural while investigating a series of gruesome murders leading to an epic battle against the Jinn King for the sake of balance between the two worlds.

movie:tt39151076.name: Mike Epps: Delusional
movie:tt39151076.description: Follows comedian Mike Epps as he discusses how a little delusion and a lot of hustle made him a star.

movie:tt26319590.name: Revolver Rita
movie:tt26319590.description: A woman must use her intelligence and grit to protect her family after they are unexpectedly caught in the crossfire of gang violence.

movie:tt34673562.name: Carrie Underwood: Reflection
movie:tt34673562.description: A showcase of Underwood's greatest hits from her nearly 20-year career as an award-winning artist, utilizing extravagant production elements like special effects, pyrotechnics, and state-of-the-art visuals and audio technology.

movie:tt39285140.name: Sarah Millican: Late Bloomer
movie:tt39285140.description: When Sarah Millican was a bairn, she wouldn't say boo to a goose. Quiet at school, not many friends, no boobs 'til she was 16. Now? NOW she is loud, with good friends, a cracking rack and goose booing all over the shop. In Sarah's seventh stand-up special, she explores how one became the other. Plus, lots of stuff about dinners and lady gardens.

movie:tt35574419.name: Miss Italy Must Not Die
movie:tt35574419.description: Behind the glitz of Miss Italia, director Patrizia Mirigliani fights to save the iconic pageant, now wavering amid scandals and changing beauty standards.

movie:tt24670146.name: Panji Tengkorak
movie:tt24670146.description: Panji, who sold his soul to black magic to avenge his wife's death, intended to end his life, but found his body now shackled by black magic that controlled his soul. After wandering aimlessly, Panji met an old warrior who asked for his help to chase a bandit who had seized a sacred heirloom that was said to be able to eliminate the power of black magic. Panji accepted the offer that dragged him into a long war between two kingdoms and revealed the reality of his dark past.

movie:tt30868885.name: A Queen’s Runway
movie:tt30868885.description: Behind the crown and beyond the glamour, ambitious hopefuls chase their Miss Universe Philippines dreams, facing fierce competition and great sacrifice.

movie:tt39140092.name: 5 Bomoh
movie:tt39140092.description: When a businessman obsessed with ancestral superstitions forces his science-minded wife and daughter on a nationwide search for a success-granting amulet, the family is repeatedly duped by fraudulent shamans in their desperate bid to secure the girl's overseas education.

movie:tt32322559.name: The Lion King at the Hollywood Bowl
movie:tt32322559.description: Join original film and Broadway stars at the Hollywood Bowl for The Lion King's 30th Anniversary concert. Lebo M, Jeremy Irons, Nathan Lane and more reunite with special guests North West and Jennifer Hudson.

movie:tt35630679.name: Larissa: The Other Side of Anitta
movie:tt35630679.description: Behind global star Anitta is Larissa, known only to her inner circle. Through an old flame's perspective, we see her true self emerge as she navigates personal challenges that reshape her life's direction.

movie:tt36789845.name: Lulu Is a Rhinoceros
movie:tt36789845.description: On a quest to spread kindness, fun-loving Lulu embarks on the adventure of a lifetime, powered by new friends, courage, and catchy songs!

movie:tt39379814.name: Bruce Bruce: I Ain't Playin'
movie:tt39379814.description: Bruce Bruce returns after 14 years with his Netflix debut "I Ain't Playin'" - observing generational chaos and life's craziness through personal stories.

movie:tt37966885.name: Cristela Alonzo: Upper Classy
movie:tt37966885.description: Cristela seeks joy through various experiences - outdoing her old bully, overdoing spa treatments, and taking her first family vacation - while teaching everyone to embrace life's pleasures.

movie:tt38808167.name: My Boo 2
movie:tt38808167.description: Witness the deep bond between Joe and Anong, which has been long-lasting through many lifetimes and reincarnations.

movie:tt38458157.name: Mo Amer: Wild World
movie:tt38458157.description: In this fearlessly honest special, Mo Amer honors his Palestinian roots, recounts confrontations on the road and relives becoming a father.

movie:tt37749083.name: Lasting Moments
movie:tt37749083.description: Aki and Pia are a devoted couple working hard to build a future together. Pia, driven by love and a desire to lift her family from poverty, is offered a prestigious job in Singapore by her boss Carlo—who harbors feelings for her. As Pia’s career flourishes, Aki’s life unravels, leading to addiction and their painful breakup. Five years later, Pia is successful but unfulfilled in a relationship with the controlling Carlo. She returns to the Philippines, rejects his proposal, and seeks out Aki—only to find a man who no longer seems to know her. Faced with regret, Pia must confront the cost of her choices and the love she may have lost forever.

movie:tt37069148.name: Flower Girl
movie:tt37069148.description: After cruelly insulting a trans woman, Ena is struck by a bizarre curse: in the middle of an intimate moment, she discovers her vagina has vanished. She's given a magical flower and a warning — she must find someone who truly loves her, even without it, before the last petal falls.

movie:tt35520292.name: Umjolo: There Is No Cure
movie:tt35520292.description: After losing her title for publicly exposing a scandal, a former pageant queen works on a tell-all book — all while her love life remains unwritten.

movie:tt34961246.name: Umjolo: My Beginning, My End!
movie:tt34961246.description: Caught between her family and her free spirit, Mayi begins to question her upcoming nuptials when she meets a charming and passionate saxophonist.

movie:tt37867075.name: Ufff Yeh Siyapaa
movie:tt37867075.description: Kesari Lal Singh’s wife leaves him, believing he was flirting with the neighbor—he wasn’t. To make matters worse, a drug parcel is mistakenly delivered to his home, leading to chaos when a dead body turns up. As he tries to dispose of it, another body arrives, plunging him deeper into mayhem.

movie:tt34767956.name: Up Next: Silvio Santos
movie:tt34767956.description: This biopic follows Silvio Santos in his 1989 presidential race, as a young journalist joins his campaign to uncover his past and what drives him to run.

movie:tt49317723.name: Hot Wheels Let's Race: Attack of the T-Rex
movie:tt49317723.description: When a giant T-Rex threatens Hot Wheels City, it's up to Coop and his friends to race to the rescue and save the day.

movie:tt32546802.name: The Super Frugal Family
movie:tt32546802.description: A family that used to live extravagantly and in debt. However, everything changed when the father, Tony, lost his job. Forced, Tony and his family had to live frugally to save themselves from bankruptcy.

movie:tt26699197.name: The Academy
movie:tt26699197.description: A young South African woman from the outskirts of Cape Town learns the metaphors of life on the ocean as she prepares to compete in the Round Robben Island race with The Academy, an initiative of the historic Royal Cape Yacht Club.

movie:tt43729889.name: Storm on Sesame Street
movie:tt43729889.description: As a big storm approaches, Elmo and friends work together to get ready. After it passes, Sesame Street looks different — and everyone pitches in to help.

movie:tt45922240.name: Barbie in the Nutcracker
movie:tt45922240.description: Barbie “Brooklyn” Roberts steps into the role of the Sugarplum Princess and Barbie “Malibu” Roberts stars as Clara, as they journey through a musical, magical dreamworld filled with holiday wonder, courage and friendship.

movie:tt37538335.name: LEGO Friends: Heartlake the Musical
movie:tt37538335.description: Young Daisy turns to toy bricks as she finds herself trying to fit into a new school in a new country. When she stumbles across a mysterious key, she is transported to Heartlake City where she makes new friends. But they soon require her help to save a vital local landmark – with plenty of song and dance numbers along the way.

movie:tt41001023.name: Past Is Past
movie:tt41001023.description: In this comedy special, Alex Calleja shares his unflinching observations about his family, personal failures and the oddities of life in the Philippines.

movie:tt31841170.name: Don't Trouble the Trouble
movie:tt31841170.description: Suri, a magician, accidentally makes a young girl vanish with a spell. The girl, revealed to be a genie who grants wishes, explores the city and unleashes her powers when angered.

movie:tt34792531.name: Avaraachan & Sons
movie:tt34792531.description: Follows Avarachan, his children and the various family and social relationships that shape their lives.

movie:tt33068674.name: The Travellers
movie:tt33068674.description: Stephen Seary, a stage designer, returns to Australia to visit his dying mother, but a quick trip descends into family tensions, past conflicts, and romantic complications, jeopardizing his return to Europe and the opera that awaits.

movie:tt35836465.name: Kiff: Lore of the Ring Light

movie:tt37884925.name: Kang Solah from Kang Mak x Nenek Gayung
movie:tt37884925.description: Solah Vicenzio returns to his hometown, accompanied by Fajrul, Jaka, and Supra. Solah imagines his homecoming will be celebrated like that of a hero but instead, he’s mistaken for a ghost. His disappointment deepens when he learns that the girl he’s long had feelings for, Dara Gonzales, is about to marry his own younger brother, Iqbal. However, their wedding is disrupted by terrifying appearances of a ghostly figure—Nenek Gayung, the corpse-washing spirit searching for her next victim to bathe. The only way to save Iqbal and Dara’s wedding is for Solah and his friends to confront Nenek Gayung and seek help from Kangmas Pusi.

movie:tt37697399.name: Shake, Rattle & Roll: Evil Origins
movie:tt37697399.description: In 1775 during the Spanish colonial period in the Philippines, nuns attempts to survive the night after an unknown evil was set free in their cloister. Meanwhile in 2025, a group of friends attend a Halloween masquerade ball which was attacked by a serial killer. Fast forward to the future in 2050, a post-apocalytic Philippines is ruled by the aswang.

movie:tt39239818.name: Haiku
movie:tt39239818.description: A charismatic young man uses poetry to navigate the complex maze of modern romance to protect his fragile relationship. Later, he must overcome deep generational divides to keep his love alive.

movie:tt39239754.name: Sigma
movie:tt39239754.description: A daring treasure hunter throws caution to the wind, outwitting deadly traps and treacherous allies with sheer nerve and cunning.

movie:tt15427952.name: Anaganaga Oka Raju
movie:tt15427952.description: A lazy, entitled brat who wants to lead an easy life is in for a rude shock that changes the course of his life.

movie:tt32135720.name: Mass Jathara
movie:tt32135720.description: A transport officer battles a violent drug lord and his criminal clan.

movie:tt48347106.name: Crowyokan
movie:tt48347106.description: Comedian Pandji Pragiwaksono turns spontaneous audience exchanges into an intimate and unpredictable crowd-work special.

movie:tt41007422.name: Thomas & Friends: Really Helpful Engines
movie:tt41007422.description: When Gordon needs help, Thomas takes on extra work alone to prove himself. But a busy day on Sodor shows that even useful engines need their friends.

movie:tt43716819.name: Beat Luke Littler
movie:tt43716819.description: One world champion. 20 fearless amateurs. £501,000 on the line. Can an underdog beat world No. 1 Luke Littler in an epic, single-leg darts showdown?

movie:tt34442799.name: Oru Durooha Saahacharyathil
movie:tt34442799.description: Humble health care worker Sethu lives a quiet life caring for his sick brother — until a mysterious armed fugitive seeks refuge in his home.

movie:tt39793801.name: Descendants/ZOMBIES Worlds Collide: Concert Special
movie:tt39793801.description: Celebrating the high-energy music from the iconic Descendants and ZOMBIES franchises, the Descendants/ZOMBIES Worlds Collide Tour thrilled sold-out crowds in over 40 arenas across North America last summer. series:tt35836615.description: Seven couples move out of their comfort zones and onto the therapist's couch to try and work through their relationship issues in this reality series.

series:tt35636900.name: James.
series:tt35636900.description: James Rodríguez, Colombia's legendary No. 10, shares details of his journey to football's elite and the game's biggest stage.

series:tt34476674.name: Hound's Hill
series:tt34476674.description: Famous writer Mikolaj returns to hometown facing blackmail over a book about a past murder. His activist father opposes local corruption. Mikolaj's journalist wife investigates, uncovering dark secrets tied to the town's tragic hi...

series:tt45124639.name: Chilean Mine Rescue: Race Against Time
series:tt45124639.description: Following a mining accident in northern Chile, 33 miners are trapped deep underground. As the search for them begins, the men are fighting for their lives under extreme conditions.

series:tt35803134.name: Final Draft
series:tt35803134.description: Twenty-five athletes, most retired, compete to win 30M yen to launch their second career. Can they overcome tough physical and psychological challenges?

series:tt42416598.name: Abandoned
series:tt42416598.description: In 1984, three children were abandoned at a Barcelona train station with no memory of their identity or past. Unclaimed, they were adopted into loving homes. As adults, they now search for their biological parents.

series:tt42604310.name: Norway: The Dark Horse
series:tt42604310.description: After 26 years of tournament drought, Norway's 2026 World Cup hopes were next to nil. But what followed rekindled belief.

series:tt40029087.name: Unicorn Academy: Secrets Revealed
series:tt40029087.description: A new mystery unfolds at Unicorn Academy as long-buried secrets begin to surface, threatening the very balance of Unicorn Island. As Sophia and her friends return for another year, they are drawn into a dangerous quest filled with hidden powers, unexpected betrayals, and dark forces growing stronger in the shadows. With every step, the stakes rise, pushing the riders to their limits. Packed with magic, suspense, and emotional twists, this chapter promises a thrilling adventure where not everything is as it seems, and every secret could change their destiny forever.

series:tt35256070.name: The Hooligan
series:tt35256070.description: When his father is released from prison, 17-year-old Kuba finds it difficult not to follow in his hooligan footsteps. After all, football is family.

series:tt43138820.name: Million Dollar Nannies
series:tt43138820.description: A young group of elite nannies heads to Ibiza to launch a new kind of agency, built by nannies, for nannies. They're promised VIP families, life-changing money, and a shot at something bigger than any of them could build alone. But fierce competition, personal drama, and a scandal from the past threaten to derail the dream before the summer sets.

series:tt35440065.name: David Blaine: Do Not Attempt
series:tt35440065.description: Magician David Blaine travels globally, connecting with masters and performers who share unique skills and secrets. His journey spans Brazil, Southeast Asia, India, the Arctic, South Africa and Japan.

series:tt37458027.name: Hurricane Katrina: Race Against Time
series:tt37458027.description: Offers the most intimate and profound exploration into the wide-ranging impacts of the Hurricane Katrina disaster to date. Weaving together critical moments of the crisis and the past events that precipitated it, the series delivers an unparalleled, emotionally raw examination of the storm’s personal, political and societal fallout.

series:tt35801873.name: Badly in Love
series:tt35801873.description: In Japan's first dating show for rebellious yankiis, 11 singles butt heads, forge bonds and live together for 14 days as they go all out to find the one.

series:tt37542748.name: Death in Apartment 603: What Happened to Ellen Greenberg?
series:tt37542748.description: Explores the death of Ellen Greenberg, initially ruled a suicide, her family insists she was murdered.

series:tt45857574.name: Stars and Vows: Anele & Buzza
series:tt45857574.description: Follow media darling Anele Mdoda and her royal fiance Buzza James from pre-wedding celebrations and tense family moments to their long-awaited "I do."

series:tt35617850.name: The Fox Hollow Murders: Playground of a Serial Killer
series:tt35617850.description: Hamilton County coroner Jeff Jellison launches a new investigation into Herb Baumeister decades after thousands of bones were found in the woods behind Fox Hollow Farms, Baumeister's stately home. Using new DNA technology, Jellison and his team work to identify the human remains, bringing long-deferred closure to victims' families and unearthing unsettling questions about potential accomplices, missing evidence, and a key witness whose story keeps changing.

series:tt34692346.name: To Love, To Lose
series:tt34692346.description: A star-crossed romance seals the fate of two families when a woman trying to save her family restaurant falls for the surly heir of a debt collector.

series:tt30428883.name: Government Cheese
series:tt30428883.description: Hampton Chambers a newly released ex-convict striving to leave his criminal history behind and reunite with his family. Amidst this struggle, he grapples with frequent inexplicable moments of divine intervention.

series:tt37024175.name: Bandi
series:tt37024175.description: Following the death of their mother, their pillar of strength and their anchor, eleven siblings aged 7 to 23 try to stay united in the face of adversity. But for some of them, drug trafficking seems to be the only way to survive. A decision far from being unanimously accepted, and one that severely tests the strength of their family bonds.

series:tt37970537.name: Beauty and the Bester
series:tt37970537.description: Did renowned Dr Nandipha get embroiled in Thabo Bester's prison break? This chilling documentary series examines the enigmatic ties that bound them.

series:tt31522591.name: Fate
series:tt31522591.description: Taxi driver David becomes the chauffeur for a famous bullfighter known as El Maestro, who is attempting a comeback after years away from the ring. El Maestro's perspective changes, and he starts seeing David as a good luck charm.

series:tt37388093.name: Delirium
series:tt37388093.description: When his wife Agustina falls into delirium, a professor delves into her dark past to piece together her story and uncover the cause of her madness.

series:tt37507058.name: What's in the Box?
series:tt37507058.description: Players answer trivia to win spectacular hidden prizes — but can they keep them from the competition?

series:tt32877867.name: Necaxa
series:tt32877867.description: Beloved Mexican soccer team Club Necaxa strives to reclaim their place as one of Mexico's top teams, while their Mexican-American owner Eva Longoria tries to breathe new life into the team by enlisting the help of her high-profile friends including new co-owners Rob Mac and Ryan Reynolds.

series:tt41083418.name: Betrayal: Secrets & Lies
series:tt41083418.description: Explores lives undone by unthinkable betrayals and the courage it takes to survive scandalous confessions, secret lives, terrifying acts of violence, financial ruin and more, showing that when loyalty turns to lies, the truth does more than break hearts - it changes everything.

series:tt29242849.name: My Family
series:tt29242849.description: A terminally ill father prepares his chaotic family to care for his two young kids and face life without him — but they must put old quarrels to rest.

series:tt43589481.name: Thunder 3
series:tt43589481.description: Unremarkably ordinary middle schoolers, Pyontaro, Hiroshi and Tsubame, wander into an extraordinary adventure when Pyontaro's little sister goes missing.

series:tt37762739.name: Just Alice
series:tt37762739.description: Torn between two loves, Alicia secretly marries both a famous writer and a former priest. How long can she juggle love, lies and her double life?

series:tt42007275.name: The Girls: A Khloé Kardashian Project
series:tt42007275.description: They're building empires. They're building families. They're always unfiltered. Welcome to The Girls, where Khloé Kardashian's inner circle of real-life besties are raising babies, running businesses, and surviving brutally honest group chats. From surprise proposals to solo parenting, glam getaways to growing pains, this is the new era of reality TV where the chaos is couture — and the bonds are unbreakable.

series:tt36955264.name: Young Millionaires
series:tt36955264.description: After four Marseille teens win €17 million, dreams of yachts, freedom and fast cash take off — but money brings chaos they never bargained for.

series:tt36255074.name: Call My Agent Berlin
series:tt36255074.description: Welcome to Stern Talent Agency, where stars, drama, and intrigue are part of daily life. After the founder’s death, the agency faces collapse. Only by discovering new talent, keeping old stars, and securing smart deals can it survive. Behind the scenes, the agents fight with passion — for their clients and for their own future.

series:tt38937921.name: Travis Japan Summer Vacation!! in the USA
series:tt38937921.description: Travis Japan embarks on a summer road trip through the Rocky Mountains in North America. Divided into teams, one hits the road by RV, the other dives into local culture. With new horizons to explore and heartfelt connections to make, this road trip promises to be unlike any other.

series:tt38776655.name: SEVENTEEN: OUR CHAPTER
series:tt38776655.description: Answers discovered through endless questioning, never-ending challenges and performances, and the stories shared with CARATs. This 10th-anniversary documentary series captures SEVENTEEN's candid stories.

series:tt35315539.name: Aitana: Metamorphosis
series:tt35315539.description: Follow pop star Aitana's journey in this 6-part series as she grows personally and professionally, shares her hits, faces challenges, and emerges as a leading Spanish music artist.

series:tt36351172.name: A Tragedy Foretold: Flight 3054
series:tt36351172.description: The untold stories and human tragedy behind Latin America's deadliest air disaster are investigated in this three-part documentary series.

series:tt38453141.name: Ready or Not: Texas
series:tt38453141.description: No plans, just vibes. When two best friends and their crew set off for Texas on an entirely unscripted adventure, there's no telling what's coming next.

series:tt37677376.name: Members Only: Palm Beach
series:tt37677376.description: Within the exclusive enclaves of Palm Beach County, follow a group of women navigating the unspoken rules, inherited traditions and high-stakes hierarchies of America's most rarefied social circles. In this manicured world of privilege and private clubs, reputations are built over brunch, alliances shift over champagne, and while wealth is ubiquitous, power, influence and access are the true currency.

series:tt43725623.name: Conversations with a Killer: The Charles Manson Tapes
series:tt43725623.description: Tracing Charles Manson's rise as a cult leader, the 1969 murders, and his trial, using unreleased prison recordings, interviews, and archival footage.

series:tt37053730.name: Diddy on Trial: As It Happened
series:tt37053730.description: The trial of Sean "Diddy" Combs has begun, and prosecutors allege he engaged in an extensive list of criminal activities, including federal racketeering, sex trafficking and more. Combs denies all accusations, maintaining his innocence. In this new weekly series, viewers can witness it all unfold in real time.

series:tt35439807.name: Harlem Ice
series:tt35439807.description: Follow the girls of Figure Skating in Harlem as they prepare for competitions, performances and a life changing global experience. Through their eyes, experience the highs and lows of the FSH Season, and the unique experiences they have as girls of color breaking the ice ceiling and gaining access to a global stage.

series:tt36742714.name: Santita
series:tt36742714.description: Left in a wheelchair after a crash, Santita leaves the love of her life at the altar. Twenty years later, he returns with a request that changes everything.

series:tt38348835.name: Calabasas Confidential
series:tt38348835.description: After graduating college, the group return to Calabasas for “a summer they’ll never forget”. Back home and living in their parents’ hillside mansions, they’ll be faced with the daunting reality of confronting unresolved drama while trying to define what’s next for their lives and relationships. Four years may have put distance between them, but new flames, old feuds, and unexpected secrets don’t stay hidden forever behind the gates of LA’s most envied zip code.

series:tt42171045.name: Between Father and Son
series:tt42171045.description: In just a few suspenseful minutes, a lawyer's world tilts as her visit to her fiancé's family estate ignites an irresistible bond with her future stepson.

series:tt38201910.name: Baki-Dou: The Invincible Samurai
series:tt38201910.description: Baki and the strongest Underground Arena fighters face a threat of historical proportions: the resurrected Musashi Miyamoto, Japan's greatest samurai.

series:tt15789898.name: Gold & Greed: The Hunt for Fenn's Treasure
series:tt15789898.description: An eccentric man named Forrest Fenn sets off a real-life treasure hunt when he hides a chest of gold in the Rockies — and leaves clues in a cryptic poem.

series:tt28235034.name: Juan Gabriel: I Must, I Can, I Will
series:tt28235034.description: Rare videos and exclusive interviews reveal the genius, sacrifices and duality between the public and private lives of iconic singer-songwriter Juan Gabriel.

series:tt38691521.name: Fire and Water: Making the Avatar Films
series:tt38691521.description: This two-part documentary provides a fascinating glimpse into the making of the Oscar-winning box office phenomenon "Avatar: The Way of Water" and features exclusive behind-the-scenes footage, concept art, and interviews with cast and filmmakers.

series:tt33989829.name: YOLANTHE
series:tt33989829.description: This reality series follows Yolanthe Cabau in her glamorous new life in Los Angeles as she faces unexpected challenges and ghosts from her past.

series:tt35407689.name: Vietnam: The War That Changed America
series:tt35407689.description: A raw, intimate look at the Vietnam War's impact on America. Through personal stories, the series examines the conflict's far-reaching consequences and lasting influence on society as the 50th anniversary of Saigon's fall approaches.

series:tt30965512.name: Istanbul Encyclopedia
series:tt30965512.description: A young student moves in with an estranged family friend in Istanbul, trading her humble hometown for a city that tests her identity — and convictions.

series:tt40618614.name: The Prosecutor
series:tt40618614.description: This raw docuseries is about the head of the new Femicide Investigation Unit in Mexico City, a department established to stop violence against women.

series:tt36416165.name: Angi: Fake Life, True Crime
series:tt36416165.description: Sentenced for the murder and impersonation of her friend, this documentary sheds new light on Angi — and the death of her husband years before.

series:tt35670584.name: KPopped
series:tt35670584.description: A group of western artists reimagine their hit songs in collaboration with K-pop idols and compete in battle performances judged by an audience in Seoul.

series:tt37497762.name: The Real Rooneys
series:tt37497762.description: A candid glimpse into the Rooneys' world as soccer legend Wayne juggles dad duties and former England captain's wife Coleen balances motherhood with business ambitions.

series:tt33806512.name: Love Is Blind: Italy
series:tt33806512.description: A group of singles who want to be loved for who they are will have the opportunity to search for their soulmate without the distractions of the outside world and will choose someone to marry without ever meeting them face-to-face. When their wedding day arrives, will real-world realities and external factors push them apart, or will they marry the person they fell blindly in love with?

series:tt39365311.name: S&X
series:tt39365311.description: At his clinic, sex therapist Ichito Shimotori treats diverse and intimate sexual issues with sincerity. Yet, he secretly hides a struggle of his own.

series:tt39151104.name: Best of the World with Antoni Porowski
series:tt39151104.description: Antoni searches for the world's most unforgettable travel experiences.

series:tt35335046.name: Taskaree: The Smuggler's Web
series:tt35335046.description: At customs, Superintendent Meena's elite team faces a crucial mission: stop rising contraband trafficking and take down global crime boss Bada Choudhary's syndicate.

series:tt11382826.name: Sneaker Wars: Adidas V. Puma
series:tt11382826.description: Through unprecedented access to both companies, uncover the tale of two feuding brothers, Adi and Rudi Dassler, whose multi-decade rivalry and competition helped shape the modern sportswear industry.

series:tt28529513.name: Berlin ER
series:tt28529513.description: After her private life falls apart, a young doctor seeking a fresh start takes over the emergency room in Berlin's toughest, most chaotic hospital. Battling staff resistance and a run-down system, she must unite her maverick team to save lives.

series:tt35674865.name: Esa Noche
series:tt35674865.description: Three sisters face a moral crisis when the youngest hits a man with her car in the Dominican Republic. They must decide how far they'll go to keep her out of jail and prevent her child from losing a mother.

series:tt32500304.name: Snakes and Ladders
series:tt32500304.description: An ambitious but overlooked teacher wants to be head of a prestigious school, but must climb a slippery ladder of lies and corruption to reach the top.

series:tt38681821.name: Love Is Blind: Poland
series:tt38681821.description: In this unique dating experiment, Polish singles date, fall in love and get engaged before ever meeting in person. Will their spark survive the reveal?

series:tt32751696.name: The Best Heart Attack of My Life
series:tt32751696.description: A ghostwriter's life-threatening heart attack in a foreign country forces him to rely on strangers for help. This unexpected crisis becomes a transformative experience, reshaping his perspective and impacting those around him.

series:tt38808290.name: 50 Seconds: The Fernando Báez Sosa Case
series:tt38808290.description: This documentary series explores the 2020 murder of Fernando Báez Sosa, whose fatal beating by a group of young men was caught on video, shocking Argentina.

series:tt34570673.name: Asura
series:tt34570673.description: Four sisters face turbulence when their father's affair is exposed. Embodying the tumultuous "asura" demigods, they clash over differing outlooks on love yet find moments of connection amid conflict and growth.

series:tt39366412.name: Girl from Nowhere: The Reset
series:tt39366412.description: "If everything stayed the same, it wouldn't be called karma, right?" When the world as it is still seems to need Nanno to shake things up.

series:tt35056033.name: SEC Football: Any Given Saturday
series:tt35056033.description: Follow college football's most elite players and coaches in this unfiltered documentary series that goes behind the scenes of a dramatic SEC season.

series:tt36742717.name: Love from 9 to 5
series:tt36742717.description: Two colleagues from vastly different backgrounds initially despise each other. He is a privileged "nepo baby," while she is a determined worker who has earned everything through her efforts. Their competitive spirit leads to unexpected sparks and, eventually, deeper affection.

series:tt27719131.name: Love Is Blind: Germany
series:tt27719131.description: The experiment comes to Germany as local singles seek true love and a commitment that lasts a lifetime, all before meeting each other face-to-face.

series:tt34683603.name: Love Is Blind: France
series:tt34683603.description: Divided into pods, French singles date and get engaged — sight unseen. Is love truly blind? A social experiment hosted by Luthna Plocus and Teddy Riner.

series:tt35257773.name: With Love, Meghan
series:tt35257773.description: Markle shares personal tips and tricks, embracing playfulness over perfection, highlighting how to create beauty in unexpected ways.

series:tt37694105.name: Next Gen Chef
series:tt37694105.description: Twenty-one rising chefs vie to be crowned a generational talent and win $500,000 in this cutthroat competition set at the Culinary Institute of America.

series:tt31806048.name: Hostage
series:tt31806048.description: When the PM's husband is kidnapped and the visiting French President is blackmailed, the two political leaders face unimaginable choices. Forced into a fierce rivalry can they work together to uncover the plot that threatens them ...

series:tt37438632.name: Hitmakers
series:tt37438632.description: Creativity and ego collide in this all-access reality series that follows a group of gifted songwriters as they pen hits for music's biggest stars.

series:tt29536553.name: טעם של בית עם אנטוני פורובסקי
series:tt29536553.description: אנטוני פורובסקי לוקח את רוח ההרפתקנות והמומחיות הקולינרית שלו למסע בינלאומי ואפי יחד עם אורחים מפורסמים, כדי לחקור מחדש את השורשים הקולינאריים שלהם ולהכניס אותנטיות למתכונים המודרניים.

series:tt37065878.name: The Guest
series:tt37065878.description: A seemingly perfect household unravels when an unexpected visitor arrives, exposing hidden tensions and political aspirations that threaten to tear the family apart.

series:tt37333650.name: All the Sharks
series:tt37333650.description: Four teams of shark experts and enthusiasts travel the globe trying to find the most elusive shark species in this fin-tastic reality competition.

series:tt31909033.name: Forget You Not
series:tt31909033.description: An aspiring stand-up comedian turns her struggles into heartfelt humor as she balances work and relationships while caring for her aging father.

series:tt37610565.name: Simon Cowell: The Next Act
series:tt37610565.description: Simon Cowell is looking for the next hit boy band. And he's risking it all to find them. Will these young singers prove he's still got the Midas touch?

series:tt32510363.name: Son of a Donkey
series:tt32510363.description: Theo comes up with chaotic schemes to save his impounded car. Meanwhile, his dying dad will stop at nothing to find himself a new kidney.

series:tt37028195.name: Too Hot to Handle: Spain
series:tt37028195.description: A group of flirty Spanish singles expect sun, parties and steamy hookups, but they quickly learn that winning €100,000 requires giving up sex completely.

series:tt40822983.name: My Brother the Minotaur
series:tt40822983.description: When a minotaur raised by humans starts dreaming of his mythical past, he sets out on a wild adventure—with help from his brother and friends—to understand who he really is.

series:tt31501513.name: Glass Heart
series:tt31501513.description: An aspiring drummer suddenly loses her spot in the band. But when a brilliant musician recruits her for his new band, her life takes a passionate turn.

series:tt35064818.name: Black Warrant
series:tt35064818.description: A newly appointed jailer at Tihar Prison confronts widespread corruption and injustice within its walls, forcing him to choose between maintaining the status quo or fighting for reform.

series:tt37150003.name: Kiss or Die
series:tt37150003.description: Male comedians face off in a steamy improv drama where they must resist the advances of irresistibly seductive co-stars and deliver the ultimate kiss.

series:tt32501190.name: Battle Camp
series:tt32501190.description: Netflix reality stars duke it out in hair-raising physical challenges and scheme to avoid elimination to win $250K in this adventurous competition show.

series:tt35668813.name: Unconditional
series:tt35668813.description: A mother-daughter vacation abroad takes a devastating turn when Gali is arrested for drug possession. Refusing to accept the charges, her mother Orna risks everything on a quest for freedom—only to get entangled in a web of Gali's secrets.

series:tt37062070.name: Single Papa
series:tt37062070.description: When Gaurav finds a baby in the back of his car, he must defy his eccentric family, the adoption agency and societal norms to become a single papa.

series:tt37610484.name: Is It Cake? Halloween
series:tt37610484.description: עוגה או זיוף? ממתק או תעלול? אופים מיומנים מכינים עוגות הלואין מציאותיות במיוחד. מהדורה חגיגית של התחרות הפופולרית.

series:tt33078939.name: Football Parents
series:tt33078939.description: When it comes to their children's amateur football careers, this group of parents has no shame, no chill — and a peculiar sense of team spirit.

series:tt32581507.name: Leviathan
series:tt32581507.description: Set in an alternate steampunk past, an Austrian fugitive prince and a Scottish airman in disguise embark on an unexpected quest to prevent a world war.

series:tt37272805.name: Off Road
series:tt37272805.description: Raz and Sela, embark on a journey through Kyrgyzstan and Kazakhstan, exploring Central Asian landscapes while testing their friendship and personal convictions.

series:tt37442772.name: The Dynasty: UConn Huskies
series:tt37442772.description: Go inside the most dominant program in college basketball history as Geno Auriemma pushes his players to the limit to win 12 titles. Rebecca Lobo, Diana Taurasi, Paige Bueckers, and more reveal what it takes to survive UConn and build a dynasty.

series:tt34691842.name: Bet Your Life
series:tt34691842.description: A down-and-out sports betting writer is roped into teaming up with the ghost of a bossy business tycoon demanding to crack his own murder case.

series:tt40618611.name: The Root of the Game
series:tt40618611.description: Brazil lives, breathes and exports várzea. This series delves into the stories behind the beautiful game — one with the power to change lives.

series:tt39370855.name: Night Shift for Cuties
series:tt39370855.description: Friendship turns into rivalry as two obsessed K-pop fans working in the same minimart do whatever it takes to meet their idols in Korea.

series:tt35836640.name: Watching You
series:tt35836640.description: Lina is happily engaged, but a chance encounter with a stranger culminates in a one-night stand. When the affair is secretly filmed and used to blackmail her, she hunts the voyeur, only to discover the danger is far closer than she could imagine.

series:tt34692003.name: Lovers Anonymous
series:tt34692003.description: Cem, scarred by a childhood that crushed his trust in love, runs the "Love Hospital" — until Hazal, a believer in the power of love, disrupts his life.

series:tt31472425.name: The Murky Stream
series:tt31472425.description: The fates of a man with a hidden past, a wise and just woman, and an upright man intertwine.

series:tt31223067.name: Prison Cell 211
series:tt31223067.description: Follows a riot that took place at a state prison in the Mexican border town of Ciudad Juárez on Dec 31, 2022 that left several dead.

series:tt39387594.name: Take a Hike!
series:tt39387594.description: Four celebrity hiking newbies end up forming a club to tackle Korea's snow‑capped peaks. Can they figure out why on earth people go to the mountains?

series:tt37981481.name: Matchroom: The Greatest Showmen
series:tt37981481.description: Matchroom is home to the biggest names in sport - from snooker to darts to fishing to boxing - and is the epicentre of some of the most lucrative deals and sporting events globally. With unprecedented access to Barry Hearn, his son Eddie and the whole Matchroom team at the Essex based HQ, this documentary series will dive into the drama of the family empire that has become synonymous with British sporting culture.

series:tt30057076.name: Welcome to the Family
series:tt30057076.description: A struggling single mom rallies her quirky family to outsmart a mafia boss after her estranged, wealthy father dies, leaving them with massive debt.

series:tt36838527.name: Obsess
series:tt36838527.description: After returning home, Talal is pulled into a dark psychological journey where the lines between guilt, desire and his own disturbing impulses begin to blur. As buried feelings connected to a past love resurface, the darkness inside him grows stronger. Talal is forced to confront a terrifying question: can he free himself from his past, or will it consume him completely?

series:tt36852036.name: Power Moves with Shaquille O'Neal
series:tt36852036.description: NBA legends Shaquille O'Neal and Allen Iverson work to revive Reebok's legacy and find a rising star to rep the brand.

series:tt34995624.name: Reminder
series:tt34995624.description: Deniz, a reliable, famous architect, and Güneş, a phenomenal editor, who decided to separate six months ago while on their way to a wedding, are swept into a journey that will change their lives with a message that arrives on their phones on the evening of the day they met by chance. This new adventure will make them discover the missing pieces of their old relationship and remind them of love.

series:tt34934110.name: Love Upon a Time
series:tt34934110.description: A modern man is transported 400 years into the past, where he must pose as a missing criminal's son while falling for a suspicious noble.

series:tt14348758.name: The Sisters Grimm
series:tt14348758.description: One year after their parents' mysterious disappearance, sisters Sabrina and Daphne move to a magical town where fairytales are real and secrets lurk behind every corner.

series:tt36144166.name: Love Overboard
series:tt36144166.description: Step aboard the ultimate luxury yacht, where sexy singles are ready to mix and mingle ... and find love. But there's a twist ... gaining access to the yacht's extravagant amenities won't be so simple. As the journey unfolds, romance ignites; alliances form; and hearts are shattered. In the end, only one couple will reign supreme. Who will rise to the top, and who will be left stranded?

series:tt35665851.name: Saare Jahan Se Accha: The Silent Guardians
series:tt35665851.description: In the 1970's, a resilient Indian spy must defeat his counterpart across the border in a battle of wits and trade craft to sabotage a nuclear program.

series:tt37041362.name: My Korean Boyfriend
series:tt37041362.description: Five Brazilian women, in various stages of their relationships, arrive in bustling Seoul to discover if their relationships can survive the distance, cultural differences, and new routines.

series:tt34139155.name: Cash Queens
series:tt34139155.description: When life pushes them to the brink, five desperate friends decide the only way out is to form a gang, swipe some guns and start holding up banks.

series:tt47052712.name: Disney Sidekick Adventures

series:tt39387426.name: Jae-seok's B&B Rules!
series:tt39387426.description: The guest is king — but so is the host! Yu Jae-seok opens his first B&B, where he runs things his way and treats guests to his signature games.

series:tt35517757.name: Onside: Major League Soccer

series:tt32821425.description: As a hit podcaster, comedian Laci Mosley knows her way around a scam. Now, she's taking her expertise on the road, uncovering small-town swindles and big-city cons across the U.S.

series:tt33522709.name: Blippi's Job Show
series:tt33522709.description: Blippi and Meekah are on a mission to learn about all kinds of jobs. From driving a monster truck to making pizzas, there's no job too big or too small!

series:tt33028674.name: Sneaky Links: Dating After Dark
series:tt33028674.description: Six singles check into a motel looking for love, but there's a twist: Their situationships are invited too. Can these hookups turn into real romance?

series:tt31189484.name: The Roshans
series:tt31189484.description: This documentary series chronicles the trials and triumphs of Bollywood's iconic Roshan family — musician Roshan Lal Nagrath, Rajesh, Rakesh and Hrithik.

series:tt27607776.name: BE@RBRICK
series:tt27607776.description: In a town where everyone's roles are predetermined, an aspiring singer-songwriter and her bandmates break free to pursue their dreams and inspire others to do the same.

series:tt35474026.name: Dog Days Out
series:tt35474026.description: When their humans are away, a cute and curious pup and his dog pals love to play with their best friends — their favorite toys!

series:tt35796974.name: Go!
series:tt35796974.description: A young sprinter tries to overcome trauma from his past as he attends a prestigious school in Johannesburg on scholarship.

series:tt28689687.name: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse+
series:tt28689687.description: Mickey and pals welcome everyone back to the clubhouse for all-new adventures filled with songs, laughs, handy helping, and fun new surprises.

series:tt34710683.name: Bullet Bullet
series:tt34710683.description: In the near future, civilization has collapsed. Gear works in a junk shop, retrieving stolen goods alongside Qu-0213 and White Bear. After accepting a mysterious request to steal an important item, they soon find themselves hunted by deadly assassins.

series:tt21057046.name: The Doomies
series:tt21057046.description: When best friends Bobby and Romy mistakenly open up a gateway to another world, they turn their sleepy coastal town into a hotspot for terrifying creatures of doom. Roped into an epic supernatural mystery, they will cross paths with the so-called “Chosen One” and do battle with both literal and inner monsters.

series:tt33997565.name: Iron Man and His Awesome Friends
series:tt33997565.description: Follow the adventures (and misadventures) of best friends and super geniuses, Tony Stark, Riri Williams and Amadeus Cho as they work together to solve problems both big and small and protect their city.

series:tt19872918.name: RoboGobo
series:tt19872918.description: Five adorable adopted pets are given super-powered Robo-Suits by kid inventor Dax, then going on a mission to save other pets in trouble and learning how to become a family in the process.

series:tt34991330.name: W.A.G.s to Riches
series:tt34991330.description: They're the wives and girlfriends of famous athletes and rap stars, but these stylishly smart W.A.G.s call the shots in this soapy reality series.

series:tt37786409.name: RIV4LRIES
series:tt37786409.description: At a middle school in Pisa, no one has ever challenged the cool kids — until new girl Terry arrives with bold ideas and the rivalries begin.

series:tt43689080.name: Heartstopper Forever: The Official Podcast
series:tt43689080.description: The stars and creators of "Heartstopper Forever" discuss the film, look back on the series and answer questions from the fans in this official podcast series.

series:tt44112771.name: THE ONE SHOT
series:tt44112771.description: Eight of Japan's top comedians selected by Daigo, including M-1 finalists and King of Conte champions, must each write and direct a short film with just one rule: include a single, hilarious gag. In this unprecedented competition, skilled comedians have just "one shot" to prove their true talent.

series:tt41337266.name: Someone Has to Know
series:tt41337266.description: A boy vanishes, and no one can find him. An open-and-shut case, except there are no leads. Three hundred people around him, and no one saw anything?

series:tt39643967.name: Desi Bling
series:tt39643967.description: Glitzy parties and delicious secrets rule the lives of ultra-wealthy Indian expats as they spare no expense — or drama.

series:tt50514651.name: KPop Demon Hunters Bonus Content
series:tt50514651.description: For the fans... from the fans! This collection of "KPop Demon Hunters" fan-video moments rounds up must-see clips to watch again and again.

series:tt37150947.name: The Kingdom
series:tt37150947.description: In 2024, the two-time defending champion Kansas City Chiefs aimed to make history by becoming the first NFL team to win three straight Super Bowls. "The Kingdom" – a new six-part ESPN Original Series – chronicles the Chiefs’ dramatic pursuit of a three-peat, the legacy of the franchise, and the unforgettable characters who built its modern-day football dynasty.

series:tt37108224.name: Hey Beautiful: Anatomy of a Romance Scam
series:tt37108224.description: Three women from around the world fall in love with the same handsome man, but their online boyfriend is not who he seems, and it could cost them everything.

series:tt35283101.name: WWE Legend Profiles
series:tt35283101.description: Legendary Superstars of WWE make history with unforgettable matches and moments inside the squared circle.

series:tt39523347.name: On the Edge: World Cup Ski Racing
series:tt39523347.description: Follow Olympic champions - including Mikaela Shiffrin, Lindsey Vonn, Marco Odermatt, Lucas Pinheiro Braathen and more - as they navigate the dramatic landscapes of Europe and North America on the Audi FIS Ski World Cup circuit. The series explores their personal journeys, on and off the snow, and the culture of the sport as they endure the grind of a global season all in pursuit of Olympic gold.

series:tt37529353.name: Born to Be Viral: The Real Lives of Kidfluencers
series:tt37529353.description: Follows the first generation of kids raised in the social media spotlight — their entire lives broadcast to millions, with the lucky few earning millions of dollars.

series:tt38133714.name: Memphis to the Mountain
series:tt38133714.description: From the grit of South Memphis, a group of young climbers set out to scale a 16,000-ft rock tower on Mt. Kenya—defying the limits of their world and themselves, and confronting thin air, raw fear, and the climb toward self-discovery.

series:tt37016963.name: Not Her First Rodeo
series:tt37016963.description: This six-part series takes viewers inside the fast-paced world of professional bull riding., following five remarkable women called the Elite Lady Bull Riders.

series:tt47596905.name: Doozie's Doghouse
series:tt47596905.description: Make it a doghouse day! Dog-loving Doozie uses her creativity and imagination during playtime with her puppy pals.

series:tt41159656.name: Yacht Deals Monaco
series:tt41159656.description: Ambitious sales talents compete in Monaco for a life-changing job in the world of luxury yachts. Under the guidance of yacht broker Cornelius Kistler and yacht consultant Marcela de Kern Royer, they face demanding tasks, high-end clients, and intense eliminations.

series:tt37727321.name: NASA+ Live on Netflix
series:tt37727321.description: Experience the latest space missions in real-time through NASA's live feed.

series:tt45015268.name: CoComelon Playdates with Sanrio Friends
series:tt45015268.description: The beloved characters from CoComelon and Sanrio are about to be introduced to one another and they’re going to be great friends!

series:tt45381042.name: Jeff & His Super Hero Friends
series:tt45381042.description: Join Jeff the Land Shark as he teams-up with the Avengers and Spider-Man in chaotic adventures against villains. Featuring characters like Hulk, Iron Man, Venom, and more.

series:tt39847051.name: Girl on the Run: The Hunt for America's Most Wanted Woman
series:tt39847051.description: When convicted double murderer Sarah Pender escapes from a maximum-security prison in Indiana, a nationwide manhunt is immediately launched. Charged alongside her former boyfriend, who pled guilty, for the murder of a young couple, Pender has vanished, igniting fear, fascination, and a relentless pursuit that stretches across state lines.

series:tt39309902.name: Is It Cake? Valentines
series:tt39309902.description: Love is in the air as Is It Cake? celebrates Valentine's Day. Three couples of expert cake artists compete in new games, create romantic cakes, and try to deceive judges and rivals. Plus, viewer games debut for the first time.

movie:tt32558705.name: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
movie:tt32558705.description: Explores Panem 24 years before Katniss' saga, starting on the morning of the reaping for the 50th Hunger Games, where a young Haymitch Abernathy participates.

movie:tt32176689.name: My Hero Academia: You're Next
movie:tt32176689.description: Deku, Bakugo, Todoroki and the rest of U.A. High Class 1-A must face off against Dark Might and the obscure crime organisation under his control, the Gollini Family.

movie:tt10515852.name: Steven Universe: The Movie
movie:tt10515852.description: Steven thinks his time defending the Earth is over, but when a new threat comes to Beach City, Steven faces his biggest challenge yet.

movie:tt1095217.name: Bad Lieutenant: Port of Call New Orleans
movie:tt1095217.description: Terence McDonagh is a drug- and gambling-addled detective in post-Katrina New Orleans investigating the killing of five Senegalese immigrants.

movie:tt43706402.name: Barreda
movie:tt43706402.description: In 1992, Ricardo Barreda was an unassuming dentist who brutally murdered his wife, mother-in-law, and two adult daughters in their family home. Branding himself as a victim, he ignited a media storm and fueled a national scandal.

movie:tt33318732.name: Jailer 2
movie:tt33318732.description: A retired officer's peaceful life is disrupted when a dangerous criminal organization threatens his family. He must use his skills one final time to protect his loved ones and preserve his legacy.

movie:tt34498564.name: The Vvaan
movie:tt34498564.description: A rational urban man defies his ancestral forbidden forest and awakens a divine goddess, only to realise that not only do some powers exist beyond logic but he must rise as the village’s only saviour to protect his people from annihilation.

movie:tt38040871.name: Drink Coffee, Talk Fast
movie:tt38040871.description: Cast, crew, and fans trace the making of Gilmore Girls and the enduring pull of Stars Hollow, revealing how its stories shaped lives and connected generations.

movie:tt40856286.name: Vibe
movie:tt40856286.description: Two hapless friends who can barely manage their own lives accidentally stumble upon a terrorist plot and suddenly find themselves responsible for saving the nation despite being completely unprepared for the task.

movie:tt33381528.name: Premada Oorali
movie:tt33381528.description: Premada Oorali is a heartfelt love story set in picturesque villages in the 2020s. The film intertwines romance and family drama, exploring the relationships between a father and son, as well as a boy and girl, as they navigate through intriguing, yet relatable, relationship challenges.

movie:tt41162785.name: 10 Good Men
movie:tt41162785.description: The B-17 Flying Fortress became an icon of American air power in World War II, but its legacy is written by the stories of the crews who flew it. Today, of the more than 100,000 veterans who flew on board of B-17 bombers during the war, there are only a handful remaining-but through years of searching, a few of the final survivors were brought together to tell this story one more time.

movie:tt32358025.name: Animal Race
movie:tt32358025.description: Inspired by the illegal universe of the Brazilian animal lottery, a fearless young man must win a deadly race to save his sister in a dystopian future where each animal in the game is now represented by a runner vying for a prize.

movie:tt33056211.name: Bikini Nuns
movie:tt33056211.description: A fearless trio of nuns is out for revenge. After being wronged by ruthless men, they trade their habits for high-powered weapons, taking justice into their own hands.

movie:tt36300841.name: Awarapan 2
movie:tt36300841.description: Shivam returns to the crime world, where his path forward demands redemption, love, and sacrifice. As relationships deepen and conflicts intensify, every choice tests his resolve and shapes his destiny.

movie:tt39676205.name: Dance For Your Life
movie:tt39676205.description: Dance for Your Life is a powerful testament to the transformative power of dance, where every leap is a story, every setback a lesson, and every moment a chance to be seen.

movie:tt35839924.name: Wizard of Oz: Dead Walk
movie:tt35839924.description: Dorothy is tricked into unleashing Tinman and Scarecrow into the real world only to learn their blood thirsty cravings.

movie:tt42369043.name: Ignition
movie:tt42369043.description: A real-time psychological thriller about bomb disposal officer Leon Colter. A routine call turns deadly when a device triggers a countdown, drawing him into a sadistic game led by a voice that knows his secrets.

movie:tt27441481.name: Coolie
movie:tt27441481.description: A mysterious man takes a stand against a corrupt syndicate exploiting and abusing the workers of a port town.

movie:tt35711633.name: Fatal Watch
movie:tt35711633.description: This gripping, true crime documentary set on the high seas exposes the largely unseen and fascinating world of fisheries observers, whose warnings about illegal fishing practices have resulted in fatal consequences for those sounding the alarm.

movie:tt35829169.name: Fabian and the Deadly Wedding
movie:tt35829169.description: Hapless con artist Fabian crashes a quirky winter wedding, planning to steal a valuable gift meant for the bride. But when a murder disrupts his scheme, Fabian finds himself unexpectedly drawn into solving the mystery. A thrilling murder mystery comedy packed with dark secrets.

movie:tt32065777.name: Nagabandham: The Secret Treasure
movie:tt32065777.description: A chosen warrior protects a mystical, serpent-bound Himalayan temple from those seeking to steal the power of the Brahma Kamalam, a divine relic.

movie:tt33402929.name: Yoroï
movie:tt33402929.description: After his last tour, Aurélien decides to settle in Japan with his wife Nanako, pregnant with their first child. In their new house in the Japanese countryside, Aurélien discovers an old armor that awakens strange creatures, the Yo...

movie:tt41022199.name: Jerry West: The Logo
movie:tt41022199.description: He built dynasties, broke barriers, and became the silhouette that defines the game. But beneath Jerry West's legendary NBA legacy was a man haunted by perfection and pain. Through rare interviews with family and basketball icons, uncover the complex truth behind The Logo.

movie:tt12643976.name: Off Rip
movie:tt12643976.description: A young skim-boarder supporting his single mother fights against all odds to become the man his family has never known but has always needed, pushing through trials within friendships, the drug scene, relationships, and competition.

movie:tt39050792.name: Afterlight
movie:tt39050792.description: In a future shaped by war, AI, and fractured time lines, five individual sci-fi stories explore humanity's fight for connection, survival, and meaning across time and space.

movie:tt37319756.name: Undercover. Inside the Bunker
movie:tt37319756.description: Bringing to light real images recorded during the greatest undercover operation in an animal experimentation laboratory in the world, Carlota Saorsa, now a protected witness, sacrifices everything and puts her life on the line to show the world the harsh reality she experienced for 18 months inside what she calls "The Bunker."

movie:tt32058735.name: Bhool Chuk Maaf
movie:tt32058735.description: Ranjan, a small-town romantic boy from Banaras, lands a government job to marry Titli but forgets his vow to Lord Shiva-only to be trapped until he fulfills his promise. A hilarious tale of love, fate, and redemption unfolds.

movie:tt24070874.name: Alien Storm
movie:tt24070874.description: A father, businessman and secret doomsday prepper escorts people to the safety of his bunker – actually an underground house – when a massive and potentially deadly fog descends and cuts the power at his home.

movie:tt9104736.name: Housefull 5
movie:tt9104736.description: In this murder mystery comedy, several imposters claiming to be the son of a recently deceased billionaire compete for his fortune aboard a luxury cruise ship.

movie:tt34906817.name: No Place to Be Single
movie:tt34906817.description: In a picturesque Tuscan town, Elisa's world shifts when a childhood friend's return stirs up old emotions.

movie:tt28102562.name: Vampires of Vijay Nagar
movie:tt28102562.description: A determined historian, sifts through old manuscripts, seeking clues about the mysterious legends of vampires in Vijay Nagar.

movie:tt31852278.name: Subedaar
movie:tt31852278.description: The man who once fought for the nation must now fight enemies within to protect his home and family.

movie:tt43676563.name: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
movie:tt43676563.description: He's conquered every title in tennis, including an Olympic gold. So why is Novak Djokovic still playing? The Wolf in Winter embeds with the greatest tennis player of all time as he returned to the Australian Open in 2025, capturing the obsession, the preparation, and the fire that won't go out even when there's nothing left to prove.

movie:tt34966678.name: The Librarians
