movie:tt39358084.description: In a desperate attempt to pay off his family's debts, a metalworker stages a bank robbery that spirals into a hostage standoff.

movie:tt32645982.name: Surrender To It
movie:tt32645982.description: Chaos ensues when a grieving father reunites with his old actor friends on a mysterious weekend in the UK's wild west.

movie:tt26681192.name: God of Frogs
movie:tt26681192.description: An Anthology film about four segments surrounding the same monster. Deep in the heart of the jungle exists an elemental creature with an eternal hunger, and every 25 years, it emerges: a woman is eaten alive in 1969, a film crew goes missing in 1994, a politician explodes live on television in 2019, and a multinational corporation goes up in flames in 2044.

movie:tt37899000.name: Finding Nina
movie:tt37899000.description: Renowned photographer JB returns to Northern Nigeria to reconnect with his roots. A photo of his childhood love, Nina, sparks a surreal journey of memory, love, and self-discovery, forcing him to confront the past.

movie:tt39325805.name: Tragic Villain
movie:tt39325805.description: After the devastating loss of their infant daughter, Maria and Avery Brooks struggle to survive the quiet devastation that grief leaves behind. Once vibrant and full of life, Maria retreats into silence, while Avery-desperate to fix what feels irreparably broken-searches for any solution that might restore the woman he loves. As outside help enters their home, fragile emotions begin to shift in unexpected ways. What starts as an attempt to heal slowly exposes buried loneliness, unmet needs, and dangerous vulnerabilities. Love becomes complicated.

movie:tt14939068.name: Devil's Play
movie:tt14939068.description: Iva, a troubled teenager trapped between an abusive stepfather and a distant, deaf mother, finds unexpected salvation in a mysterious boy claiming to be Lucifer, a fallen angel sent to guide her. As she wrestles with faith, madness, and destiny, she is trained for a chilling mission: to assassinate a powerful American televangelist hiding a sinister truth beneath his holy image.

movie:tt15263056.name: Reason to Believe
movie:tt15263056.description: Christine is counting down the days to graduation so she can escape her demanding family but her plan is sidetracked after her mother's stroke and some unlikely encounters. As Christine retreats further into herself, her conscience brings her to a breaking point and forces a choice. Will she change her life and bet on God?

movie:tt9658388.name: Praise This
movie:tt9658388.description: A young woman with dreams of being a superstar joins an underdog Atlanta praise-team choir in the lead-up to the national competition

movie:tt31849590.name: Groundswell
movie:tt31849590.description: Viewers travel around the world, getting a global perspective on the three biggest (and interrelated) problems our species faces – climate change, species loss and soil loss. More importantly, viewers will learn about the multitude of methods in which regeneration is addressing and even reversing these trends on an ecosystem-by-ecosystem basis, all while storing enough carbon in the ground to help mitigate our changing climate.

movie:tt32309072.name: Harbinger
movie:tt32309072.description: Julia, sole survivor of late serial killer Decker, is lured back to the house she shared with him for a ghost hunting TV show. The crew discover the 'Harbinger' - a fairground fortune telling machine that reveals their fates one by one.

movie:tt28223508.name: Verified Target
movie:tt28223508.description: When a bad person is marked as a 'virus', they become a verified target and will be terminated. A unique team of assassins known as 'AVL' follows this strict code. But when Blake discovers her target is innocent, she uncovers a bigger conspiracy. To hide their corruption, members of the AVL mark her as a Verified Target.

movie:tt35149269.name: Slackers
movie:tt35149269.description: A slingshot is loaded, the stone flies and crashes - the neighbor's window breaks. Ramona and Nico are friends, lazy bums and fresh out of school. But instead of thinking about their future, they prefer to let the hot Berlin summer get the better of them. When they release a beloved neighbor's bird, they have to flee - into the politically charged world that they really don't want to be in. A road trip through Berlin begins - but on foot.

movie:tt23852296.name: Let's Both Try
movie:tt23852296.description: Alice and Tommy are newlywed photographers whose love and faith are tested when Tommy embarks on a nude photography project. In response, Alice chooses to pose for another photographer, setting off a series of events that forces them to confront their deepest desires and insecurities.

movie:tt36271367.name: Summer of '94
movie:tt36271367.description: When the World Cup landed in the U.S. in 1994, it arrived in a country with no league, no culture, and no clue. A ragtag group of players faced an impossible task: don't embarrass their nation in front of the entire world.

movie:tt31307458.name: Good News
movie:tt31307458.description: Journalist Leo goes to Thailand to report on rebel groups.

movie:tt44120119.name: Last Stream
movie:tt44120119.description: Desperate for views, a fading streamer stages a fake haunting connected to an unsolved case. The stream spirals into a real-time nightmare watched by tens of thousands and someone in the chat seems to know exactly how the night will end.

movie:tt27774593.name: Love in Storytown
movie:tt27774593.description: When a single mother decides to leave the military and moves to a town known for storytelling for a settled life with her son, she meets a childhood friend who is the worst choice to fall in love with: a wandering storyteller.

movie:tt36364104.name: Minnie’s Midnight Massacre
movie:tt36364104.description: Steamboat Willie’s first mate, Minnie, goes on a killing spree when seeking revenge against the childhood bullies who tortured her as a teenager.

movie:tt23857028.name: Apnas
movie:tt23857028.description: A British Asian Mancunian is drawn in to the criminal underworld by his notorious uncle. Everything is at stake as his competition with his cousin reaches a deadly level.

movie:tt26234108.name: Vaa Vaathiyaar
movie:tt26234108.description: After being raised as the reincarnation of a famous actor, a man finds himself clashing with his grandfather's expectations of him.

movie:tt32476176.name: The Big Whoop
movie:tt32476176.description: Three washed-up clowns struggling to book gigs in a world that doesn't want clowns anymore come into possession of a stolen Egyptian artifact and face-off with the tough thief who will stop at nothing to get it back.

movie:tt17331248.name: Georgia Peach
movie:tt17331248.description: A nurse in recovery from alcoholism must confront her past and her brother's growing demands, risking everything she's worked for to reclaim her life or lose it all to her inner demons.

movie:tt40835343.name: Missing 411 National Parks: Washington State
movie:tt40835343.description: Washington State follows investigator David Paulides as he examines a series of unexplained disappearances in and around Mount Rainier and Olympic National Park, where hikers, climbers, and experienced outdoorsmen vanish without tracks, scent trails, or clear cause. Through interviews with families, witnesses, and search personnel the film contrasts known environmental dangers - severe weather, terrain, and hypothermia - with unsettling anomalies. Some of these include aircraft debris fields, unusual patterns in search failures, eyewitness encounters, and reported aerial phenomena dating back to the 1946 Curtis Commando crash and the dawn of the modern UFO era. As grief-stricken families search for closure and investigators compare evidence against established "profile points," the documentary challenges viewers to consider whether these cases can be explained by nature alone - or if something unknown operates within the wilderness.

movie:tt36390771.name: Dropbear
movie:tt36390771.description: A group of US tourists on a cheap Aussie outback tour discover the scam's fake dropbear attack has led them into the lair of a real, flesh-hungry koala king and his rabid army.

movie:tt33565384.name: Love & Trouble
movie:tt33565384.description: A young couple get married with high ideals and hidden pasts. An intimate exploration of traumas and how to negotiate shame, anger and love.

movie:tt33130645.name: The Streak
movie:tt33130645.description: In 1987, a team of outsiders attempt to break a hallowed baseball record in a desperate bid  for fame, fortune, and careers in the major leagues. Even if they succeed, no athlete can  play forever — and what comes after the death of a dream?

movie:tt39195804.name: Vishnu Vinyasam
movie:tt39195804.description: A superstitious man confronts his deepest convictions when he discovers that the woman he has fallen for has a dark secret.

movie:tt37334134.name: Aladdin's Revenge
movie:tt37334134.description: After the events of the first films, Rachel, the lone survivor of Aladdin, finds the lamp once more haunting her as she attends a therapy retreat. She must protect a new set of friends as the lamp's evil plan to grant three deadly wishes begins all over again.

movie:tt30274534.name: Haunted House of Pancakes
movie:tt30274534.description: On Halloween night an evil waffle maker transforms all the food in a sleazy diner into killer creatures out for revenge against the patrons.

movie:tt9617752.name: Mr. Jimmy
movie:tt9617752.description: Akio Sakurai has dedicated his life to honoring Jimmy Page. For 30 years he recreated vintage Zeppelin concerts note-for-note in small Tokyo clubs. Moving to L.A. to pursue his tribute dream, cultures clash and Akio’s idyllic vision meets reality.

movie:tt7502582.name: Lilith
movie:tt7502582.description: A family sequesters themselves in a high-rise apartment after the mysterious death of their daughter Lilith. Haunted by their past, the survivor's lies, deceits and strange behavior will have you asking: who killed Lilith and who will be next?

movie:tt26776720.name: Amityvillenado
movie:tt26776720.description: In the wake of a devastating storm that destroys the infamous DeFeo house, a paranormal entity merges with a malevolent tornado, unleashing an otherworldly force upon the town of Amityville.

movie:tt32397514.name: Rhino King
movie:tt32397514.description: James, a jobless husband, grapples with strained marriage as wife Sarah's career thrives. Left behind, he embarks on self-discovery journey, seeking purpose and worth amidst unfulfilled dreams and marital turmoil.

movie:tt35102335.name: Fans Only: The Human Side of Porn
movie:tt35102335.description: In an access-all-areas journey through the adult film industry, Joel Van der Molen teams up with porn legend Tommy Gunn to challenge stereotypes, uncover personal stories, and explore the human side of a misunderstood world.

movie:tt6788512.name: The Hail Mary
movie:tt6788512.description: Sister Kathy finds an angry loner in need of redemption and leads him to his atonement by conning him into creating a football team for her Catholic School.

movie:tt34911155.name: Unexpected Christmas
movie:tt34911155.description: Fresh off a recent breakup, Marissa Scott's return home takes an unexpected twist when her ex-boyfriend Richard arrives at the family gathering arm in arm with her estranged stepsister Kerry.

movie:tt22771584.name: Down to the Felt
movie:tt22771584.description: In Columbus Ohio, Paul, a chronic gambler, and David, a haunted hitman, make a pact for Paul’s scheduled death in two weeks. However, once Paul begins to find something to live for, he begins to have second thoughts.

movie:tt36820647.name: Peeping Todd
movie:tt36820647.description: When his peeping passions become compromised, Todd decides he’ll do whatever it takes to continue stalking his beloved Claire. An obsessive HOA fleet and a dense boyfriend are obstacles Todd must dance around if he wants to sing his way into Claire’s heart. As Claire gets wrapped up in the lies of her fiancé and the web of her stalker, she must escape the two most toxic relationships she’s ever faced.

movie:tt29553065.name: Princess for a Day
movie:tt29553065.description: A wealthy widower hires a small-town girl to live in his guesthouse and pretend to be a famous cartoon princess, in order to draw his little girl out of a deep depression, caused by the death of her mother.

movie:tt26756998.name: El Tonto Por Cristo
movie:tt26756998.description: A monk in a monastery on the coast of Texas embraces the life of a holy fool.

movie:tt29444671.name: Dilli Dark
movie:tt29444671.description: Michael Okeke, a Nigerian living in New Delhi wants to get his MBA and settle in India. But his part-time job as a drug dealer will jeopardize his plans, not to mention the open racism he is facing.

movie:tt37547564.name: Secret Sins
movie:tt37547564.description: After the death of his father, a pastor's son takes the lead, but a power-hungry deacon plots his ruin in a tale of faith, ambition, and betrayal.

movie:tt38553246.name: Anaconda: Blood Coil
movie:tt38553246.description: A group of friends are terrorized by an anaconda during their vacation.

movie:tt43685971.name: Pallaburusu
movie:tt43685971.description: A 70 year old widower asks his son to buy him a toothbrush for his toothache. When the son fails to do this simple errand, their already strained father-son relationship becomes comically worse through a series of escalating events.

movie:tt35661304.name: Burned Edges
movie:tt35661304.description: Burned Edges is a culinary drama about ambition pushed too far.  Inside the relentless heat of a pizza kitchen, a driven chef sacrifices sleep, love, and loyalty in pursuit of greatness slowly burning the very relationships that once grounded him.  It’s a story about overwork, obsession, and the cost of chasing a dream without knowing when to stop.

movie:tt37018920.name: Poster Boy: Becoming Zyzz
movie:tt37018920.description: Explores the rise, impact, and enduring mythology of Aziz Shavershian – “Zyzz” – the unlikely internet icon whose transformation from anonymous teenager to global symbol of fitness culture reshaped how a generation defines influencers, identity, and self-invention.

movie:tt22889888.name: The Unlock
movie:tt22889888.description: A Russian diplomat is kidnapped and his driver may be the only person who knows his whereabouts, but he has amnesia. Now 2 people have a race against time to unlock his mind before the diplomat is executed and the world plunges into war.

movie:tt14624678.name: Ether's Paradise
movie:tt14624678.description: An American girl in Thailand has a secret romance at a hidden waterfall with a local fisherman boy. Her father rips her away from the boy, but 10 years later, she returns to Thailand in search of a person and a place she once lost as a kid.

movie:tt37528681.name: Last Known Backup
movie:tt37528681.description: Enigmatic devices shatter five timelines, altering the lives of Steve, Ray, Verona, Oakley, Xiomara, Mitch, and Dominica. As chaos spreads, they're forced to rise, facing the unknown to reclaim their futures-and stop what's coming.

movie:tt38111710.name: Carmeni Selvam
movie:tt38111710.description: A content man's life turns chaotic when money fever strikes. His newfound greed leads to a series of amusing situations that unfold in this humorous tale.

movie:tt38675979.name: Fugs Film!
movie:tt38675979.description: In 1960s New York City, radical rock band The Fugs channels the raw energy of counterculture rebellion through their provocative music and anti-establishment stance.

movie:tt36410586.name: Rahu Ketu
movie:tt36410586.description: In the magical world of writer Churu Lal Sharma, his unlucky creations Rahu and Ketu spring to life, causing hilarious chaos instead of fighting corruption. When the mischievous Meenu Taxi steals Churu's mystical notebook, the bumbling duo are dragged into absurd adventures that land them in the middle of a drug mafia.

movie:tt35168834.name: Paradise Records
movie:tt35168834.description: Cooper is trying to keep the doors of Paradise Records open with its motley crew of entertaining employees, even as the world works against him.

movie:tt36735046.name: Christmas Roses
movie:tt36735046.description: A grieving young girl and a reclusive woman form an unlikely bond during Christmas, helping each other rediscover joy and find healing through the season's magic.

movie:tt34498581.name: Sense & Sensibility: A Modern Retelling
movie:tt34498581.description: Elle and Mare are opposites-steady vs. impulsive, cautious vs. romantic. Yet after their father's death, their clashing ways help balance each other through sorrow and love, showing that sisterhood is the strongest when differences unite.

movie:tt43662509.name: Dread
movie:tt43662509.description: Terror takes many forms. In five chilling tales, the mundane becomes monstrous and no one gets out clean.

movie:tt12317180.name: A Social Contract
movie:tt12317180.description: A Fourth of July dinner turns deadly when a nuclear strike is announced. A helicopter is coming for Senator Wilde—but only three others can join him. Guests fight to prove who deserves a seat before time runs out.

movie:tt33994243.name: D(e)ad
movie:tt33994243.description: Tillie, a floundering young woman and her charismatic, alcoholic father, struggle to resolve their fractured relationship in the weirdest possible way: after he dies, his ghost appears in mirrors to haunt everyone in the family but Tillie. The family must do everything they can to make Tillie see her father or else they will be plagued by this ghost forever.

movie:tt31158218.name: Etched In Pavement
movie:tt31158218.description: In a remote corner of Detroit, where the streets echo with both hardship and hope, two young men turn fighting into a language of survival, purpose and community.  Filmed over four years, Etched In Pavement follows Dwane Taylor and Michael Futrell whose weaving paths move through youth combat sports, professional boxing and their grassroots Guns Down, Gloves Up street-fighting movement. As they navigate fatherhood, loss, and those who came before, the film becomes an intimate portrait of generations caught between violence and purpose, survival and legacy.

movie:tt29289178.name: Signs of Life
movie:tt29289178.description: A grieving woman is rescued by a lonely traveller after a dangerous encounter on holiday.

movie:tt38813309.name: Sundown
movie:tt38813309.description: Three gold miners searching for riches find a forgotten town. To survive the night, they must obey its bizarre rules, where every mistake is fatal.

movie:tt8205190.name: Gandhi Talks
movie:tt8205190.description: A young, unemployed graduate Mahadev's struggles to land a job through any means possible and crosses paths with a businessman and petty thief.

movie:tt28545861.name: Anomalies 3: Killer Tapes
movie:tt28545861.description: Police have discovered a compound linked to a series of unsolved murders. Footage was found of a cult group living out their horror fantasies.

movie:tt38715593.name: Lake Rockaway
movie:tt38715593.description: "Some lakes are for swimming...This lake is the resting place for hundreds of innocent young women's souls." Welcome to Lake Rockaway a small, isolated, country town that has kept many secrets for decades.

movie:tt30260723.name: Go Deep: The DeSean Jackson Story
movie:tt30260723.description: Based on footage that Byron Jackson, the brother of DeSean Jackson, started recording thirty years ago. "After DeSean's unexpected ascent from a nine-year-old Pop Warner prodigy to one of the greatest wide receivers in NFL history".

movie:tt15017510.name: Sunday at Il Posto Accanto
movie:tt15017510.description: Sunday at Il Posto Accanto is a deeply personal, hybrid film blending documentary techniques with narrative storytelling. Set in a beloved East Village restaurant during the early days of reopening after the pandemic, it stars Victor Rasuk, Danny Hoch, and the real people who made the place a sanctuary for community. At once funny and poignant, the film is a meditation on grief, resilience, and the small rituals—both absurd and sacred—that keep us connected. It’s rich with character, brimming with the kind of imperfect charm only real life can deliver. Il Posto is about a neighborhood, a family—chosen and otherwise—and the quiet beauty of coming together after isolation. Made on a modest budget with a lot of heart, it captures a moment in time when the simple act of gathering felt nothing short of holy.

movie:tt38066403.name: Rent Free
movie:tt38066403.description: He thought he found a place to stay rent free… but nothing in life is free.  Marcus, a smooth-talking hustler, moves in with Shay, a quiet therapist hiding a dark past. But when his plan to con her is exposed, he quickly realizes he’s not in control. Trapped inside her apartment, Marcus is forced into a twisted game where every move comes with consequences and escape may cost him everything.

movie:tt38589710.name: Bride of Frankenstein Awakens
movie:tt38589710.description: In a quiet British seaside town, Santana, a troubled young woman desperate to escape her suffocating family, runs away with her volatile boyfriend Frank. The pair marry in a rundown coastal venue, hoping for a fresh start — but their new life is shattered when a mysterious car rams into them on a rural night road, killing Santana instantly and leaving Frank consumed by grief and obsession. Refusing to accept her death, Frank traps his former medical professor, Dr. Pret — a man secretly infatuated with Santana — and forces him to help reanimate her using a stolen voodoo ritual. As Frank’s desperation deepens, he manipulates and blackmails Pret into harvesting “perfect” body parts from Santana’s own family, driving both men further into depravity.

movie:tt10462682.name: Taming the Beast
movie:tt10462682.description: The world strongest man learns how to embrace his mental health challenges by confronting his inner demons and dealing with his biggest failure to date which ultimately changes his life.

movie:tt31417054.name: KJQ
movie:tt31417054.description: Two close friends become entangled in a high-stakes conflict driven by power, ego, and vengeance, exploring how circumstances shape human nature.

movie:tt36076924.name: Jonesing: When Love Is a Habit
movie:tt36076924.description: Simone is a young poet and college senior navigating love and self-discovery while witnessing the unraveling of her parents’ once-revered relationship. Her father, a world-renowned author whose words once defined a generation’s understanding of love, and her mother, a sought-after creative director celebrated for capturing the essence of intimacy through her lens, built a life shaped by passion, artistry, and devotion until the foundation began to crack. As their love story fades from the idealized lens of the public into the stark reality of divorce, Simone begins to question whether love is ever as real as it seems. Now in her final year of college, she stands at the crossroads between the creative world she was born into and the growing disillusionment in her heart. Just as she prepares to give up on the idea of love altogether, she meets Myles, a charismatic transfer athlete with unexpected emotional depth.

movie:tt40123420.name: Francisco Ramos: Still Learning
movie:tt40123420.description: Francisco Ramos: Still Learning dives into the lessons that don't come with instructions: marriage, therapy, eating with other people, and even learning how to dance in the U.S. From cultural misunderstandings to relationship realizations, the special explores how we're all still learning… especially when we think we've got it figured out.

movie:tt37847989.name: Mudrasta: Ang Beking Ina
movie:tt37847989.description: Victor "Beki" Labrador and Enrique Santillanes were once high-school sweethearts. Years later, Beki is shocked to discover that Enrique's final will grants him half of the estate and control of the family business— with one outrageous condition: he must move into a mansion and live with Enrique's orphanes sons and their sharp-tongued grandmother. What more could possibly go wrong?

movie:tt27798637.name: Superbloom
movie:tt27798637.description: A poignant road trip story of two women—one confronting her past, the other searching for purpose—whose journey becomes a transformative discovery of healing and connection.

movie:tt36590507.name: Music Box: Wizkid: Long Live Lagos
movie:tt36590507.description: From Lagos to London, this powerful documentary follows Wizkid’s rise as a global icon reshaping how Africa is seen — and heard — around the world. Blending intimate moments, explosive performances, and cultural commentary, the film captures how Wizkid is using his platform to change perceptions, reclaim African identity, and inspire a new generation.

movie:tt34510166.name: If These Walls Could Rock
movie:tt34510166.description: Rock stars, wild parties, and untold stories come alive at LA's iconic Sunset Marquis hotel, where music legends created unforgettable moments during the hedonistic peak of '70s and '80s rock culture.

movie:tt29728906.name: Diabolical
movie:tt29728906.description: Jessica grew up with a mother plagued by inexplicable psychological issues. Years later, Jessica begins to experience the same disturbing symptoms and she starts to suspect that the cause isn't psychological but something evil.

movie:tt39785725.name: Insidious Tales
movie:tt39785725.description: Across six chilling stories, strangers face the terrifying consequences of their choices as a creeping nightmare begins to invade their lives.

movie:tt31511146.name: Doctor Plague
movie:tt31511146.description: Jaded detective John Verney is on the trail of an ancient cult of Plague Doctors which is cutting a bloody swathe through the London underworld. Dismissed by his superiors as gang on gang killings, the murders draw Verney into an obsessive maze of a secret society conspiracy with links to the Jack The Ripper murders of 1888, putting him and his family in grave danger.

movie:tt36442417.name: Cathedrals
movie:tt36442417.description: In CATHEDRALS, filmmaker Dan Algrant embarks on a journey to reconnect with two black collaborators from a film made nearly 50 years ago. CATHEDRALS becomes a powerful exploration of the bonds that tie us together and the experiences that shape our identities. Through the lens of a creative collaboration, the film illuminates the struggles and triumphs that define life in a close-knit community, ultimately reaffirming the importance of human connection and the power of collective memory.

movie:tt35904865.name: Distort
movie:tt35904865.description: A musician recording an album in the woods finds mysterious cassette tapes being left for him. On them, a woman researching an urban legend was being terrorised by a man and his vicious dog. Now, those same things are happening to the musician...

movie:tt32542065.name: Moses the Black
movie:tt32542065.description: A gangster in modern day Chicago, inspired by the repentance story of the fourth-century saint of the same name.

movie:tt36997965.name: Playing with Fire: An Ecosexual Emergency
movie:tt36997965.description: From the creators of the first queer environmental documentary feature films comes a hot new offering. The third chapter is their most epic and daring yet — fusing art, activism, and intimate storytelling in a touching journey through crisis, change, and renewal. When a firestorm rips through their redwood forest home, two artist-activists — Beth Stephens & Annie Sprinkle —emerge with a powerful message of love, resilience, and ecological hope, guided by a relationship with their magical peacock.

movie:tt34554826.name: Mona Mur in Conversation
movie:tt34554826.description: The film explores the life and career of the Hamburg-born musician, whose creative work began in the West German post-punk scene of the 1980s.

movie:tt28289030.name: Hunter Among Us
movie:tt28289030.description: A group video call unhinges when one friend threatens suicide online. Next - hijacking their feed, a masked hacker turns the group’s desperate attempts to save their friend into a sadistic mind game.

movie:tt37916864.name: The Penance
movie:tt37916864.description: In a corrupt city, two ex-mercenaries, Trav and Stephano, are haunted by the ghosts of their past. When their younger sister is abducted and trafficked by a cartel, the brothers launch a desperate mission to bring her home. But their rescue erupts into bloodshed when she is tragically murdered before their eyes.

movie:tt27607454.name: Cracking the Code: Phil Sharp and the Biotech Revolution
movie:tt27607454.description: The 1977 discovery of RNA splicing by Dr. Phillip A. Sharp, Kentucky farm boy turned Nobel-prize winning scientist, set the stage for a revolution in molecular biology, enabling research into a new class of medicines predicated on recombinant DNA techniques ranging from the development of synthetic insulin and human growth hormone to the COVID-19 vaccine.

movie:tt20425286.name: The Ground Beneath Our Feet
movie:tt20425286.description: Emma Bryant feels swallowed by the growing darkness of today's culture. Forced to move in with her grandpa, she stumbles upon an old diary that transports her into a world far different from her own. There, Emma realizes something vital is missing in the 21st century. Determined to uncover it, she searches tirelessly—only to learn it cannot be acquired, but must be received.

movie:tt43499258.name: Golem.AI
movie:tt43499258.description: Two estranged friends reconnect over video chat to repair their relationship, but when they open their favorite retro online shooter, they unleash a digital nightmare that seeks revenge for their history online.

movie:tt38047580.name: The Power of Pickleball
movie:tt38047580.description: "The Power of Pickleball" tells the story of a humble game that spread into a cultural phenomenon by bringing people together across generations, backgrounds, and walks of life. Centered on the passionate individuals who helped build the sport from the ground up, the film celebrates pickleball's unique ability to create community, spark joy, and change lives in unexpected ways.

movie:tt35684482.name: 2020 Delhi
movie:tt35684482.description: 2020 Delhi, India's first one-shot feature, inspired by anti-CAA protests, the 2020 Delhi riots, and the conspiracies surrounding them, while also highlighting the plight of Hindu minorities in Pakistan and Bangladesh. a story of survival.

movie:tt32658507.name: Mermaid's Curse 2: Return of the Witch
movie:tt32658507.description: Serena, a mysterious woman with a dark secret, arrives in a coastal town where men mysteriously disappear. Local journalist Dylan falls for her, unaware of her ties to deadly sirens who lure and kill. As Dylan and his brother Connor investigate the disappearances for a story, Connor's jealousy and obsession with Serena lead him to a deadly encounter. The brothers’ quest to uncover the truth places them in a perilous clash between love, betrayal, and ancient horrors lurking beneath the sea.

movie:tt40355764.name: The Secret Between Us
movie:tt40355764.description: A man admired for his integrity watches his perfect life unravel when an unexpected visitor shows up at his front door and forces him to confront the painful consequences of his past betrayal.

movie:tt35652701.name: Horror in the High Desert 4: Majesty
movie:tt35652701.description: On a desolate Nevada ranch, a woman uncovers a long-buried box. What's inside begins to expose a terrifying history she was never meant to find.

movie:tt35932382.name: À demain sur la Lune
movie:tt35932382.description: An ordinary woman finds hope and an unexpected friend in her last months on Earth. A sensual film about life and death, where gratitude gets the last word.

movie:tt29502644.name: Kerouac's Road: The Beat of a Nation
movie:tt29502644.description: Jack Kerouac's "On the Road" finds new relevance as modern travelers and cultural figures like Josh Brolin, W. Kamau Bell and Natalie Merchant reveal how his quest for authentic experience resonates powerfully in our screen-saturated era — offering a lyrical meditation on what it means to truly experience the journey.

movie:tt31329590.name: Unbanked
movie:tt31329590.description: A global bitcoin documentary by David Kuhn and Lauren Sieckmann.

movie:tt38525039.name: S. Saraswathi
movie:tt38525039.description: A devoted mother whose life is shattered when her 12-year-old daughter goes missing. Desperate for answers, she turns to the police for help, but as the investigation unfolds, unexpected twists begin to deepen the mystery.

movie:tt36823510.name: Christmas Snowed in with a Prince
movie:tt36823510.description: During a freak blizzard, a remote British lodge is shut down with just two guests: Ellie, a sarcastic travel blogger, and a handsome, overly polite guest who's definitely not from around here. Turns out, he's Prince Alaric, stranded while trying to escape royal duties. With only each other and no Wi-Fi, sparks (and snowballs) fly.

movie:tt37068058.name: Baltimore Hustle
movie:tt37068058.description: Set against the gritty yet vibrant backdrop of Charm City, Baltimore Hustle is a powerful ensemble drama that captures the heartbeat of a city built on resilience, loyalty, and the unbreakable will to rise.

movie:tt38588956.name: The Dragon's Prophecy
movie:tt38588956.description: October 7 unleashed a new war in the Middle East, a place where nothing ever seems to be solved, or resolved. Whose land is it really? Who is good and who is evil? How can good prevail over evil without becoming evil itself? Could the fate of the world, of humanity itself, be tied to this conflict? And how does America fit into the picture?  Based on Jonathan Cahn’s #1 international bestseller, The Dragon’s Prophecy.  The film offers dramatic, never-before-seen live footage of October 7, together with on-site reporting and interviews with major figures like Israeli prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu and U.S. ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee. It also reveals the astonishing discoveries of biblical archeology, confirming the historic events recorded in the Bible and the ancient presence of the Jews in the land of Israel.

movie:tt30490877.name: Mother Nature and the Doomsday Prepper
movie:tt30490877.description: 100% Popcorn Meter. A whimsical mythic romp for the whole family. Doomsday preppers, the Coast Guard, dolphins, and quirky Greek gods help a nerdy mortal Tween teach Zeus and Mother Nature about the plight of the earth.

movie:tt43134711.name: Ramba Oorvasi Menaka
movie:tt43134711.description: A man spends 15 years attempting to use a magical book to summon the celestial angels Ramba, Urvasi, and Menaka to earth, but Lord Indra blocks their descent until they finally arrive.

movie:tt31849452.name: Flood
movie:tt31849452.description: After being released from jail, Remi aims to do the right thing until his criminal brother is kidnapped, forcing Remi back into his old ways.

movie:tt4558024.name: American Criminals
movie:tt4558024.description: Chicago 1924. A prosperous city Thriving in the midst of racial and political turmoil. Two precocious wealthy teenage scholars, Nathan Leopold and Richard Loeb, kidnap and murder a fourteen-year-old boy, Bobby Franks.

movie:tt37679066.name: Dinosaur Hunt
movie:tt37679066.description: A rich family are brought together to a remote island for a reunion, only to learn that their father has been experimenting with dinosaurs in an attempt to find a cure for his disease. This family are forced to work together when the dinosaurs escape.

movie:tt11725866.name: Pretty Ugly: The Story of the Lunachicks
movie:tt11725866.description: Punk music icons, Lunachicks, reunite after 20 years in an unfiltered, hilarious, and electric documentary. Packed with rare archival footage, the film traces their rise from gritty NYC teens to feminist trailblazers of the 90s grunge era. Fans and newcomers alike will thrill as the band recounts old antics, rekindles bonds, and embarks on their long-awaited journey back to the stage.

movie:tt33069174.name: The Raftsmen
movie:tt33069174.description: Twelve men from seven countries embark on a seemingly impossible mission - to cross the world's largest ocean on three handmade wooden rafts. Fifty years later, the survivors finally tell the story of the world's longest raft journey.

movie:tt38782916.name: Soulmates
movie:tt38782916.description: A carefree rickshaw driver’s life changes when a don targets him and a European tourist, Isa, joins him to test her fiancé’s love. As they journey through Rajasthan’s deserts, havelis, and forts, their bond deepens—but soulmates don’t always stay together. A cross-cultural romance filled with adventure, magic, and longing.

movie:tt13318488.name: Seyran Ates: Sex, Revolution and Islam
movie:tt13318488.description: In the 1960s, the hippies championed the idea of a sexual revolution. They received neither Fatwas nor bodyguards. Today, Seyran Ates - a Turkish- German lawyer, feminist, and one of the first female imams in Europe - is fighting ...

movie:tt19891472.name: Stealing the Sky
movie:tt19891472.description: A mosaic of interlocking stories set against the backdrop of Toronto's swelling urban landscape.

movie:tt31888337.name: Pickleball Pete
movie:tt31888337.description: A washed-up tennis player enters a Palm Beach pickleball tournament in order to save his hometown courts from being torn down for a corporate office complex.

movie:tt27798101.name: The Last Sunday of High School
movie:tt27798101.description: The day after graduation, four high school friends reunite for one last hangout—revisiting old memories, ending an era, and looking into the unknown.

movie:tt35405436.name: Number 2
movie:tt35405436.description: The Queens are back! Facing the prospects of being phased out with their old gags, the team engage in sideline odd jobs to keep their livelihoods aﬂoat. Chee Beng, who is moonlighting as a property agent got into a bad altercation while being humiliated during one of his viewings. The result of this bad PR causes Chee Beng to be expelled from the drag community and barred from performing in Singapore. However, an opportunity arises, a drag competition in Thailand! Chee Beng pushes for the team to compete and regain their former glory while dealing with his rebellious teenage son, Mason.

movie:tt36437047.name: Abduct
movie:tt36437047.description: A woman's peaceful mountain getaway takes a bizarre turn when her boyfriend disappears, and a random naked man shows up claiming to be him.

movie:tt32654745.name: The Unrestricted War
movie:tt32654745.description: A top-tier Canadian virologist and his Chinese wife are suddenly arrested by military secret agents in Beijing. He is threatened with the task of stealing a sample of his own work from his former laboratory, and the situation rapidly turns worse when people begin to fall ill.

movie:tt28085421.name: Without a Doubt
movie:tt28085421.description: Two months into her second pregnancy, a young mother receives a stage 4 inflammatory breast cancer diagnosis. She must choose between saving her child's life or undergoing intense chemotherapy and radiation treatment.

movie:tt29383607.name: Tale of the Forest Unicorn
movie:tt29383607.description: After the tragic loss of her parents, Violet discovers a Unicorn in the mystical forest near her Aunt and Uncle's cottage. This sparks her to undergo a mission to save the forest from local property developers.

movie:tt30984804.name: Deadbeat
movie:tt30984804.description: Journey into the lives of Father's fighting to be with their children. As they face an uphill battle against a biased system pushing a Fatherless agenda. Wrongfully Accused, False Accusations, Child Support and Meritless Restraining Orders

movie:tt37513740.name: Land of Shadows
movie:tt37513740.description: Following a tragic event that shattered her life, renowned author Alice Chevalier struggles to find meaning in her existence. Searching for answers and a sign from destiny, she meets Thomas, a mysterious man who offers her an experience that defies the boundaries of reality. Driven by the hope of rebuilding herself, Alice embarks on a mystical journey, like an astronaut venturing into the far reaches of the unknown.

movie:tt39122419.name: Happy Raj
movie:tt39122419.description: A city romance meets a rural family invasion. What follows is chaos, comedy, and heartfelt moments. The story unfolds as a joyful entertainer that explores love, cultural clashes, and the importance of family bonds.

movie:tt32331539.name: Beyond Belief
movie:tt32331539.description: An aspiring teenage rock star trains for a marathon after hearing a mysterious voice.

movie:tt37276380.name: Bigfoot Primal Fear
movie:tt37276380.description: A group camping trip in the woods turns into their worst nightmare as they soon realize they are not alone out there, and someone or something is hunting them. Every step could be their last as they try to escape their fate.

movie:tt34623398.name: They Wait in Shadows
movie:tt34623398.description: Two sisters returning to their family home after their mother's death, only to confront the monsters they accidentally conjured with a Ouija board.

movie:tt36817729.name: October 7: Bearing Witness to the Massacre
movie:tt36817729.description: A feature documentary film on the history of Gaza and the horrific events of October 7, 2023 that shook the world.

movie:tt10172522.name: Fluorescent Beast
movie:tt10172522.description: A man is sent on a clandestine business trip by a shadowy executive. The details of the journey withheld even from him, the man must follow a series of mysterious clues to uncover the true nature of his mission.

movie:tt35534649.name: Björk: Cornucopia
movie:tt35534649.description: A visually spectacular landscape of lush colours, futuristic screens and wild images of nature that comes alive with Björk's wondrous music, as she performs live alongside musicians and choirs of flutes and voices.

movie:tt37391453.name: Khalid Ka Shivaji
movie:tt37391453.description: Khalid, a 5th standard student is teased by his classmates because of his religion after a chapter on Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj was being studied. "Why do the children tease me by the name of Afzal Khan? Just because I am a Muslim? Was every Muslim an enemy of Shivaji Maharaj like Afzal Khan?" Khalid's curiousity and fascination with Shivaji Maharaj sends him and his family on a life-altering journey.

movie:tt32751074.name: Forgiveness Girl
movie:tt32751074.description: A little girl with cerebral palsy is relentlessly bullied throughout her life, yet finds it in her heart to forgive by seeking strength from a higher source above.

movie:tt15160410.name: Lure
movie:tt15160410.description: After being invited to a party by a mysterious and alluring woman, six men awake to find themselves part of a cult family's gruesome annual tradition to find the perfect suitor.

movie:tt37799980.name: Gator Face
movie:tt37799980.description: Booze, Blood and Gators. A broke-down swamper with a bottle in one hand and a blade in the other learns the hard way that rage will rot your soul.

movie:tt32242519.name: Lone Star Shark
movie:tt32242519.description: A group of virtual hunters unleash a deadly shark in a Texas lake, causing a young couple to fight for their lives during a peaceful fishing trip in a secluded cove.

movie:tt20257536.name: Snorkeling
movie:tt20257536.description: Snorkeling is an authentic coming-of-age film about love, addiction, and mental health. All of us - especially young people - fear loneliness and isolation. Teenagers Michael and Jameson explore these haunting subjects together. As their romance blossoms, a new hallucinogenic street drug called Snorkeling concocts a fantasy where the user feels invincible. They can interact with the world without fear or inhibition - a true out-of-body experience. When taking a drug this powerful, what are the possibilities - and the dangers? Through his trippy, colorful recreation of the euphoria and tragedy of drug dependency, director Emil Nava takes us on a unique journey of adolescent self-discovery.

movie:tt43617102.name: Drags to Riches
movie:tt43617102.description: Andre and Troye orchestrate a wild scheme for a promotion: they force a drag queen named Jonas to impersonate his long-lost straight twin to fool their homophobic father.

movie:tt35996799.name: Content
movie:tt35996799.description: Shown through phones, laptops, & webcams, a seemingly polite director stalks and blackmails his actors into living a real-life horror movie.

movie:tt36546626.name: SKIT
movie:tt36546626.description: In 2007, at the dawn of user-generated content, three female college students are determined to make a viral YouTube video.

movie:tt37096169.name: I'm Not Into Golden Showers!
movie:tt37096169.description: A fresh look at the FBI's investigation into the 2016 Trump Campaign and its many contacts with the Russians. What triggered the investigation, and what did it find? And why - apropos of nothing - does Donald Trump keep bringing up that salacious rumor about Russian prostitutes in a Moscow hotel? Narrated by Stormy Daniels, star witness at the 2024 trial that resulted in Trump being convicted of 34 felonies. —Joe Ayella

movie:tt38038820.name: Wizard of Death: Tinman's Rise
movie:tt38038820.description: A family outing spirals into a fight for survival against the Tin Man, a heart-hungry machine risen from the ruins of Oz.

movie:tt13091698.name: Pomegranate
movie:tt13091698.description: A young, politically liberal, Iraqi Muslim immigrant struggles to find her footing in a neighborhood of well-to-do conservative, Iraqi Christians while battling her family's fears of deprivation and demands of loyalty to Muslim traditions.

movie:tt10951760.name: Teller's Camp
movie:tt10951760.description: A prospector and his son battle vengeful bandits over a disputed claim during the California Gold Rush.

movie:tt15210538.name: Dug Dug
movie:tt15210538.description: Mysterious events in the wake of a freak motorcycle accident sow the seeds of a new religion.

movie:tt28692368.name: His Father's Son
movie:tt28692368.description: An Iranian-Canadian family struggles to reconcile with their past after news of an unexpected inheritance.

movie:tt43710022.name: Reptilians: They Walk Among Us
movie:tt43710022.description: They wear our faces, shape our destiny, and have waited through the ages for the perfect moment to rise, igniting a spiritual battle for our future.

movie:tt32116651.name: Semolina Pilchard
movie:tt32116651.description: As a terminally ill Liverpool gangster summons his estranged eldest daughter back to their hometown after a five-year absence, his youngest daughter, determined to inherit everything, plots to eliminate her.

movie:tt14694672.name: An American Abroad
movie:tt14694672.description: Visit Greece, Africa, and Amsterdam and more in this hilarious rom-com about a free spirited travel host and her uptight boyfriend's wild love story. Marcia's lust for adventure has Arnold on a walking safari, swimming with sharks and wine tasting in France, but will it all be too much for him when she really gets weird? He’s a bit conservative, a bit square, and she’s into psychics, dancing in the street, and getting her Minister’s License just for the wine discount. As Marcia’s travel show takes the two of them through 7 exotic countries, what at first seemed like a dream come true, might turn into a relationship nightmare. Will they be able to find enough common ground to get them through the insanity and realize true love or will the crew mutiny before they get the chance?

movie:tt2906058.name: Romancing Sydney
movie:tt2906058.description: George works in an antique shop run by Lilli. George also has a secret that's consumed many years of his life, a secret that would shock everyone. Elisa is young and sweet. Sachin is dreamy and naive. A disaster for both becomes love at first sight. Will fate keep them together? Zac and Alex are tight. Their relationship blossomed amidst dance and gymnastics. But can someone truly be that sure? Through a saga intertwined with dance pieces, six individuals embrace their emotions in Sydney.

movie:tt13153584.name: Renner
movie:tt13153584.description: A computer genius invents an A.I life coach to help him find love, but realizes too late he accidentally programmed his manipulative mother into the code.

movie:tt31227486.name: Pinkerton
movie:tt31227486.description: The story or Alan Pinkerton, who along with his agents, became America's first private detectives.

movie:tt14984912.name: The Aryan Papers
movie:tt14984912.description: Stuttgart, 1942: Nazis have cleared Jewish communities from towns and Villages. Two German-born Jewish children flee Nazis who have killed their family, escorted by Gisella, part of the Lebensborn, an SS Master Race program.

movie:tt32495339.name: The Taj Story
movie:tt32495339.description: Vishnu Das is a local guide who becomes driven by a curiosity to uncover the true history behind the iconic Taj Mahal monument.

movie:tt38984885.name: Betty's Revenge
movie:tt38984885.description: Three college seniors venture to the abandoned Dizzy Dishes cabaret club while researching its fiery past. They encounter the former owner, Betty — who claims to be half woman, half “something else.”

movie:tt37273405.name: Mithra Mandali
movie:tt37273405.description: The lives of a group of misfit friends become chaotic after one of them falls for a politician's daughter.

movie:tt27953266.name: The Stress Is Killing Me
movie:tt27953266.description: At their 20th college reunion, eight old friends take a house for the week and decide to try doing their dream jobs: teacher, detective, sex therapist, instead of their boring jobs, and their dream jobs all go hilariously wrong.

movie:tt15426712.name: Last Shot
movie:tt15426712.description: 12-year-old basketball prodigy Caden Isaacs faces grief, identity issues, and high expectations. After the sudden death of his father and amid a strained relationship with his previously absent mother, the two must come to terms with their past and give their future one last shot.

movie:tt39708015.name: Gaayapadda Simham
movie:tt39708015.description: Follows Indians facing challenges while trying to travel to the USA and the struggles they encounter after reaching there.

movie:tt38162479.name: He Calls Me Daughter
movie:tt38162479.description: An exploration of women shaped by absent or broken fathers as they find healing, courage, and restored identity through God’s faithful love. Through raw and powerful stories, HE CALLS ME DAUGHTER reveals a timeless truth: A heavenly Father changes everything.

movie:tt38129252.name: Jiaoying Summers: What Specie Are You?
movie:tt38129252.description: It's the first comedy special from comedian and actress Jiaoying Summers, and sees her dissect what makes us different and what brings us together. Drawing from her life as a Chinese American and first-generation immigrant, she tackles topics like cultural clashes, immigrant identity and motherhood, among others.

movie:tt34577340.name: Mafianado
movie:tt34577340.description: A tornado wrecks havoc on the mafia

movie:tt27124646.name: Casey Makes A Mixtape
movie:tt27124646.description: A 13-year-old navigates teen life in a strange new Texas town while struggling to finish her prized summer '81 mixtape.

movie:tt42203456.name: Love Oh Love
movie:tt42203456.description: A couple is in love. One partner's excessive spending pushes the other into debt. When the burdened partner decides to seek a divorce, the other files a police complaint through the leader of a women's association. As they begin living together, they gradually understand each other's struggles. Eventually, they reconcile and choose to continue their life together.

movie:tt37245385.name: Dream Big: The Olympia Movie
movie:tt37245385.description: A global fascination with strength, human performance and physique transformation has created massive commerce, impacting regional economies throughout the world. At the top of this movement is the most prestigious fitness experience in the world - "The Olympia." Dream Big: The Olympia Movie celebrates 60 years of history, passion, and cultural impact behind bodybuilding's ultimate stage.

movie:tt48312118.name: The Seventh Day
movie:tt48312118.description: A group of travel journalist visit the quiet town of Willow Ridge to write a story about the Delaney family, known for their famous blueberry pies. But what they discovers during their stay will change everything.

movie:tt37529076.name: The Girl That Got Glue Stuck In Her Hair
movie:tt37529076.description: Learn what really happened during the “gorilla glue crisis”

movie:tt35943486.name: The Town That Drove Away
movie:tt35943486.description: ​​The historic village of Hasankeyf, a Kurdish majority settlement, is ordered to relocate after plans are made to build a dam. The stark beauty of the Anatolian landscape frames the devastated buildings, the site of a political game requiring obedience and submission. When all has disappeared, only a bitter and unsettling sense of dignity will remain.

movie:tt10919732.name: A Light Through Coloured Glass
movie:tt10919732.description: Soon after his wife has left him, William finds his life turned further upside down upon meeting Tina, a younger woman with problems of her own.

movie:tt36408254.name: Gangers
movie:tt36408254.description: An undercover cop teams up with a crooked PT Master to loot 100 crore from a corrupt politician.

movie:tt40570079.name: The Bowens: A Portrait of an American Family
movie:tt40570079.description: What does it take to raise an American family today? What kind of values should be instilled into children? Is the future too dangerous, unpredictable and grim? Meet The Bowens - a new kind of American family that decided to take matters into their hands and work together to navigate uncertainties of life through relentless self improvement, strength, discipline, and loyalty.

movie:tt29549087.name: Lady in the Locket
movie:tt29549087.description: A young woman inherits more than just a house as the spirit of her estranged, eccentric aunt lingers, desperate to lead her to uncover the family secret.

movie:tt36283648.name: Square Heads
movie:tt36283648.description: Brave and his friends, Four Eyes and Freckle, end up spending a fortune online after a few careless clicks, which throws Brave’s father into complete chaos. Hoping to fix what happened, Brave brings home an old watch he bought as a present. Out of nowhere, the watch activates and pulls the trio into a strange and surreal world. There they find themselves working for Ruhi, a strict and demanding boss who makes them earn every cent. To get back home, the kids have to stay alert, stick together and understand what the watch has dragged them into.

movie:tt30258830.name: Meteors
movie:tt30258830.description: A pair of friends rent a cabin to watch a meteor shower which triggers the end of the world.

movie:tt35497216.name: #WorstChristmasEver
movie:tt35497216.description: A divorced dad reluctantly joins his ex-wife's Christmas celebration in Atlanta for his kids' sake and unexpectedly meets someone who might help him believe in love again.

movie:tt32858056.name: Space Coast Confidential
movie:tt32858056.description: A veteran detective is paired with a transplant detective from Massachusetts to investigate strange occurrences in Cocoa Beach.

movie:tt40002751.name: The Odyssey: The Real Story
movie:tt40002751.description: After the fall of Troy, warrior-king Odysseus begins a perilous voyage home, only to be thrown into a decade of wandering across a world ruled by gods and monsters. He outwits cyclopes, resists enchantresses, and descends into the realm of the dead, while his family fights to survive in his absence.

movie:tt27720675.name: The Worst Film Festival Ever
movie:tt27720675.description: Recently dumped Alan, dreams of producing his own movies, but when his father suffers a heart attack, Alan is forced into running the Bargain basement Film Festival that Gabriel uses as a cynical money maker.

movie:tt27837220.name: Diamond Sky
movie:tt27837220.description: In this gripping romantic thriller, a desperate young couple, suffocated by their rigid lives, risk everything on a daring diamond heist that promises freedom and a fresh start.  But as their plan spins out of control and trust between them erodes, they're forced to confront a harsh reality: can love endure betrayal, violence, and fear, or was their dream of escape doomed from the very beginning?  When the stakes are life and death, the line between passion and destruction blurs beyond recognition.

movie:tt26764532.name: Dakar Chronicles
movie:tt26764532.description: Adrenaline-pumping races across multiple motorsports merge with intimate portraits of elite drivers and riders as they chase glory on the track.

movie:tt17079602.name: The Alien Report
movie:tt17079602.description: A life-long alien abductee figures out a clever way to record his alien encounters using a micro camera, and shares high-res video of telepathic beings, human hybrids and more.

movie:tt9674022.name: Under the Crystal Sky
movie:tt9674022.description: In the 1800s American Southwest, an Indigenous family witness an extraordinary extraterrestrial event. The family must confront their fear of the phenomenon while also fending off the encroaching American military.

movie:tt38129244.name: Jay Jurden: Yes Ma'am
movie:tt38129244.description: Jay Jurden has been called "one of the most reliable killers working the New York comedy circuit" (Jason Zinoman, NY Times), and his debut comedy special, "Yes Ma'am", proves just why that is the case. Jurden delivers a fast-paced, punchline-filled love letter on what it means to be Black, Southern, and Queer, all while navigating those identities with his signature wit. Filmed at the historic Joy Theater in downtown New Orleans, the Mississippi native and Tonight Show regular is ready to make a big splash with this premier hour presented by Comedy Dynamics.

movie:tt21990214.name: Schmeichel
movie:tt21990214.description: A Goalkeeper in Danish football team that won the European Championship against all odds in 1992 and captained Manchester United in the Champions League final victory that clinched the treble in 1999.

movie:tt19865716.name: Absolute Dominion
movie:tt19865716.description: In the year 2063 AD, the world faces catastrophe as zealots and extremists wage a global holy war, crumbling cities and dismantling entire countries in the name of spiritual superiority. Desperate for a solution to save humanity from itself, the world's governing bodies vote to establish a radical new form of diplomacy called The Battle of Absolute Dominion, a fierce martial-arts tournament featuring the best fighters in the world to determine a champion whose faith will govern humanity and restore peace for the future.

movie:tt33097970.name: The R.I.P Man
movie:tt33097970.description: As a serial killer with a peculiar oral disease continues to murder teenagers in a quaint town, a determined detective attempts to piece together the killer's identity and motivations. The grizzly teeth gimmick murders overshadow the normally safe opulent area, as a vulnerable young man, must revisit his unknown past and put an end to the gruesome death.

movie:tt37975364.name: Rise and Fight: The Battle of Hobkirk's Hill
movie:tt37975364.description: Patriot Southern Command under General Nathaniel Greene organizes militias for a push against the British.

movie:tt7684416.name: Clément, Alex et tous les autres
movie:tt7684416.description: Clement and Alex are looking for a new gay roommate. And they find Leo, a charming student who is in deep trouble to find a place to sleep. Leo will do anything to get that room, whatever it takes.

movie:tt8709312.name: Northspur
movie:tt8709312.description: In a violent, post-pandemic world, a peace-loving man is forced on a desperate journey to find life-saving drugs for his wife - but to get them he must first help an ornery old man defend his cabin against all-comers.

movie:tt6006552.name: Ballroom
movie:tt6006552.description: A devastating accident forces aspiring dancer Violet to relearn life in a wheelchair. Through dance and an unexpected bond, she discovers that dreams don't disappear - they transform.

movie:tt39367866.name: Bob the Drag Queen: This is Wild
movie:tt39367866.description: The incredibly talented and humble Bob the Drag Queen showcases her stand-up in this special you won’t want to miss! Non-stop jokes, brilliant wit, and perfect comedic timing keep her audience begging for more. She shares her intimate moments, relatable trauma, and how life is today as a millennial in the spotlight.

movie:tt37677322.name: The Man Who Saves the World?
movie:tt37677322.description: Resurrection, indigenous prophecies, and adventures around the globe — this is the story of Patrick McCollum. A spiritual leader and peace advocate, he finds himself at the very center of an ancient prophecy that could decide the fate of our planet. Pulled into McCollum’s world, acclaimed director Gabe Polsky will bring us across continents on a spiritual journey in which the absurd and profound merge.

movie:tt28772290.name: Ever After
movie:tt28772290.description: A group of girlfriends arrive at a forest lodge to celebrate, but things take a horrific turn as they realize that the forest is home to bloodthirsty lunatics who perceive themselves to be characters from classic fairy tales.

movie:tt32658453.name: Nazi Zombies
movie:tt32658453.description: Girlfriends practicing witchcraft near a WWII burial ground accidentally awaken a band of blood-thirsty Nazi Zombies

movie:tt34171000.name: Rumpelstiltskin
movie:tt34171000.description: Once upon a time, a miller attempted to marry his daughter off to the King by promising she could spin straw into gold. With the help of a demonic imp, she completes the task, but the King becomes greedy and wants more. So, she promises the imp her firstborn in return for yet more favours. But when it comes time to honour her bargain, dark forces merge when the Imp makes a deal with the devil.

movie:tt26316431.name: The Problem of the Hero
movie:tt26316431.description: In 1940, author Richard Wright turns to Pulitzer Prize-winning playwright Paul Green to help adapt his best-selling book, Native Son, into a Broadway play. Days from opening night, they differ over a single page of the script.

movie:tt38350072.name: Siege of Ape Canyon
movie:tt38350072.description: In 1924, gold prospectors led by Fred Beck claimed they were attacked by ape-like creatures in Washington. "Siege of Ape Canyon" features interviews, analysis, and footage revealing the truth behind the infamous encounter.

movie:tt34402250.name: Suky
movie:tt34402250.description: In this grim and unforgiving environment, Suky discovers a glimmer of hope, a brutal underground fight club that promises freedom to the strongest. With nothing to lose and revenge fueling his every move, Suky must fight not only for his life but for a chance to reclaim his freedom.

movie:tt33049115.name: Jafaican
movie:tt33049115.description: Gazza, a small-time crook, seeks £35,000 for his gran's care. He overhears a tip, devising a scheme. In 21 days, he must master Jamaican culture to execute a fraud in London and Jamaica, facing life-threatening risks.

movie:tt34752624.name: Alien AI: Legacy
movie:tt34752624.description: A weekend getaway leaves a young couple stranded on an isolated road in the woods where they discover they’re being targeted for alien abduction.

movie:tt14122026.name: Made in Ethiopia
movie:tt14122026.description: When a massive Chinese factory complex attempts a high-stakes expansion in rural Ethiopia, three women in search of prosperity have their faith in industrialization tested to the limit. Filmed over four years with singular access, Made in Ethiopia lifts the curtain on China’s historic but misunderstood impact on Africa, and explores contemporary Ethiopia at a moment of profound crisis.  The film was awarded the Jury Special Mention at Tribeca Festival.

movie:tt41028147.name: The Dripton Files: More Mummy, More Problems
movie:tt41028147.description: A look at the career of the Mexican journalist Jaime Maussan.

movie:tt35281197.name: Katangari Goes to Town
movie:tt35281197.description: Quirky "Katangari", a Retired Police Inspector and legendary sleuth is called to Abuja to investigate the murder of his international businesssman cousin, Chief Bello Gyang. Suspects include Bello's family friends and associates all confined in his beautiful mansion until the culprit can be identified.

movie:tt34493877.name: Lace Larrabee: Sparkle Baby
movie:tt34493877.description: America's Got Talent alumnus Lace Larrabee performs for a hometown crowd in Atlanta, GA and reflects upon her years in pageants, opportunities she's realized were missed when she was younger and alternative routes her life could have taken.

movie:tt36372377.name: Zakir Khan: Delulu Express
movie:tt36372377.description: Zakir Khan is back with his hysterical new special! Go on a wild ride with stories about friendship and love, first jobs and quitting them, eventful train journeys, and the amusing retelling of the longest day of his life.

movie:tt32474216.name: Jora Kaiya Thattunga
movie:tt32474216.description: A solitary magician in rural South India battles social resistance while pursuing his deceased father's aspirations, until hardship sparks his metamorphosis into a resilient force ready to overcome.

movie:tt33985496.name: I Am Martin Parr
movie:tt33985496.description: Since the 1970s‚ Martin Parr has fearlessly held out his unique photographic mirror and given us some of the most extraordinary and unique visual clichés of modern times. Sometimes serious‚ often absurd but always playful‚ his insightful and often acrid commentary on consumer society has always been a subject of controversy and discussion.

movie:tt39510096.name: All the World Is Green
movie:tt39510096.description: In a world heading towards climate breakdown, All the World is Green takes us on a journey to discover how much what we put on our table fuels climate change. Through the guidance of scientists, academics, activists, journalists and philosophers, we embark on a journey spanning from China to the USA, leading us to discover how our love for animal products took over our food system, pushing our ecosystems to the verge of collapse for the profit of a handful of corporations. After a journey stretching through Asia, America and Europe, the film leaves the viewer with a choice: remaining part of the problem, or becoming part of the solution.

movie:tt32092575.name: Sunphlowers
movie:tt32092575.description: In the wake of her husband's death, a rural widow battles isolation, mounting debts, and the threat of organised crime, all while holding her fractured family together. But as pressure mounts, Catherine discovers an unexpected inner strength, forging a powerful journey of resilience, survival, and self-reclamation.

movie:tt34228383.name: Love & Rage: Munroe Bergdorf
movie:tt34228383.description: Focuses on one of the most talked about and important issues of our time – how to find yourself and your truth. It follows model and transgender activist Munroe Bergdorf’s journey and provides hope for those facing similar challenges.

movie:tt38948631.name: Nishaanchi 2
movie:tt38948631.description: After another stint in jail, Tony finds that Rinku, his one true love and hope, has been taken by his brother Dabloo. This shocks him into reforming, but Ambika drags him back into crime, with Kamal on his trail. How Manjari gets to have the last laugh, with Tony, Ambika and Kamal at the forefront, forms the rest of the two-part gangster drama.

movie:tt29297421.name: After the Act
movie:tt29297421.description: A devastating meditation on love and intimacy, unfolding over 24 hours as three friends face the quiet wreckage of their choices.

movie:tt35988817.name: Nexus to Disclosure the Truth Is Classified
movie:tt35988817.description: A hidden network of female journalists and activists, dedicated to UFO disclosure, uncovers shocking truths about the government's knowledge of extraterrestrial phenomena.

movie:tt14563214.name: Hi.
movie:tt14563214.description: On the banks of a coastal village, a pair of young adult writers, two teen lovers, and mentally ill parents intertwine in three tales of love and forgiveness during separate stages of life.

movie:tt41571012.name: 5002 Space Aliens
movie:tt41571012.description: There are 5002 space aliens currently on our planet. This is the only known footage of all of them. Please put on your anti-alien glasses now and memorize all 5002 space aliens.

movie:tt33478014.name: Psychic Storm
movie:tt33478014.description: As psychic waves ravage Earth's cities, a clairvoyant teams up with an investigator and scientist to prevent global destruction. Their mission uncovers dark conspiracies while reality crumbles around them.

movie:tt33031173.name: Bikini Shark
movie:tt33031173.description: Mutant sharks are unleashed on unsuspecting victims wearing toxic Bikini-Net swimsuits. What starts as a glamorous beach promotion turns into a blood-soaked nightmare, as engineered predators hunt down anyone caught in the scheme. Now, a small group must fight for survival against the ocean’s deadliest creations—while uncovering the twisted plans of a deranged CEO.

movie:tt32780794.name: Shadows of Willow Cabin
movie:tt32780794.description: Albert and Devon travel to a remote cabin to explore the possibility of a relationship. But when the cabin reveals its true intentions, their romantic getaway turns into a game of survival.

movie:tt11859058.name: Walking Against the Rain
movie:tt11859058.description: Two strangers, Blair and Tommy, are navigating their way across a barren landscape in a desperate attempt to find each other. With their only form of communication being two soon-to-die battery operated radio mics and with a new evil in the shape of 'The Forsaken' tracking them down, they must learn to confront loss and rediscover a trust in humanity.

movie:tt33130643.name: Zombie Repellent
movie:tt33130643.description: A newly engaged couple breaks down in a small town and discovers the locals are hiding a century-old zombie secret.

movie:tt34378658.name: 1 More Round
movie:tt34378658.description: Jackie Despain is in the for the fight of her life. In order to get custody of her young niece, the aspiring mixed martial artist, does the one things she knows she is good at - fight. If she can win enough fights within the brutal, high stakes world of mixed martial arts and sign a professional contract, she can win back her niece. As Jackie blazes a violent path towards her goal, she must rely on the guidance of her hardened trainer, Hank.

movie:tt37475004.name: J.I.A.: The Justice Intelligence Agency
movie:tt37475004.description: A covert Black ops team led by a former lawyer turned vigilante takes on drug cartels, corrupt cops, and global power players-until one of their own is kidnapped, and the mission gets personal.

movie:tt36329718.name: 916 Kunjoottan
movie:tt36329718.description: A man with a small frame but a massive presence leads a double life as a beloved villager and a sharp city tycoon. As love and secrets collide, he must prove that true worth comes from the mind, not the size..

movie:tt38283916.name: The Reality Experiment
movie:tt38283916.description: Eight strangers gather for an unknown experiment at the University for a quick payday. However, things rapidly get out of control as reality itself begins to turn on them.

movie:tt32214359.name: Marlon Williams: Two Worlds
movie:tt32214359.description: Follow the charming Aotearoa New Zealand singer-songwriter on a life-changing journey of self-exploration as he embraces his roots and creates his first album in te reo Māori.

movie:tt40185156.name: Outlaws of the Everglades
movie:tt40185156.description: When mounting fishing regulations prevented them from making a living, they turned to marijuana smuggling to survive. Outlaws of the Everglades...a story of loyalty, survival, determination and grit.

movie:tt35257481.name: Don Jediondo Recharged
movie:tt35257481.description: Irreverent, daring, very spicy and above all full of laughter. Don Jediondo, the funniest peasant in Colombia, brings his spectacular stand-up comedy that are hotter than ever. Without a doubt, a show that you won't want to miss.

movie:tt10544752.name: Beth + Jeremy and Steve
movie:tt10544752.description: An atmospheric, dreamy, low-key funny and somewhat acerbic tale about three people who are in different states of yearning at two different milestones, teens and 30’s.  Jeremy was recently rejected by his high school sweetheart. Beth and Steve are at a crossroad in their marriage. Beth and Jeremy have an accidental meeting in a record store and their mutual interests forge a connection that surprises themselves and challenges Steve.

movie:tt41142128.name: Breach
movie:tt41142128.description: Five haunting visions of the future collide in this gripping sci-fi anthology where technology spirals out of control, society begins to collapse, and humanity is pushed to its limits.

movie:tt34493855.name: Ian Aber: Big Santa
movie:tt34493855.description: Ian Aber drills down on his experiences growing up in Myrtle Beach, being married to a doomsday prepper and a very special movie scene to the delight of crowd in Charleston, SC.

movie:tt37179355.name: Lobito Bound: A Journey to Africa's New Frontier
movie:tt37179355.description: As the world races for critical minerals, a new trade route is transforming Central Africa. Lobito-Bound: A journey to Africa’s new frontier follows explorer Dwayne Fields - in partnership with pan-African mobile provider Africell - from the Indian Ocean to the Atlantic along the Lobito Corridor, tracing the impact of global power struggles on local lives. Through voices on the ground, the film explores whether the Lobito Corridor will bring real progress or simply shift the balance of control.

movie:tt37516301.name: Big Star: The Nick Skelton Story
movie:tt37516301.description: Big Star: The Nick Skelton Story is the official all-access documentary of national hero Nick Skelton (CBE), one of the most decorated and enduring Equestrian champions the world has ever seen. Nick’s passion and perseverance drove him to 7 Olympic games and inspired athletes in the sport worldwide. The film includes interviews with  Nick’s family, and with key members of the British Equestrian Community.

movie:tt26315947.name: Behind the Lines
movie:tt26315947.description: Documentary based on three New York Times bestselling books by historian Andrew Carroll and inspired by the stage play If All the Sky Were Paper, the film tells the story of Carroll, who travels the world to seek out the greatest war letters ever written

movie:tt36591334.name: Vijeyta
movie:tt36591334.description: after establishing successful businesses in Kolkata, a determined entrepreneur moves to Mumbai with his family, where their growing success attracts unwanted attention from extortionists.

movie:tt34371068.name: A Mary Little Christmas
movie:tt34371068.description: Mary Little's Christmas search for the missing nutcracker to complete her family's heirloom collection leads to unexpected discoveries and romance.

movie:tt23560074.name: When the Ringlights Dim
movie:tt23560074.description: When a famous content creator is kidnapped, a group of influencer friends—unable to involve the police—must rely on social media, dating apps, and content house contacts to untangle the twisted mystery.

movie:tt37428782.name: A Map of the World in Time
movie:tt37428782.description: Over 34 days at sea, deep in the Arctic Circle, the wages of knowledge are explored. This ship's mariners and scientists reflect on their life at sea as they attempt to better understand climate change, both past and present.

movie:tt32242457.name: Gunner
movie:tt32242457.description: A retired fighter pilot is called back into action after he witnesses the death of his wing man.

movie:tt34930474.name: Buenas noches
movie:tt34930474.description: A young Brazilian girl travels to Argentina to visit her aunt, but after a misunderstanding and the loss of her belongings, she must kill time until the next morning.

movie:tt35981821.name: Cypress Hill & the London Symphony Orchestra - Black Sunday Live at the Royal Albert Hall
movie:tt35981821.description: Hip-hop meets classical as the legendary Cypress Hill play an exclusive show at the Royal Albert Hall alongside the London Symphony Orchestra. Celebrating 30 years since the release of their seminal album Black Sunday, they are accompanied by unique arrangements from the glorious 70-piece orchestra.

movie:tt38690249.name: Ida Who Sang So Badly Even the Dead Rose Up and Joined Her in Song
movie:tt38690249.description: Ten-year-old Ida believes that the mysterious angelic singing resounding across the village graveyard is the only thing keeping her beloved Grandma alive. So she decides to join the school choir-even though she is absolutely tone deaf.

movie:tt30788209.name: Pickleball
movie:tt30788209.description: When foreclosure threatens their community center, Father Joseph rallies his late friend’s sons into an underdog pickleball team for a $100,000 tournament—against a cocky tennis legend determined to seize the courts and steal the spotlight.

movie:tt14257652.name: Melodrive
movie:tt14257652.description: After separating from his wife due to an emotional affair, a homeward bound musician goes on a road trip, but after bumping into his high school sweetheart, his feelings become even more off balance.

movie:tt15708792.name: Fragile Seeds
movie:tt15708792.description: A therapist working with sex offenders uncovers haunting secrets and answers to her family’s past through the violent men she counsels every day.

movie:tt38113523.name: One of One
movie:tt38113523.description: Founded in Tokyo in the aftermath of WWII, Naito Auto Engineering is a three-generation family business, renown for restoring high-value classic cars with artistry and precision.  Masao Naito, with his bold vision and rebellious spirit, took his father's local mechanic shop and turned it into a first-class company, whose services are coveted by top auto collectors the world over. For over 40 years, Masao has ruled the family business with an iron fist. Now, with his retirement on the horizon, cracks are beginning to show. Do the younger Naitos have what it takes to keep the family together, and carry the business forward?

movie:tt40194661.name: Homeys
movie:tt40194661.description: Homeys is a story of struggle and resilience that follows four artists living the streets of Los Angeles as they fight against adversity to pursue their dreams.

movie:tt35489631.name: Confessions of a Menopausal Femme Fatale
movie:tt35489631.description: Prepare to laugh, cry, and embrace the beauty of reinvention. This bold and refreshingly candid film explores the trials, triumphs, and transformations of aging through the lens of one woman's hilarious and heartfelt journey.

movie:tt14949262.name: Can You Hear Me?
