movie:tt14949262.description: A fallen WWI American soldier strikes a divine bargain to reunite with his bride in England. As he resumes life unaware he's a ghost, love and loss blur. When Annabel learns the truth-now carrying his child-she must face heartbreak and find the strength to let him go.

movie:tt11958198.name: The Kool Kids
movie:tt11958198.description: Three teenage freaks get tired of being bullied and kidnap the high school's most elite for a weekend of torment and torture.

movie:tt36441111.name: The World's Toughest Ski Race
movie:tt36441111.description: Stephan Wilson embarks on an extraordinary journey to conquer Nordenskiöldsloppet, the world’s longest and most grueling ski race. Covering 220 kilometers through the Arctic wilderness, this historic challenge pushes even the toughest endurance athletes to their absolute limits. But for Stephan, the challenge is even greater. Years ago, he could barely stand on skis—he even wore a helmet when he first started learning. Yet, despite his struggles, he fell in love with the sport. Now, driven by sheer curiosity and an unbreakable will, he sets out to test himself against one of the most demanding endurance races on the planet.

movie:tt14284376.name: Stationed At Home
movie:tt14284376.description: On a clear and frigid Christmas Eve in 1998, in a small, forgotten city, a solitary taxi driver on the graveyard shift breathlessly awaits the sight of the International Space Station. As the hours count down, a parade of offbeat misfits derail his plans, propelling the story to its exhilarating climax. In this poetic, hilarious and often absurd tale, complete strangers discover unexpected unity and a newfound understanding of their place among the stars.

movie:tt36164068.name: Show Me Your Glory
movie:tt36164068.description: Explore miracle research, true supernatural accounts and unexpected answers to prayer. For those wrestling with why a loving God allows suffering and evil, experts share insights and evidence.

movie:tt27658326.name: Wild Summon
movie:tt27658326.description: A natural history fantasy film, following the dramatic lifecycle of the wild salmon in human form, with narration by Marianne Faithfull.

movie:tt31436872.name: Mazaka
movie:tt31436872.description: The path to true love does not run smoothly when a father and son seek marriage at the same time.

movie:tt33308692.name: Half-Life of Memory: America's Forgotten Atomic Bomb Factory
movie:tt33308692.description: In the suburbs of Denver, the U.S. secretly manufactured thousands of atomic weapons, leaving behind a toxic legacy that will persist for generations.

movie:tt36136052.name: 1 Hour to Kill
movie:tt36136052.description: After becoming TV celebrities, a team of ghost hunters is assigned a new job investigating a house haunted by the evil spirit of a serial killer, but the gig soon turns into an actual haunting with a demon trying to possess their bodies.

movie:tt36264297.name: Spill
movie:tt36264297.description: A struggling immigrant cleaner walks into the wrong house and becomes trapped in the fallout of a violent past, forcing her into a brutal fight for survival across Los Angeles and the desert beyond.

movie:tt36823504.name: The Christmas Princess Switch
movie:tt36823504.description: Hannah, a waitress in a small U.K. town, is stunned when a royal security team mistakes her for Crown Princess Helena of Camalonia. The real Helena disappeared just days before her coronation. Hannah agrees to pose as the princess to prevent national panic, only to fall for the royal advisor helping her navigate palace life.

movie:tt35284450.name: Smile for the Dead: An Examination of Spirit Photography
movie:tt35284450.description: 1869: William H Mumler stood trial for fraud in New York for claiming to photograph spirits of customers' deceased loved ones. Mumler walked free as experts of the day could not figure his methods. Was he a fraud? Or could he truly photograph the dead?

movie:tt12975170.name: T Bird
movie:tt12975170.description: A homeless streetfighter breaks up a child trafficking ring

movie:tt35380387.name: The Rendlesham UFO : The British Roswell
movie:tt35380387.description: In this thrilling, unique, and sometimes hilarious UFO documentary, tantalising discoveries emerge while delving into Britain’s own Roswell—the 1980 Rendlesham UFO incident where a mysterious craft was reportedly seen landing near a U.S. airbase. As the investigation revisits the original event, the film also chronicles the strange encounters reported in Rendlesham Forest ever since; weird UFO sightings, floating orbs of light, and encounters with terrifying cryptid creatures.

movie:tt27399130.name: Almost Popular
movie:tt27399130.description: Susie and Bobbie, high school sophomores, go on a quest to fulfill their dream to become part of the elite POP Girls who rule the school. After a series of unfortunate and humiliating attempts, they get their big chance.

movie:tt39302467.name: Let Them Come
movie:tt39302467.description: After being branded traitors by their former doomsday cult, Isabel and her father are forced to fight for survival as they are thrust into a relentless nationwide manhunt.

movie:tt30334536.name: A Life of Sunshine
movie:tt30334536.description: Private investigator Sunshine "Sunny" LeBlanc is brutally murdered, triggering a shocking investigation. Her sudden death exposes a massive secret: she was leading a triple life, simultaneously married to a woman and two men who knew nothing about each other. Bound by grief and shared betrayal, the wife and two husbands must move into the same house for their own protection. Putting aside their shock and jealousy, the trio unites to avenge Sunny's death. Using her own detective files and tools, they hunt for her killer. As they dig deeper, they uncover a dangerous web of personal lies and high-level government corruption that puts all their lives in immediate danger.

movie:tt37750852.name: Krampus in Space
movie:tt37750852.description: A salvage crew finds a relic box on an abandoned ship. Opening it unleashes Krampus, an ancient predator now stalking their vessel. With the creature picking them off, the crew races to decode the relic's origins before their mission-and their lives-are swallowed by the darkness they unleashed.

movie:tt28498914.name: Bull Shark 3
movie:tt28498914.description: The finale to the Bull Shark trilogy as a family of Bull Sharks faces off against a small Texas lake community.

movie:tt37513276.name: The Grim & The Dark
movie:tt37513276.description: When looking for a gift for his kid, Jon Heder (Napoleon Dynamite) is introduced to the world of Grimdark. In that moment he starts down a journey that will take him all over the world and through interviews with prominent Grimdark authors, game developers, and dedicated fans, he delves into the themes that define the genre—all in an effort to find the man who started it all: John Blanche.

movie:tt38907371.name: Oh..! Sukumari
movie:tt38907371.description: Follows an aspiring politician who falls in love with Sukumari, a beautiful and soft-natured woman, while her father conceals a secret that threatens their relationship.

movie:tt35839936.name: Wickedness
movie:tt35839936.description: Two witches put against each other. One good, one evil. Who will have the ultimate wickedness?

movie:tt22687548.name: What's the Story, Wishbone?
movie:tt22687548.description: A behind-the-scenes journey into the creation and lasting legacy of Wishbone, the Emmy-winning PBS series that introduced a generation to classic literature through the adventures of a small dog with a big imagination.

movie:tt32636458.name: Fall to the Top
movie:tt32636458.description: In the hard and gritty streets of London, one man wants to rule all the drugs gangs. This man will need to work his way to the top from a lowly drug dealer to the king of the jungle.

movie:tt27794848.name: A Murder in Oakland: Beauty is Deadly
movie:tt27794848.description: A four-year-old cold case has been reopened in Oakland with new evidence, uncovering a dangerous web of crime, deception, and corruption. This thrilling mystery follows the relentless pursuit of justice as detectives dig deeper into a case that was thought to be long buried.

movie:tt38890268.name: Moment of Contact: New Revelations of Alien Encounters
movie:tt38890268.description: For the first time in history a neurosurgeon describes communication with a live captured alien. This expanded version of Moment of Contact, New Revelations of Alien Encounters sees James Fox return to Brazil in the wake of congressional hearings in the United States. Ground-breaking interviews with former police chief, pathologists, and Dr Ítalo Venturelli who communicated with the alien.

movie:tt11132392.name: The Blessing and the Curse
movie:tt11132392.description: Closed-off to most of the world, the filmmakers were granted exclusive access to an isolated Jewish settlement in the Northern West Bank called Itamar which sits between two mountains- the Mountain of the Blessing and the Mountain of the Curse. On the night of March 11, 2011, two terrorists penetrated the security fence of the community, entered the home of the Fogel family, who were asleep in their beds, and brutally murdered the parents and three of their children, including a three-month-old who was nearly beheaded. THE BLESSING AND THE CURSE explores the aftermath of the crime and examines how the memory of that night still haunts the people of Itamar, and poses the question: Why would anyone choose to raise their family in such a dangerous place?

movie:tt31491006.name: Finders Keepers
movie:tt31491006.description: A young women becomes a tenant in an inner city property and takes pity on a girl who has fallen on hard times, giving her a place to stay. Decorating their new home together, they discover a stash of money hidden in one of the walls. Their lucky feeling soon turns to unlucky as they learn that their exciting discovery comes at a price - some very bad people want their money back and will stop at nothing to get it.

movie:tt39365508.name: Fittest on Earth: 2025
movie:tt39365508.description: Fittest on Earth: 2025” is a bold, emotional exploration of the world’s fittest athletes and the sport that reshaped their lives. Through raw interviews, behind-the-scenes footage, and vulnerable reflections, 2025 Games athletes open up about the sacrifices, the breakthroughs, and the moments that nearly broke them — and why they keep coming back. On the women’s side, Tia-Clair Toomey chases her eighth title while the men battle in one of the most competitive fields we’ve ever seen.

movie:tt37603762.name: Into Black
movie:tt37603762.description: Amidst the chaos and destruction of the London Blitz, four women become trapped in an abandoned warehouse, where they must fight to survive against a murderous stranger known as The Blackout Ripper. Inspired by true events.

movie:tt39402045.name: Your Attention Please
movie:tt39402045.description: A quiet revolution is underway: As the real-world consequences of social media come into focus, a new generation of parents and teens step forward to challenge the systems shaping their lives and fight for a different future.

movie:tt26217712.name: Thirsty
movie:tt26217712.description: An Oakland mayoral candidate struggles to figure out her personal and professional lives.

movie:tt34493867.name: Dewayne White: A Boy Named Shannon
movie:tt34493867.description: In his debut comedy special, Dewayne White tackles the issues that made him who he is today. From his parents' poor choice of names to his time in Iraq to his current role as a husband and father, Dewayne's energetic and irreverent style will have you roaring with laughter.

movie:tt36355176.name: Lara Beitz: Stoppable
movie:tt36355176.description: Lara Beitz's Stoppable is a raw, hilarious ride through the chaos of everyday life. With her mix of sharp wit and personal storytelling, Lara tackles family, addiction, relationships, and more, all through her unflinching, relatable lens that will have you laughing out loud from start to finish.

movie:tt38036540.name: The Blue Brazili
movie:tt38036540.description: In 1980s Erbil, five boys from broken childhoods and forgotten streets found their identity behind the wheel of a stolen blue Volkswagen — they called it “The Brazili.” What began as survival soon spiraled into violence, fear, and infamy. The Blue Brazili is a haunting tale of lost youth, crime, and the dark path that trauma can carve through a life.

movie:tt27489635.name: Just a Bit Outside: The Story of the 1982 Milwaukee Brewers
movie:tt27489635.description: Records the highs and lows of a season that came close to winning the championship. Chronicles the 40-year love affair between a struggling blue-collar city and a perfectly matched blue-collar team.

movie:tt37671707.name: Not All Movies Are the Same: Dual
movie:tt37671707.description: After losing everything to a personal mistake, a young man stumbles into a parallel world where a family is trapped by zombies. Driven to save them, he must navigate this deadly reality and fight for survival-and redemption

movie:tt39150080.name: Ghost in the Machine
movie:tt39150080.description: The untold origins of artificial intelligence lie not in machines but in power, revealing the fantasies behind the hype that got us here and where we go next.

movie:tt38938767.name: The Cure: The Show Of A Lost World (Troxy Live 2024)
movie:tt38938767.description: To launch the album "Songs of a Lost World" on 1st November 2024, The Cure play live at Troxy in London. Playing the album in full, then embarking on a monster set to adoring fans, The Cure show why they are one of the most respected bands of the last 40 years. Main Set: Alone, And Nothing Is Forever, A Fragile Thing, Warsong, Drone:Nodrone, I Can Never Say Goodbye, All I Ever Am, Endsong, Plainsong, Pictures of You, High, Lovesong, Burn, Fascination Street, A Night Like This, Push, In Between Days, Just Like Heaven, From the Edge of the Deep Green Sea, Disintegration, At Night, M, Secrets, Play for Today, A Forest. Encore: Lullaby, The Walk, Friday I'm in Love, Close to Me, Why Can't I Be You?, Boys Don't Cry.

movie:tt30496524.name: American Skyjacker
movie:tt30496524.description: The true tale of Martin McNally, a man who hijacked an American Airlines plane in 1972 in an attempt to repeat what the infamous DB Cooper did 6 months prior, and led authorities on a 5 day manhunt across the country. However this was just the beginning of one of the wildest true crime stories ever. This is the documentary version of the Top 20 Apple podcast American Skyjacker.

movie:tt33309991.name: Alien AI: Discovered
movie:tt33309991.description: Two filmmakers journey to Cooke County, Texas to probe a missing family case rumored to have been abducted by extraterrestrial beings in 2022.

movie:tt36829078.name: Passengers
movie:tt36829078.description: After 30 years, locked away footage from the 1990s is revealed featuring raw, emotional confessions from a group of disillusioned New Yorkers. As the world faces new challenges, their voices feel more relevant than ever. People are people. Even then.

movie:tt43692404.name: Magic in the Mundane
movie:tt43692404.description: A cinematic journey into the overlooked miracles of everyday existence.

movie:tt13271368.name: Stay Safe
movie:tt13271368.description: Stationed on the front lines of a Pandemic Hotzone, an army surgeon, Eva attempts to uncover the truth behind a subliminal message she received from a patient while dealing with the unexpected arrival of an illegal immigrant into her home.

movie:tt30825000.name: Nimma Vasthugalige Neeve Javaabdaararu
movie:tt30825000.description: The title means "You are responsible for your belongings." As humans, we develop profound attachments to our belongings, which often intertwine with our deepest insecurities. Unfortunately, many of these insecurities manifest in reality.

movie:tt36827507.name: Any Problem Is No Problem
movie:tt36827507.description: Any Problem Is No Problem captures the personal journeys of five young entrepreneurs. In an industry often misrepresented by hype and stereotypes, this intimate portrayal reveals the grit, creativity, and passion required to make ...

movie:tt45383111.name: All of Us
movie:tt45383111.description: When Ruby Bridges Elementary opened in Washington State in 2020, its founding principal and staff made a radical choice: to educate every child in the same classroom, regardless of disability or support needs. Five years later, the school is seeing strong academic and social outcomes, without additional funding or staff. There was no magic fix – just a new model based on the belief that inclusion benefits everyone. All of Us is the story of a school that breaks the mold. A school that is unique, but shouldn't be.

movie:tt35513670.name: Confessions of a CEO: My Life in an Out-of-Balance World
movie:tt35513670.description: A bare-knuckled critique of corporate America told through the powerful true story of a toxic CEO who evolves from a profits-over-people, philandering executive to an unorthodox leader, populist messenger, and mentor to American influencers. It’s a story of growth, redemption and the impact of self-awareness on leadership and life.

movie:tt40504304.name: Copes: Comandos De Élite
movie:tt40504304.description: For the first time, a camera crew is granted exclusive access to the selection process of the Colombian National Police's Special Operations Command (COPES). Over four and a half months, more than one hundred police officers from ...

movie:tt32409066.name: The Protos Experiment
movie:tt32409066.description: In a dystopian future, death row inmates are used like lab rats by a private company who use memory implants to revolutionise the correctional system. Two prisoners who become subject to the experiment must escape or risk losing their minds forever.

movie:tt42340173.name: Death Mask
movie:tt42340173.description: The artist Oliver Black wakes up and finds his wife dead next to him. Instead of calling for help, he hides the body and starts creating a death mask, before her face is lost forever.

movie:tt38095629.name: Dead Before Christmas
movie:tt38095629.description: A horror film directed by Brandon Scotland about a real estate entrepreneur who becomes entangled in a web of lies and murder after meeting a mysterious woman just before Christmas.

movie:tt36458791.name: The First Hymn
movie:tt36458791.description: In the ancient ruins of Oxyrhynchus, Egypt, archaeologists unearthed a papyrus scrap containing the earliest known Christian hymn, complete with both its lyrics and musical notation.  Analyzed at Oxford University, this discovery challenges traditional views of church history by revealing the rich musical practices of early believers. Hosted by Australian historian John Dickson, the feature-length documentary “The First Hymn” chronicles the hymn’s journey from its desert origins to its modern resurrection, as acclaimed composers Chris Tomlin and Ben Fielding transform the ancient melody into a contemporary worship piece, culminating in a live concert performance.

movie:tt24223534.name: Give Me a Word: The Collective Soul Story
movie:tt24223534.description: Filmed at Elvis' Palm Springs getaway in early 2023, and containing archival footage from the band's early days, "Give Me a Word: The Collective Soul Story" is the definitive feature-length documentary on Collective Soul. Currently in their 31st year, "Give Me a Word" tells the untold story, the family component to the band, the creativity, and the wisdom that has been hard won over a three decades plus career.

movie:tt34493841.name: Damon Sumner: I'm A Professional
movie:tt34493841.description: In his debut special, Damon Sumner hilariously dives into his inability to maintain a social life, raising both his kids and those of others and maintaining friendships as a couple at The Limelight Theater in Atlanta, GA.

movie:tt23836308.name: Where Did the Adults Go?
movie:tt23836308.description: When three siblings meet at the family summer home on the anniversary of their parents' death, a power struggle ensues when the eldest proposes selling the house so she and her wife can afford to start a family.

movie:tt8168944.name: Havana Libré
movie:tt8168944.description: Follows the effort to legitimize surfing in Cuba, chronicling the unwavering passion that keeps them going to the water despite all odds.

movie:tt41635414.name: Mr. Reset and the Society of Turnbuckle & Bone
movie:tt41635414.description: A secret society manipulates pro wrestling from the shadows, luring hopefuls with promises of fame. Trapped in a world of illusion and psychological trials, they face intense sacrifice for a shot at glory.

movie:tt38977677.name: San Francisco Rising
movie:tt38977677.description: A city of reinvention, San Francisco tries to rise from the ashes after an era of turmoil and troubled headlines. Told through intimate vignettes; a Muni operator, the mayor, artists, the man who cremates overdose victims and dozens more.

movie:tt33305703.name: Angels Near Death
movie:tt33305703.description: In the City of Angels, six eccentric strangers cross paths after near-death experiences, interweaving the journey of love, death, and the human spirit.

movie:tt32986677.name: The Fisherman
movie:tt32986677.description: A traditional Ghanaian fisherman forced into retirement teams up with a bougie talking fish and his quirky associates on a whimsical adventure to Accra, chasing their dream of owning a boat while learning to navigate the modern world without losing touch with their roots.

movie:tt11206512.name: Clemente
movie:tt11206512.description: An immersive documentary about the remarkable life and legacy of MLB icon Roberto Clemente.

movie:tt39797122.name: A Vision for Vision
movie:tt39797122.description: Directed and produced by 2x Emmy-award winning filmmaker Wayne Chesler, this special documentary follows Irish nutritional scientist Professor John Nolan’s 20-year exploration of the link between powerful antioxidants - Carotenoids - and their effects on nutrition, vision, and brain health. From the marigold fields of Mexico to research labs in Ireland, the Omega-3 enriched Norwegian seas, and elite performance centers in Singapore, the film uncovers breakthrough science behind these incredible nutrients that support how we see, think, and age.

movie:tt36470280.name: Shattered Silence
movie:tt36470280.description: A wealthy non-denominational Pastor Edmond Henry appears to be a devoted family man, but he harbors a scandalous past hidden from his wife, children, and the public eye. When he is blackmailed by someone threatening to expose his ...

movie:tt11891602.name: Igniting the Spark – The Story of Magic: The Gathering
movie:tt11891602.description: A documentary exploring the influence of the world's most popular collectible card game and chronicling its history since the 1993 release.

movie:tt38501926.name: Kristin Key: Lesbian Army
movie:tt38501926.description: With a guitar, quick wit, and wildly original sense of humor, comedian Kristin Key takes the stage in her debut comedy special. A fearless, funny, and deeply personal celebration of identity, love, and the beautiful mess of being human.

movie:tt33299234.name: Saving Buddy Charles
movie:tt33299234.description: As best friends Clara and Sydney prepare to part ways for college, they embark on a cross-country journey to rescue Sydney’s pet lizard from her ex-boyfriend. Unbeknownst to Sydney, Clara is harboring a life-altering secret that may just change their friendship forever.

movie:tt36119988.name: Fair Rain
movie:tt36119988.description: As a new world government emerges from the mysterious disappearances of people worldwide, a band of resisters known as the Remnant live and die to protect a valuable asset that will bring hope to those surviving the catastrophic scenario.

movie:tt27496342.name: The Lemurian Candidate
movie:tt27496342.description: Three former college buddies who reunite for a backpacking trip on Mount Shasta to heal old wounds and improve their mental health. The weekend descends into madness and a quest for alien contact after one of them introduces hallucinogens into the mix.

movie:tt23861504.name: Notre Dame de Moncton
movie:tt23861504.description: Anna (Laurie Gagné) is going through a particularly stressful time: she is preparing to reconnect with Jason (Thomas Lapointe), the son she was forced to place for adoption almost 20 years ago. Unable to go through with this meeting, she takes refuge, clandestinely, in the house of an elderly couple. A dramatic event changes everything and forces Anna to forge an impromptu relationship with Victorine (Louise Turcot). The strange cohabitation of these two women will help them find the courage to face their trials.

movie:tt40935136.name: The Motherload
movie:tt40935136.description: An imaginative telling of the story of a Vietnamese American mother-daughter duo who, in their attempt to heal the rift between them, reenact and satirize scenes from celebrated Vietnam War films while depicting a diasporic reality.  Two inventive storylines complicate The MOTHERLOAD to levels of absurdity. Both of these glide in and out beneath the narrative backbone of Jessca and Kim’s personal story, and reflect the stunning disconnect between the Vietnamese diaspora and the world’s understanding of their presence.

movie:tt13934264.name: When It Rains in LA
movie:tt13934264.description: Following the story of an Eastern European girl who escapes the horror of losing her boyfriend in her own country for an LA vacation with friends, she faces the reckoning of the trauma she left behind... and the rain she unearthed coming here.

movie:tt28754392.name: Sugarhouse
movie:tt28754392.description: A sweet-natured teenager and her headstrong little sister, abandoned by their outlaw father, reach out for help from their wayward brother, who remains haunted by the sins of his past.

movie:tt32249170.name: Darklands: Are You Ready to Go Deep?
movie:tt32249170.description: Every year, thousands of visitors make the pilgrimage to Antwerp for the largest indoor gay fetish event in the world. Through the eyes of the Jeroen, and his sister, straight Nathalie, both of the masterminds behind the event, this sensitive documentary offers an unprecedented account of a journey that sees taboos challenged and leaves audiences enthralled. In "Darklands", sensitive topics like sexual identity and fetishism are approached in a poignant and non-explicit way, while tantalising secrets behind the festival's genesis are revealed.

movie:tt35889949.name: Not Every Woman
movie:tt35889949.description: Four Black women bond over wine, laughter, and shared anxieties about America, only to uncover deeper truths that will change them forever.

movie:tt39703118.name: Her Own Child
movie:tt39703118.description: A father's fight to stay in his daughter's life unleashes a deadly chain of events between broken lovers, loyal brothers, and trusted friends.

movie:tt38790586.name: Mountains of the Moon
movie:tt38790586.description: World renowned artist and skier Chris Benchetler explores the unseen connections between sport, life, music, and the living earth—set to the timeless tunes of the Grateful Dead.

movie:tt36415829.name: The Shepherd Code: Lapierre
movie:tt36415829.description: Lewis enlists his top agent, Alex Lapierre - aka "The Shepherd" - for a mission that's as high-stakes as it is dangerous: eliminate a list of targets for Tania Edwards, a powerful and enigmatic woman tangled in a massive scandal. But things quickly take an unexpected turn. A mysterious bounty hunter, known only as "The Ghost," enters the picture with a very different agenda: to take out both Tania and Alex, but on whose behalf? Caught between the conflicting demands of his superiors and his own growing doubts, Alex faces a tough decision: follow orders and remain the loyal soldier he's trained to be, or be swayed by Tania's allure and question everything he believes in.

movie:tt28234672.name: Parallel - The Triad
movie:tt28234672.description: Three souls are sent to Earth from the Parallel on an eternal mission to fulfill God's plan. They've come to guard and train Cyrus, a young mechanic who has lost his way in life, and they help him understand his calling.

movie:tt7365110.name: Mola: A Tibetan Tale of Love and Loss
movie:tt7365110.description: This is the story of Kunsang Wangmo, a 100-year-old Buddhist nun exiled from Tibet in 1959 to escape the Chinese occupation.

movie:tt19408240.name: The Hermit
movie:tt19408240.description: Dragged on a vacation to the woods, teenagers Lisa and Eric fight for their lives against an unstoppable cannibal pig farmer.

movie:tt4899906.name: Mister Gates
movie:tt4899906.description: Real-estate mogul Christopher Gates becomes homeless after losing his family, only to discover the sinister connection to their deaths.

movie:tt27329281.name: Chasing Light
movie:tt27329281.description: After a fall wipes his memory, 13-year-old Max embarks on a journey to uncover his identity. But as memories resurface, he questions: are they his, or has someone shaped his past? Max's search may reveal a truth he's not ready to face.

movie:tt31283823.name: Skinwalker Island
movie:tt31283823.description: After their grandmother's death, Lucy and Miles return to their family's swamp island, only to face buried secrets, eerie visions, and their volatile cousin Chet. As myths come alive, the trio is pulled into a nightmare of shape-shifting terror and reckoning.

movie:tt15657904.name: Bart Bagalzby and the Garbage Genie
movie:tt15657904.description: Set in 1999, in a typical suburban town, Bart Bagalzby is a high school kid who wants to be more popular. His best friends are a diverse group of not-so-cool kids and geeks. Bart is interested in Grace, one of the school's most popular girls, and he thinks if he becomes a rock star, Grace might finally notice him. While Bart is tossing out the garbage at his part-time job, a very unconventional Genie emerges from the garbage can, rewarding Bart with three wishes. But after several missteps and some failed magic, Bart's plans start losing steam. Finally, Bart finds his own inner magic, and he and his friends become an amazing rock band playing all of their own tunes.

movie:tt35056565.name: Tim Loulies: Sugar Glider
movie:tt35056565.description: In his debut special, Sugar Glider, Tim Loulies delivers a wildly entertaining performance, balancing personal stories with sharp social commentary. Known for his unapologetic wit and larger-than-life stage presence, Tim opens up about retiring his signature fat jokes, weaving humor into reflections on health and aging. His comparison to a 'beloved infomercial salesman' is just the beginning of a series of unexpected yet hilariously relatable insights. As Tim takes aim at the ironies of life, he pokes fun at fitness culture, all while admitting he himself is far from judgment-free. Shifting gears, Tim delves into pop culture, and sharing the hilarious irony of being a bill collector. With Sugar Glider, Tim Loulies seamlessly blends personal growth, pop culture critique, and sharp observational comedy. His dynamic storytelling and fearless approach to humor will leave audiences laughing, thinking, and eager for more.

movie:tt36719461.name: Clayburn Cox: So Here's The Thing
movie:tt36719461.description: Clayburn Cox is a school teacher who hates corn. Revealing that to his students was both the biggest mistake and biggest opportunity. Hear his hilarious stories of never ending corn gifts along with one-liners and musical comedy. It's uproarious fun for everyone.

movie:tt42181002.name: Devil in a Sundress
movie:tt42181002.description: The Devil in a Sundress is a sharp, seductive thriller about the most dangerous lie, the one that looks like love. Because evil doesn't announce itself with horns and fire. It shows up soft-spoken, sun-kissed, and completely convincing.

movie:tt36128168.name: Music City Mistletoe
movie:tt36128168.description: In Nashville, a spirited songwriter and a widowed consultant clash over the fate of a music publishing office. As Christmas nears, rivalry turns to romance in this conflict-filled holiday tale where saving dreams means risking hearts.

movie:tt18303602.name: Shaken and Stirred: The Story of Flair Bartending
movie:tt18303602.description: Shaken & Stirred follows the lives of three flair bartenders at the top of their game as they set their sights on a big competition in Florida, intercut with interviews with legendary bartenders who discuss the sport’s past, present, and future.  The movie features legends from the bartending world including Christian and Rodrigo Delpech, Dario Doimo, Tom Dyer, Ivan Usov and many more!  This is the first full length feature documentary about the sport and art of flair bartending.

movie:tt39380663.name: Taming the Mouth
movie:tt39380663.description: At the world's most dangerous river entrance, generations of mariners, engineers, and workers battle the raw force of the Columbia River Bar-and the monumental effort to tame it forever changed the American West.

movie:tt37252805.name: Bravery & Betrayal
movie:tt37252805.description: After 9/11 our Nation sent the Aussie S.A.S. into harms way to protect us. 25 years later, their suffering continues. The S.A.S. now tell their story of what really happened in Afghanistan and Iraq.

movie:tt7373900.name: Cracking Aces: A Woman's Place at the Table
movie:tt7373900.description: A documentary about the pioneering women who broke through the glass ceiling of professional poker.

movie:tt15272328.name: Nora
movie:tt15272328.description: Having given up her career in music, Nora moves home to suburbia to focus on her child. Her dreams, however, have different plans.

movie:tt33539361.name: The Final Party
movie:tt33539361.description: As graduation nears, scholarship students at a party face a night of terror when the wealthy elite crash in, acting on dark childhood traumas. Trapped, they must survive the chaos and violence until dawn.

movie:tt36304283.name: On Healing Land, Birds Perch
movie:tt36304283.description: A short documentary that tells the remarkable stories behind one of the most iconic photos in history, while acting as a portal into the “varied carols,” to borrow from Walt Whitman, of trauma and the American journey.

movie:tt33357680.name: Bozzo in the woods
movie:tt33357680.description: As the war between the Hunters and Demons grows. Lieutenant Skyler goes on a secret mission to investigate the missing artifact. Soon Skylers team realise that, in addition to fighting the demons, they also must fight a demon lord.

movie:tt36836582.name: Minding Your Business
movie:tt36836582.description: Desperate to get back to New York, Rachel Carver strikes a deal with her family's sworn enemy, business superstar Jacob Rush. However, their families' bitter rivalry threatens to derail everything.

movie:tt42724366.name: Kwik Stop
movie:tt42724366.description: After moving from Chicago to Tampa for a fresh start, Kenny takes a late-night gas station job, but one deadly shift forces him into a nightmare he may not survive.

movie:tt33376631.name: Urban Flesh Eaters
movie:tt33376631.description: A zombie outbreak confines people in an apartment building, forcing a mother to fight the undead to rescue her two children.

movie:tt32360348.name: Put the Guns Down: A World Epidemic
movie:tt32360348.description: Exposes the harsh realities of gun violence in South Central Los Angeles. Directed by Terry C. Carney, Sr., and Eric Herbert, and produced by Ice-T, this documentary features raw interviews and exclusive insights from community figures like Spice 1 and Kokane. It sheds light on systemic issues fueling violence and serves as a powerful call for change.

movie:tt13793134.name: Nico
movie:tt13793134.description: Nico (33), German-Persian, emancipated and happy, is the most popular geriatric nurse for her patients. With her best friend Rosa (37), she enjoys the summer in Berlin. A xenophobic attack tears the self-confident NICO from its self-determined everyday life. Waking up in the hospital, she realizes that she doesn't seem to be a part of it after all.

movie:tt22486396.name: Dog Fugitive
movie:tt22486396.description: A brutally honest dog psychiatrist, Dr. Fluffy, skips town when her patient is accused of killing their cheating husband and Dr. Fluffy thinks she's to blame.

movie:tt22325440.name: Marwan: Tomorrow's Freedom
movie:tt22325440.description: Marwan Barghouti, often described as the ‘Palestinian Nelson Mandela’, is serving five life sentences in an Israeli prison. This is his story.

movie:tt35439895.name: Holding Liat
movie:tt35439895.description: Liat Atzili was kidnapped from her kibbutz on October 7. What begins as a chronicle of her parents, sister, and children's efforts to secure her return, becomes a portrait of conflicting impulses towards anger, indifference, and compassion straining the bonds of one grieving family.

movie:tt14588278.name: Breaking 10
movie:tt14588278.description: Breaking 10 chronicles the pursuit of athletic excellence and personal growth as it follows amateur triathlete Justin Hibbert in his attempt to complete a full Ironman in under 10 hours, an accomplishment tried by many and achieved by few.

movie:tt23640614.name: When Angels Fear
movie:tt23640614.description: It is 1974, Joseph Florio enters Divine Light Catholic High School Preparatory Seminary as a fourteen year old Freshman. He quickly learns that not everyone has enrolled to learn about Clerical life. His life is threatened in an effort to silence him for exposing the secrets he uncovers.

movie:tt35663311.name: Connected
movie:tt35663311.description: The film chronicles the final journey of 88-year-old Russian former top-secret scientist and philanthropist Dmitriy Zimin, alongside his longtime American friend Augie Fabela, acting US police officer, before Zimin’s scheduled euthanasia. Against the backdrop of geopolitical tensions between Putin’s Russia and the USA and the outbreak of war in Ukraine, the film captures the closing scenes of a life and a time of peace. Zimin’s story is an embodiment of the harsh historical cycles that have defined Russia over the past century.

movie:tt42860853.name: Escaping Kabul
movie:tt42860853.description: The dangerous path to freedom for Afghanistan's women cyclists

movie:tt17823452.name: The Squatchers
movie:tt17823452.description: A group of friends, known as "The Squatchers", set out to fulfill their dream of finding Bigfoot, only to wind up on a heart-pounding quest for survival against the unknown. This is one adventure you have to see to believe.

movie:tt37992733.name: George Civeris: A Sense of Urgency
movie:tt37992733.description: In this sharp and surreal stand-up special, George Civeris riffs on the child he'll never raise, the Shakespearian nature of straight weddings, and our equine savior. It's hilariously personal, fully absurdist, and oddly poetic.

movie:tt32204669.name: The Stuttering Preacher
movie:tt32204669.description: Reverend Clarence Jackson III, a charismatic minister who loves all women but finds his match in Efay, a stunning woman who challenges him more than his own speech impediment.

movie:tt39288573.name: The Kinderhook Creature: In the Shadow of Sasquatch
movie:tt39288573.description: Kinderhook is a quiet, picturesque community found in Columbia County, New York, typified by bubbling streams, thick forests and generational homes. But Kinderhook is much more than a small, rural town. In the 1980s an author and radio broadcaster named Bruce Hallenbeck and his family were beset by continual encounters with a strange, upright creature. The sightings became an international phenomenon, and even stranger, were but one of many odd events chronicled by Hallenbeck and others.

movie:tt37530117.name: 18 Heartbeats: Recording Live
movie:tt37530117.description: Ansh and Kavya chase the theory of 18 Heartbeats, a journey that fades into silence, only to be rediscovered a decade later by a college professor amidst a rising student protest.

movie:tt37455562.name: Mermaid Vs. Shark
movie:tt37455562.description: A shark attack survivor transforms into a shark-human hybrid each full moon. He battles flesh-eating mermaids for beach territory while one mermaid and the were-shark develop feelings

movie:tt34882776.name: Cards & Cognac
movie:tt34882776.description: Four men gather for cards and cognac after the death of a close friend. What begins as a fellowship becomes raw confessions of infidelity, betrayal, guilt, and loss, forcing each man to speak their truth while strengthening their brotherhood.

series:tt13694702.name: Surface
series:tt13694702.description: A woman's quest to rebuild her life after a suicide attempt, and her struggle to understand all the things that led up to that moment.

series:tt2712516.name: The Thundermans
series:tt2712516.description: These siblings with superpowers might be twins, but they are very different indeed.

series:tt11097240.name: Obliterated
series:tt11097240.description: A special forces team thwarts a deadly plot in Sin City and parties accordingly. But when the real threat emerges, they must sober up to save Las Vegas.

series:tt5536400.name: Man with a Plan
series:tt5536400.description: A dad finds out that parenting is harder than he thought after his wife goes back to work and he's left at home to take care of the kids.

series:tt9165992.name: My Strange Hero
series:tt9165992.description: Falsely accused of violence in high school, adult Kang Bok Soo returns as a student to get revenge on his first love and classmate who caused his expulsion. He gets caught up in the changed school's dynamics.

series:tt0130414.name: Merlin
series:tt0130414.description: Legendary wizard Merlin tells his story of his war against Queen Mab of the Sidhe and his creation of Camelot.

series:tt1928307.name: Time Bandits
series:tt1928307.description: An unlikely alliance forms between a band of thieves and Kevin, an 11-year-old history buff, as they embark on a perilous mission to save Kevin's family and the world.

series:tt35636155.name: Apocalypse Hotel
series:tt35636155.description: In an isolated Tokyo hotel, robot manager Yachiyo and staff maintain operations amid societal collapse and nature's takeover, faithfully awaiting guests return to Ginzaro.

series:tt6719950.name: Muhammad Ali
series:tt6719950.description: An in-depth look at the life of boxer, Muhammad Ali, including his years as an activist and philanthropist.

series:tt22325774.name: Supersex
series:tt22325774.description: Siffredi's family, his origins, his relationship and the context that led him to embark on his path in pornography and accept that the demon in his body is compatible with love.

series:tt22297712.name: My Love Story with Yamada-kun at Lv999
series:tt22297712.description: After her boyfriend breaks up with her for another girl, Akane Kinoshita decides she is going to make him regret his decision. Unexpectedly, however, she meets a socially awkward gamer who might just solve all of her problems.

series:tt0108847.name: The Magic School Bus
series:tt0108847.description: An eccentric teacher takes her class on wondrous educational field trips with the help of a magic school bus.

series:tt3598030.name: K.C. Undercover
series:tt3598030.description: An outspoken and confident technology wiz and skilled black belt discovers that both her parents are spies and expect her to follow in their footsteps.

series:tt2455546.name: Avengers Assemble
series:tt2455546.description: The further adventures of the Marvel Universe's mightiest general membership superhero team.

series:tt19370256.name: KinnPorsche: The Series
series:tt19370256.description: Porsche agrees to guard mafia heir Kinn for his family's sake, but fighting off danger soon turns into fighting his own feelings.

series:tt2084712.name: Young & Hungry
series:tt2084712.description: A well-off young tech entrepreneur hires a feisty young food blogger to be his personal chef.

series:tt21275092.name: The Spencer Sisters
series:tt21275092.description: Police officer Darby Spencer and her mystery novelist mother Victoria Spencer have opposite personalities but still embark on the unlikeliest of ventures: becoming partners in a private detective agency.

series:tt0105986.name: Diagnosis Murder
series:tt0105986.description: Dr. Mark Sloan has a knack for getting into trouble, negotiating the twists and turns of mysteries and solving crimes with the help of his son, Steve, a homicide detective.

series:tt38626513.name: Becoming a Cooking Soldier Legend
series:tt38626513.description: Kang Seong Jae is a soldier and gets transferred to the Gangrim Post, where First Sergeant Park Jae Yeong, First Lieutenant Cho Ye Rin and military cook Yun Dong Hyeon are stationed.

series:tt31840873.name: The Best Thing
series:tt31840873.description: Workaholic hotel manager Shen Xi Fan meets gentle doctor He Su Ye while seeking treatment. Though initially doctor-patient, they unexpectedly live nearby, allowing love to bloom despite both nursing heartbreaks.

series:tt0805666.name: Shark
series:tt0805666.description: Sebastian Stark is a well-known Los Angeles attorney who leaves his lucrative career defending wealthy criminals to be a prosecutor for the district attorney.

series:tt31867798.name: Wizards Beyond Waverly Place
series:tt31867798.description: Justin embraces mortality to live with his family. His new challenge arises when Alex introduces Billie, a wizard-in-training, seeking Justin's mentorship.

series:tt13317508.name: Midnight at the Pera Palace
series:tt13317508.description: At a historic Istanbul hotel, a journalist is thrust into the past and must stop a plot that could change the fate of modern Turkey.

series:tt2177489.name: Baby Daddy
series:tt2177489.description: A 20-something bachelor bartender becomes an unlikely parent when an ex-girlfriend leaves a baby girl on his doorstep.

series:tt13823494.name: Pistol
series:tt13823494.description: Based on the memoir of Steve Jones, the legendary Sex Pistols guitarist who helped usher in a punk revolution in Britain.

series:tt1694423.name: MasterChef: USA
series:tt1694423.description: A nationwide search for the best home cooks in America. One of 50 hopefuls will become a culinary star and one of America's "Masterchefs."

series:tt14076044.name: WondLa
series:tt14076044.description: A young woman tries to figure out her place in the world while on the run with her robot mother, an over-sized water beast and a tall blue creature.

series:tt9460858.name: The Barrier
series:tt9460858.description: In 2045, Spain like the rest of the western world has been driven into a dictatorial regime by the lack of natural resources. Life in the countryside is impossible, and in the city a fence divides peoples into the powerful, and th...

series:tt18482892.name: Alpha Males
series:tt18482892.description: Pedro, Luis, Raúl and Santi are four friends who feel a bit lost in the new world of empowered women, each trying to adjust in their own haphazard way.

series:tt31975847.name: As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World
series:tt31975847.description: Reborn as nobility with the power to size up talent in a glance, Ars Louvent is on a mission to elevate his new life.

series:tt3214310.name: Tut
series:tt3214310.description: A largely fictional mini-series based on a legendary teenage Pharaoh of Ancient Egypt.

series:tt0985344.name: Claymore
series:tt0985344.description: Hybrid warrior Clare and her comrades fight to protect their land from shape-shifting demons.

series:tt10893694.name: The Irregulars
series:tt10893694.description: Set in Victorian London, the series follows a gang of troubled street teens who are manipulated into solving crimes for the sinister Doctor Watson and his mysterious business partner, the elusive Sherlock Holmes.

series:tt40856520.name: Adarsh Baal Vidyalaya
series:tt40856520.description: A relaxed principal tries to reform a failing public school, triggering a messy transformation as misfit teachers work to repair the system one lesson at a time.

series:tt37180305.name: Friends Sex and Games
series:tt37180305.description: A group of friends starts a daring game. Everyone throws their keys into a bowl—whoever picks one spends the night with the owner of that key.

series:tt41054228.name: Demonzu Kuresto
series:tt41054228.description: סדרת אנימה. סדרה חדשה מאת רקי קאוואהארה, מחבר Accel World ו-Sword Art Online. ב-Sword Art Online, הוצגה מציאות מדומה, ונושא המציאות הרבודה נחקר ב-Sword Art Online the Movie: Ordinal Scale, וכעת "סמל השטנים" צוללת לתוך מציאות מעורבת. כש'קסם אמיתי', משחק תפקידים המוני במציאות מדומה, הראשון בעולם עם צלילה מלאה, מתמזג עם העולם האמיתי, משחק מוות חדש מתחיל. משחק שהוא גם מציאות.

series:tt40914930.name: Alliance
series:tt40914930.description: A competitive captive reality show blending high-stakes strategy, economy and psychological warfare. Sixteen celebrities are split into four teams, battling through physical and mental challenges to earn points-the only currency inside a mysterious HQ run by the System. Face the Ace's power, survive weekly votes, and rebuild alliances every reset.

series:tt35870921.name: Raakh
series:tt35870921.description: When two teenagers vanish, a close-knit family is shattered and the city is left on edge. Determined to uncover the truth, a relentless officer leads a nationwide manhunt that pulls him deep into a world of violence and human depravity.

series:tt43691394.name: TANK CHAIR
series:tt43691394.description: Nagi Taira was the strongest assassin until he fell into a coma protecting his younger sister from a bullet. However, his unique physical constitution allows him to regain consciousness for a short time when “intent to kill” is directed toward him. Now begins Nagi’s “rehabilitation”! He will fight powerful targets in his custom wheelchair until he achieves a full awakening!

series:tt43707668.name: The Threads of Fear
series:tt43707668.description: The Threads of Fear is a psychological thriller miniseries that turns everyday situations into unsettling and disturbing experiences. Across eight episodes, it explores how fear can emerge in the most unexpected places, transforming the familiar into a true nightmare.

series:tt43122935.name: Operation Deception
series:tt43122935.description: Follows a controversial undercover operation that sent Alain Olivier, a drug-addicted Quebec forestry student, to death row in Thailand in 1989.

series:tt40018046.name: The Silent Noise
series:tt40018046.description: In the coastal town of Escondido, Eli, a deaf, 10-year-old child, struggles to make sense of the sudden death of his beloved teacher, Sam Ignacio. As police investigate further, suspicion falls on his family. While they search for the truth, Eli watches his home crumble as devastating secrets unravel.

series:tt16997004.name: Matka King
series:tt16997004.description: In this fictional tale set in 1960s Mumbai, an enterprising cotton trader who craves legitimacy and respect, starts a new gambling game dubbed ‘Matka’, that takes the city by storm and democratizes a terrain previously reserved for the rich and elite.

series:tt38941543.name: Love Is Never Gone
series:tt38941543.description: Teo is a devoted son who dreams of a better life for his family. He falls victim to Yana, a cunning thief known as “Chameleon,” but soon learns she steals out of desperation to care for her sick mother. What begins in anger turns into love, forged through shared loss and sacrifice.  However, Yana’s ties to a crime syndicate lead to betrayal and Teo’s wrongful imprisonment, leaving him convinced she destroyed him. Years later, pardoned and back in the Philippines, Teo tries to rebuild his life, only to discover that Ace Verona’s wife, Gem, is the very image of Yana. As he infiltrates her world seeking justice, he uncovers dangerous secrets about the powerful Verona family and the shocking truth about Gem’s sacrifice to free him. Caught between love, betrayal, and the corruption of a ruthless clan, Teo is forced into a final reckoning where passion, vengeance, and survival collide—proving that love endures even after betrayal.

series:tt31841438.name: I Would Rather Die
series:tt31841438.description: One cold night, misfit Archie gets bitten by a zombie and after briefly considering ending his life, he decides he's going to figure out what the hell is happening to his body. So, with the help of his only friend and his lifelong crush, Archie sets out to find a cure before he turns into a full-blown monster and kills everyone.

series:tt41793323.name: Honor Thy Mother
series:tt41793323.description: After years of estrangement, a mother and daughter find themselves on opposite sides of a bitter contest for what each believes is rightfully hers. Old wounds resurface as they weigh whether to confront the past together or let it drive them further apart.

series:tt30269513.name: Cocaine Quarterback: Signal-Caller for the Cartel
series:tt30269513.description: The unbelievable true tale of convicted drug trafficker Owen Hanson's rise from USC college football champion to smuggling for the world's most dangerous cartel.

series:tt50666033.name: MELANIA the Series
series:tt50666033.description: Experience Melania Trump's transition to First Lady as she navigates the White House and puts her mission into action.

series:tt29106483.name: Fist of the North Star: HOKUTO NO KEN
series:tt29106483.description: In the year 199X, the world was engulfed in nuclear fire!! Yet...humanity somehow survived!! A lone man with seven scars on his chest emerges. His name is Kenshiro, heir to Hokuto Shinken. In a world where only the strong survive, Kenshiro forges a path with his iron fists!

series:tt38638035.name: Soul Power: The Legend of the American Basketball Association
series:tt38638035.description: Experience the ABA's nine-year rivalry with the NBA that changed basketball forever. From the 3-point shot to the Slam Dunk Contest, the ABA's innovations became game staples. Told by "Dr. J" Erving, Larry Brown, Bob Costas & other Hall of Famers.

series:tt32832580.name: ROMCON: Who the F**k Is Jason Porter?
series:tt32832580.description: Discover how Toronto real estate broker Heather Rovet's perfect romance with "Jace" shattered upon discovering he was Jason Porter, a convicted felon with a history of romantic fraud. Connecting with other victims, Heather transforms from heartbroken lover to determined investigator, risking everything to expose his pattern of manipulation and seek justice.

series:tt38956012.name: LOL Next
series:tt38956012.description: Spin-off of the hit series "LOL: Last One Laughing", hosted by Hazel Brugger.

series:tt32974250.name: Naughty Business
series:tt32974250.description: A conservative housewife has to confront her beliefs when her husband falls into a coma, leaving her in charge of their video store on the brink of bankruptcy. She specializes in selling adult films, causing uproar in the neighbor...

series:tt42206913.name: The Grand-ish Tour
series:tt42206913.description: Gathering in the care home where they now live, Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond and James May host three special shows looking back at their favourite Grand Tour moments. Or at least the ones they can remember. Their fading memories stretch from California to Mongolia to Italy and everywhere in between, and include classic moments of misery featuring mud, water, and at least two actual injuries.

series:tt31924802.name: The Revolutionaries
series:tt31924802.description: The Revolutionaries narrates the inspiring tale of brave young Indian freedom fighters who fought for ending British Raj with their unwavering spirit and ideology.

series:tt31844233.name: Daldal
series:tt31844233.description: Haunted by the guilt of her past and dealing with the demons of her present, a newly-appointed DCP, Rita Ferreira, must embark on an investigation of a series of murders that puts her on a collision course with a cold-blooded serial killer.

series:tt39318088.name: Pelayo: Más Allá Del Límite
series:tt39318088.description: An immersive, three-episode docuseries narrated in the first person by Pelayo Gayol, revealing the darkest side of drug trafficking, not as a distant phenomenon, but as a global system that transforms violence into a business. It's a journey of no return to the heart of a silent war where looking the other way is no longer an option. Gayol leaves his role as an instructor to try to understand the roots of the conflict from the frontlines.

series:tt40358752.name: ANIMAL LOVE
series:tt40358752.description: In this fictional drama, Kaia, a trap artist from the outskirts of the city, meets Nico, an upper-class young man with existential angst. Despite their different realities and the outside forces pushing them apart, they try to make space for their love to grow, and in doing so, unleash a gang war.

series:tt31898201.name: Khauf
series:tt31898201.description: Madhu moves into a hostel in Delhi to start afresh, but her room hides a sinister presence that begins to get stronger each day, alarming the other women on her floor. They know what the room hides and desperately want her gone before it is too late for them all.

series:tt27651336.name: Justice on Trial
series:tt27651336.description: Judge Judy Sheindlin puts the American justice system on trial in a true crime high-stakes courtroom drama, as she and her expert legal team recreate the trials from notorious cases where following the letter of the law did not necessarily feel "just."

series:tt34880941.name: Mobile Suit Gundam GQuuuuuuX
series:tt34880941.description: A space colony teen's life changes when she befriends a refugee and joins underground mecha duels. Her world is further shaken by the arrival of a mysterious Gundam and its young pilot, both sought by authorities.

series:tt36939501.name: The CEO Club
series:tt36939501.description: Dive deep into the world of seven trailblazing female CEOs (Serena Williams, Thalia, Dee Ocleppo Hilfiger, Loren Ridinger, Winnie Harlow, Hannah Bronfman, and Isabela Rangel Grutman) as they navigate the triumphs and challenges of both their professional and personal lives. Redefining what it means to lead in today's world, these women enter the next phase of their careers with confidence and clarity forged by life experiences.

series:tt34773311.name: Gram Chikitsalay
series:tt34773311.description: The young, idealistic and brilliant Dr. Prabhat, takes charge of a neglected Primary Health Centre in a North India Village hoping to bring about much needed changes only to realise it is he who will have do change before anything else.

series:tt27621333.name: BAT-FAM
series:tt27621333.description: Follow Batman, Alfred, and young Damian Wayne—who has taken on the mantle of Little Batman—alongside a few newcomers to Wayne Manor, as they navigate the fun and frustrations of life as a super family

series:tt37109800.name: Esports World Cup: Level Up
series:tt37109800.description: Esports World Cup: Level Up follows the most ambitious Esports tournament ever staged—1,500 players, 22 titles, $60 million on the line. From rising prodigies to battle-tested legends, the race for the first-ever Club Championship unfolds in Riyadh. Just because something doesn’t have a history… doesn’t mean it can’t be historic.

series:tt37899694.name: Human Specimens
series:tt37899694.description: Professor Shiro Sakaki, a butterfly researcher, confesses to turning six young boys, including his own son Itaru, into "human specimens."

series:tt35674465.name: Made in India: A Titan Story
series:tt35674465.description: A visionary man Xerxes Desai with his team turns humiliation into history by building India's first world-class watch brand, proving that time itself can be reclaimed through courage, failure, and innovation.

series:tt37090886.name: Young Farts Trailer Parts
series:tt37090886.description: Small-town brothers Jagger and Dawson run Young Farts RV Parts, a multi-million-dollar business where they turn trailer trash into cash. Between outrageous schemes, chaotic stunts, and big-hearted hijinks, these brothers chase one wild idea after the next - all for the love of their family and the empire they’re building.

series:tt30954380.name: Dish It Out
series:tt30954380.description: Tilly Ramsay, a passionate foodie and aspiring chef, steps out of her famous father's shadow and into her own culinary adventures! Tilly takes viewers on a journey celebrating online trends and family favorite recipes - alongside some familiar faces and some surprise visitors who join her in the kitchen.

series:tt38626699.name: Killing Grounds: The Gilgo Beach Murders
series:tt38626699.description: When a woman vanishes, police find bodies along Long Island's shore. Years of dead ends and overlooked victims stall the case until a new task force spots a suspect hiding in plain sight. With trial looming, insiders and families speak.

series:tt32879566.name: The LIberation
series:tt32879566.description: Three women join forces to prevent a sexual harassment complaint against a renowned movie director from coming to light. This controversial mission will take them to the doors of a feminist group named La Aldea, which will take them on an inward journey to heal their patriarchal wounds.

series:tt31925787.name: Do You Wanna Partner
series:tt31925787.description: Best friends Shikha and Anahita turn entrepreneurs with an exciting craft beer brand, Jugaaro, to stand out in the crowded NCR beer market. However, they face gender discrimination every step of the way. To fight for an equal place in this male dominated sector, they decide to invent a fictitious male partner to help smooth their way. Invariably, things don’t go exactly as planned. What follows are their collective adventures & misadventures in trying to build a successful start-up amidst the current boom, as the bunch of misfits band together and become a family.

series:tt34467643.name: Tremembé
series:tt34467643.description: Tremembé reveals the intrigues, love affairs, and unusual stories that take place inside the prison that houses Brazil's most famous criminals.

series:tt41793322.name: The Loyalty Game
series:tt41793322.description: A group of women runs a unique business: luring men to expose their infidelity. Their newest client, Ana, lives a seemingly perfect life with her devoted husband-until doubt creeps in. As he starts to distort her reality, Ana teams up with a loyalty tester, and their search for truth spirals into a dangerous game of secrets, manipulation, and power-where loyalty becomes a matter of life and death.

series:tt32832573.name: 50,000 First Dates: A True Story
series:tt32832573.description: When memory is destroyed and logic gone, is intuition enough to fall in love (again, and again, and again)? This series is the dramatic, almost unbelievable true story of Nesh Pillay, a 32-year-old woman who mysteriously lost the last 15 years of her memory, including recollection of her fiancé.

series:tt35696553.name: Real Madrid: How Could I Not Love You
series:tt35696553.description: At Real Madrid, the demand to win every title each year consistently tests the club's executives, coaching staff, and players. As the 2023-24 season approaches, the club is reinforcing its squad to meet this immense challenge. The goal is to cap off a decade of success that could solidify the team's legendary status and carve out a new golden era in football history.

series:tt32636904.name: Miss Sophie - Same Procedure as Every Year
series:tt32636904.description: At last, the long-awaited prequel to the cult sketch Dinner for One. England, early 20th century - a country estate near Eastbourne. Faced with financial hardship, young Miss Sophie decides to get married and invites marriage candidates to her castle. Before she can make her choice, one of the gentlemen is murdered. Miss Sophie challenges the bachelors to witty competitions for her heart and tries to secretly find the murderer. Always at her side is her butler James - and a tender but seemingly impossible romance develops ...

series:tt40250814.name: Paul
series:tt40250814.description: At nearly 30, Paul Mirabel has just sold Amazon the recording of his show and a documentary about his life. Problem, he spent more time on his PlayStation than working and has no archival footage. In short, he lied. How far will this bluff take him? And to top it off, a childhood love resurfaces, because problems never come alone…

series:tt36939244.name: The Home Team: New York Jets
series:tt36939244.description: In this intimate look at NFL family life, follow Tyler Conklin, C.J. Mosley, Quinnen Williams, Allen Lazard, Alijah Vera-Tucker, and Chuck Clark and their partners through a year of setbacks and breakthroughs . From fatherhood and injuries to contract pressure and uncertain futures, this series captures the heart, sacrifice, and humanity behind America's favorite game.

series:tt38589437.name: The Pyramid Scheme
series:tt38589437.description: Follows the story of Goldy, an ambitious but impatient young man, whose quest to get rich through a pyramid marketing business spirals into a rollercoaster of chaos - risking not just his future, but also the love and trust of his close-knit joint family.

series:tt35996744.name: Day One
series:tt35996744.description: Barcelona, 2026. During Mobile World Congress week, Ulises Albet, a former tech prodigy turned anti-tech activist, becomes the prime suspect in a murder. As he escapes through a city under lockdown, he uncovers the imminent launch of a groundbreaking technology that could put humanity's ethical future at risk. To stop it, he must confront his past.

series:tt31914057.name: Sivarapalli
series:tt31914057.description: Shyam, an engineering graduate from Hyderabad, reluctantly takes up the job of Panchayat Secretary in Sivarapalli, a remote village in Telangana, due to a lack of job options. The show follows Shyam as he navigates the idiosyncrasies and absurdities of village life and his job while preparing for the GMAT, hoping to leave the village and move to the USA.

series:tt38938332.name: LOL: In Real Life
series:tt38938332.description: Philippe Lacheau has invited Franck Dubosc, Clara Luciani, Redouane Bougheraba, Michou and Paola Locatelli to a bold new challenge: Playing LOL in the middle of an airport full of unsuspecting travelers. The rule is simple: Don't laugh... while also making as many of the people around you laugh as possible to rack up points. The winner will earn €100,000 for the charity of their choice.

series:tt36166928.name: The Not Very Grand Tour
series:tt36166928.description: A nostalgic journey through the best automotive adventures, with archive footage and test drives, guided by the legendary James May, Richard Hammond and Jeremy Clarkson.

series:tt31925699.name: Arabia Kadali
series:tt31925699.description: A fictional suspense drama series that revolves around a group of fishermen from rival villages who inadvertently trespass into international waters and find themselves imprisoned in a foreign jail.

series:tt40494646.name: Local Times
series:tt40494646.description: What happens when four friends try to save a dying newspaper with nothing but blind ambition, street smarts, and each other? Local times is a heartfelt comedy of misadventures, where the real headline is the friendship that keeps them going-even when nothing else does.

series:tt31536241.name: Tell Me Your Name
series:tt31536241.description: Toledo, Spain, 1997. The residents of Río Blanco have accepted the settlement of Moroccan seasonal workers in Fuensanta. Coexistence brings tensions, known by Sonia, an NGO leader; Father Ángel, the local priest; and Safir, the imam. What they don't imagine is that Fuensanta's foundations hide something capable of unleashing their worst nightmares, regardless of their beliefs or prayers.

series:tt35667050.name: For the Win: NWSL
series:tt35667050.description: An immersive docuseries offering unprecedented access into the 2024 National Women’s Soccer League (NWSL) playoffs and Championship

series:tt31898339.name: Rangeen
series:tt31898339.description: After discovering his wife's betrayal, a straight-laced husband dives into the hidden world of paid intimacy as a twisted act of revenge. Clueless and out of his depth, he stumbles through misadventures that mix awkward hilarity with raw self-discovery - forcing him to question his notions of love, manhood, and morality.

series:tt31924979.name: Ziddi Girls
series:tt31924979.description: The lives of 5 self-absorbed Gen Z freshers is about to change as they enter the corridors of Matilda House college. Deep friendships form over a year of mistakes, heartbreaks and self-discovery as they put themselves between their college & the forces that threaten it.

series:tt35944495.name: Know Where to Hide - Wie niet weg is…
series:tt35944495.description: Led by presenter Stefan Jurriens, participants are challenged to find the ultimate hiding spot and hide for 90 minutes in some of the most iconic and striking locations in the Netherlands, such as Soestdijk Palace, Euroborg Groningen, Walibi Holland, Hof van Saksen, Archeon and Twenthe Airport.

series:tt39050154.name: The Nowhere Man
series:tt39050154.description: Lukas, a former mercenary haunted by PTSD, roams the city as a waste picker with his trolley. At the homeless shelter where he lives, he salvages scraps to help others. Using his metalworking skill, he crafts statues and sells them to raise funds, quietly battling the violent past he longs to escape.

series:tt39779622.name: Jesy Nelson: Life After Little Mix
series:tt39779622.description: Exclusive and intimate documentary following Jesy Nelson as she becomes a mother for the first time, while reflecting on the years which made her famous in Little Mix. Raw, tender and empowering, it captures her emotional journey - from the joys and heartbreaks of a troubled pregnancy to redefining her identity beyond fame. For the first time, Jesy reveals the truth behind her split from the band.

series:tt36838547.name: Marry My Husband: Japan
series:tt36838547.description: Misa has been a supporting character all her life, blindly trusting her best friend and husband. When she discovers their affair, the betrayal results in her death. Waking up ten years in the past, Misa vows to become the main character of her own story. She plans to ruin her betrayers by making them marry each other, but after meeting her director at work, starts to consider who she truly is.

series:tt43122927.name: Hometown Giants
series:tt43122927.description: Step inside the Vancouver Giants major junior hockey team, where celebrity owners Michael Bublé and Drew Scott set out to revive a franchise that hasn't won a championship since 2007. For the players, they're teenagers living away from home, finishing high school, and chasing NHL dreams they've built their lives around, even though only a few will ever make it.

series:tt18566094.name: #1 Happy Family USA
series:tt18566094.description: An exploration of the experiences of a Muslim-American family that must learn how to code-switch as they navigate the early 2000s: a time of fear, war, and the rapid expansion of the boy-band industrial complex.

series:tt31418326.name: Su majestad
series:tt31418326.description: Pilar, Princess of Spain and future queen of the country, is a troubled free-spirited party lover who is asked to save Spain of a possible scandal which affects to her family and it could ruin the royal institution.

series:tt37542164.name: Built in Birmingham: Brady & the Blues
series:tt37542164.description: A gritty docuseries following Birmingham City Football Club through the 2024/25 season after its purchase by NFL icon Tom Brady and billionaire Tom Wagner. With unfiltered access to Brady, Wagner, the team and fans, this is a character-led series rooted in the city’s unique culture and driven by the stories of those who are deeply invested in bringing success to one of England’s toughest clubs.

series:tt34796686.name: Dinner Club
series:tt34796686.description: Swiss three-star chef Andreas Caminada invites high-profile guests Moritz Bleibtreu, Caro Daur, Karoline Herfurth, Kurt Krömer, Franka Potente, and Teddy Teclebrhan to dinner. After culinary journeys of discovery through different countries, they take turns cooking with Andreas for the other guests and reflect on their experiences.

series:tt36823292.name: Roast on the Coast - Norway
series:tt36823292.description: Six Norwegian comedians have packed their bags and traveled to Cyprus for a week of sun, swimming – and roasting! Each night, a new comedian will take the hot seat to have their life torn apart by the other comedians, before the best roaster of the night is crowned. On the final day of the stay, the week's best roaster and the winner of Roast on The Coast Norway will be announced.

series:tt35984846.name: Octopus!
series:tt35984846.description: This is a documentary about being murdered by your lover, getting lost in Mexico, finding a unicorn, a competitive quilter, Tracy Morgan, and exploring our connection with a possible alien. In other words, it's a documentary about the octopus. Narrated by Phoebe Waller-Bridge.

series:tt10167012.name: Clean Slate
series:tt10167012.description: Harry, an Alabama car wash owner, is surprised when his estranged child returns home after 17 years, now a determined, proud trans woman named Desiree.

series:tt31690920.name: Mentiras, the Series
series:tt31690920.description: After discovering that Emmanuel Mijares has died, Daniela, Dulce, Yuri, and Lupita are summoned to a mysterious mansion. Forced to interact, the tensions between them quickly ignite, and the lies they've been hiding for years come to light. But little by little, these women begin to question themselves, to reflect, and to realize that they share much more than they ever imagined.

series:tt36480078.name: Yes or No Games
series:tt36480078.description: 128 contestants battle it out in 24 breathtaking worlds for €100,000. From the jungle to a pirate island to outer space, Steven Gätjen asks one question: Yes or No? Each answer determines whether the contestant wins or is eliminated. Only the one who masters all worlds wins everything.

series:tt36877792.name: Roast on the Coast - Sweden
series:tt36877792.description: Kristoffer Appelquist has invited five of Sweden’s funniest comedians to his luxury villa in Cyprus. During daytime they soak up the sun and enjoy the pool, but in the evening, things heat up as the guests one after another must take their place in the hot seat and get roasted by their friends. Last of them all is the host, only to then decide who has become the best roaster of the season.

series:tt35522920.name: Spy High
series:tt35522920.description: When teenager Blake Robbins files a lawsuit claiming his school is spying on him, it sparks a wild scandal with alarming digital privacy implications.

series:tt40123418.name: Final Siren: Inside the AFL
series:tt40123418.description: In one of the tightest seasons in AFL history, Final Siren follows seven of the game's biggest names - Marcus Bontempelli, Nat Fyfe, Max Gawn, Toby Greene, Touk Miller, Cam Rayner and Dayne Zorko - as public doubt, online abuse, injuries, ageing, suspensions, and fierce rivalries threaten to derail what could be their shot at Premiership glory in 2025.

series:tt40859434.name: Lukkhe
series:tt40859434.description: A young sportsman infiltrates the wild and dangerous world of Punjab's rap music to investigate a drug syndicate, only to find himself torn between love, family, guilt and brotherhood.

series:tt31898077.name: In Transit
series:tt31898077.description: A documentary series that explores the lives of trans and non-binary individuals navigating love, identity, and the boundaries of gender in a uniquely Indian way.

series:tt36400733.name: Abandoned: The Woman in the Decaying House
series:tt36400733.description: After almost 30 years of silence, a victim shares new and disturbing details of the horror she experienced in the home of the person who became known throughout Brazil as the woman with white ointment on her face.

series:tt33038523.name: Unburied
series:tt33038523.description: Aylín, a teenager from a working-class neighborhood, discovers her supernatural abilities: when she eats soil, she has visions that help her find missing people. Together with her brother and friends, she learns to master this new power. As her skills strengthen, she becomes a heroine fighting against the violence and injustice plaguing her neighborhood.

series:tt31918578.name: Andhera
series:tt31918578.description: In this visceral tale of urban horror, a fearless cop and a haunted medical student must take on this living darkness to avert impending doom.

series:tt39164732.name: Raise the Flags: 50 Years of Buccaneers Football
series:tt39164732.description: From 0-26 to two-time Super Bowl champs - this is the Buccaneers' untold story, featuring Gruden, Sapp, Brady, Evans, Alslott & more.

series:tt37394767.name: The Alibi
series:tt37394767.description: Vincent, an heir to a news empire, gets accused of killing his rival, Walter. To protect his reputation, he hires Stella, an escort with her own haunted past, to pose as his alibi. What begins as a transactional arrangement soon becomes dangerously real as their shared wounds and ambitions draw them together. But when they uncover the truth, the two are compelled to confront their true feelings.

series:tt36041464.name: Par de ideotas
series:tt36041464.description: Vadhir and José Eduardo Derbez open a pop-up bar together, but opening a business for the first time, is anything but easy! With the pressure of trying to make it a success, the brothers work hard but not without crazy and unexpected issues!

series:tt32367551.name: Earnhardt
series:tt32367551.description: The untold story of Dale Earnhardt Sr.'s ascent as NASCAR's preeminent figure. His charm resonated beyond the sport, yielding fame and fortune. An intimate exploration of a working-class icon's impact on his family and the racing world.

series:tt32600812.name: Suga
series:tt32600812.description: After his daughter's tragic death, Suga, the leader of a notorious motorcycle club, struggles to hold his fractured family and gang together. As rival crews and a relentless prosecutor close in, his world shatters when his own brotherhood betrays him. Now, he faces an impossible choice: reclaim his lost power or protect his grieving family.

series:tt38350589.name: Allen Iv3rson
series:tt38350589.description: An unprecedented look at the NBA legend's story. This unflinching docu-series uses never-before-seen footage and exclusive interviews to reveal his remarkable rise from a poverty-stricken upbringing to cultural icon. It chronicles his sacrifice, resilience, and unwavering loyalty to family and community, showing how he redefined the game and empowered future generations.

series:tt35918291.name: Nordin
series:tt35918291.description: When luxury-loving Nordin Kynani is forced by his mother to spend a year teaching at an underprivileged school, he expects an easy ride. But between rebellious students, a corrupt principal, and his own ego, he soon learns that real life isn't about fast cars, but about making an impact.
