Can he turn himself and his class into a success story, or will he fail spectacularly?

series:tt31925820.name: Dupahiya
series:tt31925820.description: Dhadakpur, the Belgium of Bihar, is on the cusp of celebrating 25 years of being crime free. But chaos strikes when a never-seen-before motorbike, that was purchased as a wedding gift gets stolen 7 days before the ceremony! The journey taken by the bride's family and ex-lover to find the Dupahiya forms the heart of this comedy, which explores the hopes and aspirations of simple people.

series:tt36220598.name: Heels in the Hay
series:tt36220598.description: Twelve city influencers trade their luxurious urban lives for the harsh reality of the Dutch countryside. No filters and no oat milk cappuccinos - just early mornings, dirty hands, and fierce competition. They discover that farm life holds more hidden challenges than they ever imagined. Which city dweller will hold their ground? One thing is certain: it won’t be a picture-perfect scene...

series:tt38570835.name: Hollywood Hustler: Glitz, Glam, Scam
series:tt38570835.description: From Midwest dreamer to Hollywood fraudster, Zach Horwitz constructs an elaborate over $650 million Hollywood scam to finance his obsessive quest for stardom. His former inner circle recount how Zach preyed on their trust while living extravagantly, but when investors stop receiving payments, the facade crumbles, exposing the depths of his deception.

series:tt37660537.name: Two Much with Kajol and Twinkle
series:tt37660537.description: Two of India’s sharpest women, Kajol and Twinkle, host a talk show that’s fun, unhinged and sneakily insightful - featuring celebrity guests, wild takes, and total chaos. Like the fun table at the party - everyone’s invited.

series:tt40856820.name: Chaar Yaar
series:tt40856820.description: A story of four middle-class boys, their dreams, setbacks and friendship being their armour. A fateful decision leads them to take a step that changes the course of their lives trapping them between gangsters and cops. What once held them together slowly tears their bond. With their armour shattered, their enemies close in and fate serves up a bill for their crimes.

series:tt40857865.name: Jagamae Sangeetham
series:tt40857865.description: Set in Vaikuntapuram, a sacred temple town nestled between the banks of the Godavari and the neon lights of pop stardom, a disciplined heir to a musical throne and a fame-weary singer strike a forbidden chord. To protect a century of heritage, they must navigate a landscape of family secrets, masked identities, and the heavy price of finding their own voices.

series:tt32832543.name: Tom Green Country
series:tt32832543.description: A funny and heartwarming glimpse into the hilarious life of the infamous comedian as he relocates from Los Angeles to a simpler life on his new remote farm. But farm life isn't easy. Tom scrambles to repair his century-old barns, build fences, install a chicken coop and take ownership of a variety of livestock! Has Tom Green finally bitten off more than he can chew?

series:tt40857820.name: Isakapatnam
series:tt40857820.description: Set in the 1990s, in the ruthless port town of Isakapatnam, three forces collide—a woman driven by justice, a henchman torn by loyalty, and a common man hungry for revenge—each closing in on the empire built by the port’s most powerful man, Naidu.

series:tt34950769.name: Red Carpet Survival
series:tt34950769.description: Herbert Ballerina, Brenda Lodigiani, Antonio Ornano, Awed, Ginevra Fenyes, Pierluca Mariti, Michela Giraud, Gabriele Vagnato, and Francesco Arienzo are the bodyguards in the first edition of "Red Carpet Survival." The best team, at the end of the four episodes, will win the coveted Golden Pigeon. Alessia Marcuzzi will lead the bodyguards. Commenting on it all are the voices of Gialappa's Band.

series:tt35291001.name: The Tinellis
series:tt35291001.description: Marcelo Tinelli opens the doors of his mansion in Punta del Este to welcome his family and friends. He takes the opportunity to introduce them to his girlfriend, Milett, 30 years younger than him. However, the reaction of his daughters is not as expected, and it causes an emotional imbalance in the group a few months before a transcendental event: the wedding of Cande, Marcelo's second daughter.

series:tt28106758.name: Bandwaale
series:tt28106758.description: Mariam, a young poetess, finds herself trapped in a sleepy town, where every young girl's future lies in wedlock. Mariam hopes to find her freedom against all odds, by uploading her poetry on the internet through an anonymous account.Along with her band of misfits - Robo and Psy, Mariam discovers the power of her poetry and her own voice.

series:tt33290236.name: Taurasi
series:tt33290236.description: Basketball legend Diana Taurasi shares the inside story of her life and career - with no stone left unturned.

series:tt43702035.name: Marília Mendonça: All the Feels
series:tt43702035.description: How did an ordinary girl from the heart of Brazil become a phenomenon? Through previously unreleased footage, audio recordings and interviews, the series traces Marília Mendonça's meteoric rise from singing at a gas station to becoming one of Brazil's biggest artists.

series:tt39373808.name: MrBeast: Extreme Survival!
series:tt39373808.description: In this season, MrBeast pushes contestants and himself into the toughest survival experiments imaginable, from one hundred days in bunkers and circles to freezing expeditions and isolation tests. Every scenario is designed to strip life to its basics and reveal who has the strength, patience, and ingenuity to endure.

series:tt46658122.name: No Signal
series:tt46658122.description: Eight influencers accustomed to showcasing an idyllic life on social media attend a transformative retreat to get to know themselves better. What lies behind the perfect life they project?

series:tt39373979.name: MrBeast: Luxury Experiences!
series:tt39373979.description: In this season, MrBeast brings the height of luxury down to Earth. Everything from expensive dates, to high-paying jobs, to the world's most impressive superyachts.

series:tt39205808.name: Serious Business with Anthony Edwards
series:tt39205808.description: Anthony Edwards, the superstar guard for the NBA's Minnesota Timberwolves, is all business. On the court or off, he's ready to challenge whoever, whenever. Perhaps he's crazy or maybe he's a genius, but Edwards believes he can challenge the world's most elite athletes and biggest celebrities in any competition imaginable - and believes he can win. For him, competition is Serious Business.

series:tt39230035.name: What Would You Rather?: Decide to Survive
series:tt39230035.description: Romesh Ranganathan hosts ten UK online stars playing Would You Rather for real. Fiendish dilemmas decide everything, from hilarious supersized games to how they eat and sleep. There's no right decision, but making the least worst choice could guarantee survival (in the game, not literally). You've played it hypothetically, now they're playing it for real, and only one will be crowned champion.

series:tt36851997.name: El Novicio Rebelde
series:tt36851997.description: Rogelio arrives in the El Milagro neighborhood on the run from a dangerous criminal and takes refuge inside the parish church, where he is mistaken for the new seminarian. Taking advantage of the confusion and fearing for his life, Rogelio plays along, but when he tries to escape, he realizes that not only is it impossible, but he no longer wants to leave.

series:tt29538565.name: Mama Drama
series:tt29538565.description: Four young mothers strengthen their friendship beyond their children's school chat group after an intense school camping trip, where they discover who is having an affair with one of their husbands.

series:tt41442832.name: Schnick Schnack Pumuckl treibt Schabernack
series:tt41442832.description: Pumuckl can no longer stand being alone in the workshop. Curious, the little kobold sets off on an adventure and, after an unintended boat ride on the Isar, ends up right in the middle of Munich. Starting from the English Garden, his turbulent journey back begins. Along the way, Pumuckl causes plenty of commotion, mischief, and unexpected encounters—playful, cheeky, yet always with heart and a strong sense of justice.

series:tt38639909.name: Castle Walls
series:tt38639909.description: In the eleventh century, Hasan Sabbah captures the castle of Alamut and founds a mysterious movement that challenges the established order. While his old friend Nizam al-Mulk strives to protect the empire, Azazil—a warrior freed from the dungeon—emerges as his most loyal *fedai*. In this tale where friendship turns to enmity, love, faith, betrayal, and the lust for power fuel a conflict that alters the course of history.

series:tt39653400.name: This Is Not a Dating Show
series:tt39653400.description: A live comedy and improvisation show, every episode of This Is Not A Dating Show brings together 100 singles who have been seriously unlucky in love. A difficult task, but nothing Galder Varas can't handle. And if nobody hooks up, at least we'll have had a laugh.

series:tt43308829.name: Patrocínio
series:tt43308829.description: In a world dominated by filters and controlled narratives, "Patrocinio" breaks with the formality of one of Portugal's most influential families to offer an intimate and unprecedented access to the sisters' world. The camera ceases to be a guest at gala events and instead portrays the emotional, professional, and familial structure that sustains an empire of influence, work, and sisterhood.
